Title: Senior Campaign Analyst
Description:
Who we are

JustWatch delivers data-driven digital marketing for the global entertainment business. From the biggest blockbusters to award-winning shows, major sporting events, and best-selling console games. Not only are we entertainment obsessives ourselves, but we also own the world's largest streaming guide, which gives us unparalleled data and insights on audience behaviours and content tastes.




From a small startup, we've evolved into a 200+ strong team, based in Berlin, around the world, or working remotely. We've been all about building a profitable business while riding that wave of impressive growth.




Who we need

Our Campaign team consists of more than 75+ specialists - and it keeps growing: As our new Senior Campaign Analyst, you are the go-to person for all kinds of data-related requests, reports, and their automation. Your expertise will ensure that our campaigns are fueled by accurate data, actionable insights, and efficient reporting processes.




Learn where your talents can be developed, deliver at your peak, and create value in your work.

Join us and experience a workplace that's the perfect fit for your talent.




What you will be doing

Collaborate with our Business Intelligence department to maintain correct and clearly defined data and KPIs in campaign dashboards.

Title: Senior Analyst — People & Workforce Intelligence (PWI) (d/f/m)
Description:
Personio's intelligent HR platform helps small and medium-sized organizations unlock the power of people by making complicated, time-consuming tasks simple and efficient. Our team of 1,500 Personios is building user-friendly products that delight our 15,000+ customers and their 1.5 million employees. Ready to make an impact from day one?

This role requires 2 days per week in the office and is based in Munich, Berlin or Dublin.

We empower Personio's decision-making with reliable data and strategic insights, while improving productivity through scalable infrastructure and automation. Be part of our transformative journey in HR technology, where your contributions shape how a leading people management platform understands its own workforce.

The Senior Analyst — PWI sits within the Data, Systems & AI department and partners closely with the People & Workplace Intelligence (PWI) function. This role combines two capabilities that are most powerful together: building the data foundations that make reliable analysis possible, and delivering the analysis itself. You own the infrastructure — writing dbt models from raw sources — and you own the insight: turning that data into clear recommendations for People leadership and partners.

You will work closely with PBPs and People leadership to connect people data sources — HRIS, absence and attendance systems, and others — and enable a self-serve analytics capability across the people domain.

What You'll Do

Data Foundations


Build and own dbt models end-to-end — from raw source ingestion through to staging, intermediate, and reporting layers — for the PWI domain, covering HRIS, headcount, absence, attendance, and adjacent people data sources.
Design and maintain scalable warehouse schemas in Snowflake, with clear data lineage, documentation, and version-controlled code (Git).
Define, document, and steward metric definitions and the semantic layer for people data, ensuring reliable KPI logic and metric consistency across the domain.
Implement data quality testing, monitoring, and alerting so that data issues are caught early and fixed proactively — not discovered by stakeholders.


Analytical Delivery


Deliver structured analysis on headcount, attrition, absence and attendance, org design, manager effectiveness, and compensation for PBPs and PWI leadership — forming clear hypotheses and producing decision-ready outputs, not just data dumps.
Build and maintain intuitive dashboards and reporting that allow stakeholders to self-serve on day-to-day questions without requiring analyst involvement.
Support MBR and QBR cycles with data storytelling: own the narrative, not just the numbers.
Partner with PBPs to diagnose root-cause data gaps, translate urgent business needs into analytical deliverables, and systematically improve the quality of people data over time.


Stakeholder Partnership


Act as the embedded analytical partner for the PWI function — showing up proactively, anticipating needs, and flagging risks before they escalate.
Present findings directly to People leadership with confident, prescriptive recommendations.
Enable PBPs to work more independently with data through documentation, self-serve tools, and direct coaching.


What You Need To Succeed

Must-haves


5+ years in analytics engineering, analytics, or a hybrid of both — you have done both the building and the analysis, not just one side.
Expert-level dbt: you have built models from raw source data, written tests, managed documentation, and understand lineage end-to-end — not just maintained existing models.
Strong SQL: complex queries, performance optimization, ability to work across a Snowflake-based data warehouse without hand-holding.
Analytical rigour: you structure ambiguous problems into hypotheses, identify the right metrics, and produce outputs that lead to decisions — not more questions.
Clear communicator: you translate data into plain language for non-technical stakeholders, present confidently, and write documentation that people actually use.
Experience with BI tooling (HEX, Tableau, Looker, or equivalent) for building stakeholder-facing dashboards and reporting.
Comfortable with Git and version-controlled codebases as a daily practice.
High ownership: you diagnose root causes, drive work independently, and don't wait to be told what matters next.


Nice to have


Experience with people/HRIS data — Workday, BambooHR, or similar compensation and benefits tooling.
Python for analytical workflows and automation.
Exposure to AI/LLM tooling (Claude, GPT) for insight generation or workflow automation.


Why Personio

Personio is an equal opportunities employer, committed to building an integrative culture where everyone feels welcomed and supported. We embrace uniqueness and understand that our diverse, values-driven culture makes us stronger. We are proud to have an inclusive workplace environment that will foster your development no matter your gender, civil status, family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, education level, or race.

At Personio, we value in-person collaboration while also offering flexibility. This role is office-based, with 3 days per week required in your contracted office location. The remaining days can be worked from home or in the office if you prefer. In addition, you’ll have 20 Flex Days per year to work remotely from other locations. Aside from our people, culture, and mission, check out some of the other benefits that make Personio a great place to work:


Receive a competitive reward package – reevaluated each year – that includes salary, benefits, and pre-IPO equity
Enjoy 28 days of paid vacation, plus an additional day after 2 and 4 years
Make an impact on the environment and society with 1 (fully paid) Impact Day
Receive generous family leave, child support, mental health support, and sabbatical opportunities
We enjoy gathering for meals, cultural initiatives, and events like local Summer Sessions and year-end celebrations. There's also healthy snacks, drinks, and a weekly catered lunch.

Title: (Junior) Energy Data Scientist – Energiedaten & Automatisierung (MSB) (m/w/d)
Description:
Über uns

Bei VREY bauen wir das EnergyOS für Mehrfamilienhäuser.

In Deutschland stehen über 3,3 Millionen Mehrparteienhäuser – und sie sind das schwarze Loch der Energiewende. <1% Solardurchdringung. <2% Smart Metering. Kaum Flexibilität oder intelligentes Energiemanagement.

Gleichzeitig zwingt die Regulierung Eigentümer zu massiven Investitionen: Solar wird zur Pflicht, Smart Meter müssen in den nächsten 5 Jahren flächendeckend ausgerollt werden, Heizung und Mobilität elektrifizieren sich. Das Mehrfamilienhaus wird vom Betongold zum aktiven Teil der dezentralen Energieinfrastruktur.

Was fehlt, ist ein integriertes System, das diesen Wandel wirtschaftlich und operativ beherrschbar macht.

VREY kombiniert zertifizierten Messstellenbetrieb mit eigener Software und ermöglicht Eigentümern erstmals, ihren selbst erzeugten Solarstrom direkt an ihre Mieter zu verkaufen – einfach und ohne selbst zum Energieversorger zu werden (


42b EnWG).


Damit wird regulatorischer Zwang zu einer profitablen und planbaren Chance:


Zweistellige Renditen und Wertsteigerung für Eigentümer,
~20 % Stromkostenersparnis für Mieter, und
digitale Infrastruktur für Speicher, Wärmepumpen und Flexibilität.


Bereits heute betreuen wir eine dreistellige Anzahl an Projekten - darunter die größten Bestandshalter und Wohnungsbaugenossenschaften - in allen 16 Bundesländern. Damit gehören wir nach kürzester Zeit zu den führenden Anbietern im Markt.

Im Zuge unserer Seed-Finanzierung haben wir 3,3 Mio. € von führenden Impact- und Energy-VCs (u. a. Rubio Impact Ventures, HTGF, Kopa Ventures) eingesammelt. Mit dem frischen Kapital gehen wir in die nächste Wachstumsphase und bauen unser Team gezielt aus.

Wir stehen am Anfang eines strukturellen Marktumbruchs. Wer heute die Energieinfrastruktur im Mehrfamilienhaus definiert, prägt sie für Jahrzehnte. Werde Teil von VREY und baue mit uns das führende EnergyOS.

Dein Profil


Du hast bereits erste Erfahrungen im Consulting (Tier 1/Tier 2), High-Growth Start-ups (idealerweise Operations oder Prozessoptimierung), oder im Projektmanagement gesammelt und ein abgeschlossenes Studium in einem relevanten Bereich
Erfahrung oder starkes Interesse an Datenanalyse, Automatisierung und KI/LLM-Agents (z. B. Python, APIs, Umgang mit größeren Datenmengen)
Sehr gutes Zahlen- und Datenverständnis; Freude daran, Datenqualitätsprobleme systematisch und datenbasiert zu durchdringen
Idealerweise Erfahrung in der Energiewirtschaft / Marktkommunikation (MaKo, Messstellenbetrieb, GGV/Mieterstrom, Bilanzierung) - oder die klare Bereitschaft, sich schnell tief einzuarbeiten.
Strukturierte, gewissenhafte Arbeitsweise: du gibst dich nicht mit „Job abgeschlossen" zufrieden, sondern prüfst, ob das Ergebnis inhaltlich stimmt
Eigenverantwortung und Ownership-Mentalität: du übernimmst einen Bereich, statt nur Aufgaben abzuarbeiten; und strebst danach, dein volles Potenzial in diesem Bereich zu entfalten
Du suchst bewusst keinen 9-to-5-Job, sondern willst in einem schnelllebigen, gründer-nahen Umfeld Verantwortung übernehmen, Strukturen aufbauen und das Wachstum aktiv mitgestalten
Du bist in Berlin (oder bereit umzuziehen) - unser Büro ist unser Homebase
Du sprichst Deutsch und Englisch fließend


Deine Aufgaben

Mission der Rolle

Du sitzt an einer unternehmenskritischen Schnittstelle: tief drin im operativen Energiedaten-Geschäft und mit dem Mandat, dieses Geschäft durch eigene Datenanalysen, Tools und KI-Agenten grundlegend zu automatisieren. Du siehst den unmittelbaren Effekt deiner Arbeit - jedes gelöste Ticket bringt ein Projekt näher an die Abrechnung, jeder gebaute Agent spart dem ganzen Team Zeit.


Datenanalyse & Automatisierung durch eigene KI-Agents
Du analysierst Messwerte, Zählerstände und Versandjobs auf Muster, Ausreißer und wiederkehrende Fehlerursachen
Du übersetzt dieses Wissen in KI-Agenten, die Fehler eigenständig diagnostizieren und Lösungswege vorschlagen oder umsetzen
Du bist der fachliche Motor der Messstellenbetrieb (MSB) App: du erkennst aus dem Tagesgeschäft, welche Features fehlen, spezifizierst sie und bringst sie mittels eigener Entwicklung ins Produkt
Operative Energiedaten-Verantwortung bis zur Abrechnungsreife
Du bringst Projekte Monat für Monat zur Abrechnungsreife: fehlende oder unplausible Messwerte korrigieren, Ersatzwerte über Referenzprofile bilden, Werte maskieren und neu berechnen lassen
Du legst Versandjobs an, überwachst deren Status und plausibilisierst die Daten nach jedem Fix
Du arbeitest dabei täglich in der App unserer Partner und unserer internen MSB App entlang der marktüblichen MSB-Prozesse
Ownership & Skalierung des MSB-Bereichs
Du verantwortest alle Energiedaten-Tickets intern (Projekt- und Abrechnungsteams) wie extern (VNB, Lieferanten, ÜNB) - von Annahme über Priorisierung bis Lösung - und bist Eskalationsinstanz bei komplexen Fällen
Du behältst die MSB-relevanten Postfächer im Blick, ordnest Nachrichten von Marktpartnern den richtigen Vorgängen zu und stellst sicher, dass keine fristrelevante Kommunikation untergeht
Du lernst Praktikant:innen und Werkstudent:innen in Prozesse, Tools und die MSB Bibel ein, begleitest sie bis zur Eigenständigkeit und hältst die Doku aktuell


Benefits

Verantwortung: zentrale Rolle in unserem Kernteam

Vergütung: Kompetitives Gehalt und Anteile am Unternehmen

Startdatum: so bald wie möglich, unbefristet

Team & Benefits: Lustiges Team, Tech Budget von 2 Tsd.€, regelmäßige Team Events und Learning Lunches, Gratis Getränke, Deutschlandticket

Weitere Vorteile: Tägliche Zusammenarbeit mit den Gründern, Getränke & Snacks, Personalverantwortung und die Möglichkeit, das Unternehmen von Grund auf mitzugestalten

Das Wichtigste: Du brennst für Unternehmertum und Start-ups. Bei uns entstehen keine endlosen Slide-Decks oder rein theoretische Modelle – wir bauen ein Unternehmen und machen tagtäglich einen großen Schritt nach vorne. Wenn du von Tag 1 an etwas Großem mitgestalten möchtest, bist du bei uns genau richtig.

Noch ein paar Worte zum Schluss

Bei VREY sind wir davon überzeugt, dass Vielfalt uns als Unternehmen und Gesellschaft stärkt. Weder bei der Einstellung noch während des Beschäftigungsverhältnisses werden Entscheidungen auf Basis von Hautfarbe, Religion oder religiösen Glaubens, ethnischer oder nationaler Herkunft, Behinderung oder Alter getroffen.

Auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst, zögere nicht, dich trotzdem zu bewerben. Wenn du von unserer Mission begeistert bist und glaubst, einen Beitrag leisten zu können, möchten wir von dir hören!

Der beste Weg ist eine warme Intro: Kennst du jemand, der auf diese Rolle passt? Empfiehl die Person und erhalte 3.000€ bei erfolgreicher Einstellung.

Voraussetzung: Die Person ist uns noch nicht bei uns im Prozess und wird offiziell vorgeschlagen. Auszahlung nach bestandener Probezeit. Bei mehrfacher Nennung zählt die erste eingegangene Empfehlung.

Du sitzt an einer unternehmenskritischen Schnittstelle: tief drin im operativen Energiedaten-Geschäft und mit dem Mandat, dieses Geschäft durch eigene Datenanalysen, Tools und KI-Agenten grundlegend zu automatisieren. Du siehst den unmittelbaren Effekt deiner Arbeit - jedes gelöste Ticket bringt ein Projekt näher an die Abrechnung, jeder gebaute Agent spart dem ganzen Team Zeit.

  • Datenanalyse & Automatisierung durch eigene KI-Agents
  • Du analysierst Messwerte, Zählerstände und Versandjobs auf Muster, Ausreißer und wiederkehrende Fehlerursachen
  • Du übersetzt dieses Wissen in KI-Agenten, die Fehler eigenständig diagnostizieren und Lösungswege vorschlagen oder umsetzen
  • Du bist der fachliche Motor der Messstellenbetrieb (MSB) App: du erkennst aus dem Tagesgeschäft, welche Features fehlen, spezifizierst sie und bringst sie mittels eigener Entwicklung ins Produkt
  • Operative Energiedaten-Verantwortung bis zur Abrechnungsreife
  • Du bringst Projekte Monat für Monat zur Abrechnungsreife: fehlende oder unplausible Messwerte korrigieren, Ersatzwerte über Referenzprofile bilden, Werte maskieren und neu berechnen lassen
  • Du legst Versandjobs an, überwachst deren Status und plausibilisierst die Daten nach jedem Fix
  • Du arbeitest dabei täglich in der App unserer Partner und unserer internen MSB App entlang der marktüblichen MSB-Prozesse
  • Ownership & Skalierung des MSB-Bereichs
  • Du verantwortest alle Energiedaten-Tickets intern (Projekt- und Abrechnungsteams) wie extern (VNB, Lieferanten, ÜNB) - von Annahme über Priorisierung bis Lösung - und bist Eskalationsinstanz bei komplexen Fällen
  • Du behältst die MSB-relevanten Postfächer im Blick, ordnest Nachrichten von Marktpartnern den richtigen Vorgängen zu und stellst sicher, dass keine fristrelevante Kommunikation untergeht
  • Du lernst Praktikant:innen und Werkstudent:innen in Prozesse, Tools und die MSB Bibel ein, begleitest sie bis zur Eigenständigkeit und hältst die Doku aktuell

Verantwortung: zentrale Rolle in unserem Kernteam

Vergütung: Kompetitives Gehalt und Anteile am Unternehmen

Startdatum: so bald wie möglich, unbefristet

Team & Benefits: Lustiges Team, Tech Budget von 2 Tsd.€, regelmäßige Team Events und Learning Lunches, Gratis Getränke, Deutschlandticket

Weitere Vorteile: Tägliche Zusammenarbeit mit den Gründern, Getränke & Snacks, Personalverantwortung und die Möglichkeit, das Unternehmen von Grund auf mitzugestalten

Das Wichtigste: Du brennst für Unternehmertum und Start-ups. Bei uns entstehen keine endlosen Slide-Decks oder rein theoretische Modelle – wir bauen ein Unternehmen und machen tagtäglich einen großen Schritt nach vorne. Bei VREY sind wir davon überzeugt, dass Vielfalt uns als Unternehmen und Gesellschaft stärkt. Weder bei der Einstellung noch während des Beschäftigungsverhältnisses werden Entscheidungen auf Basis von Hautfarbe, Religion oder religiösen Glaubens, ethnischer oder nationaler Herkunft, Behinderung oder Alter getroffen.

Auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst, zögere nicht, dich trotzdem zu bewerben. Wenn du von unserer Mission begeistert bist und glaubst, einen Beitrag leisten zu können, möchten wir von dir hören!

Der beste Weg ist eine warme Intro: Kennst du jemand, der auf diese Rolle passt? Empfiehl die Person und erhalte 3.000€ bei erfolgreicher Einstellung.

Title: Sr. Product Analyst (m/w/x)
Description:
About Grover

Founded in 2015, Grover enables consumers and businesses across Europe to subscribe to tech devices and comprehensive technology solutions - from individual smartphones, laptops, and wearables to full corporate device setups. The company offers access to over 1,000 unique tech items on flexible and financially convenient terms. A pioneer of the circular economy, Grover refurbishes and recirculates devices to help eliminate e-waste.

To continue this incredible adventure, we are currently looking for a Sr. Product Data Analyst to join our talented Product Team at our Berlin HQ (3 days per week - Tuesday-Thursday).

Reporting to the Product Director, you will act as a key strategic partner for Product, Engineering, and Design, with a specialized focus on optimizing our Acquisition and Retention domains. You will be responsible for enabling data-inspired product decisions that lift Grover’s user experience to a new level and have a considerable business impact. You foster an environment where data is leveraged effectively to shape product strategy, identify opportunities, and measure success. You do so by ensuring each team has access to the right data, delivering high-quality analyses that uncover actionable insights, and championing best practices in experimentation and data-inspired decision-making.

🎯 What You Will Contribute


Domain Expertise: Serve as the primary data partner for the Acquisition and Retention domains, uncovering insights that drive growth and long-term customer loyalty.
Advanced Experimentation: Own the end-to-end A/B testing lifecycle using our experimentation platform, Eppo, ensuring statistical reliability and continuous improvement.
Strategic Insights: Support and consult on company-wide decision-making through deep-dive product insights and behavioral analysis.
KPI Management: Contribute to defining and maintaining Grover's PIs/KPIs, ensuring they are socialized and understood by key stakeholders.
Roadmap Expansion: Drive new high-impact use cases by collaborating with Data Platform, Engineering, and Product teams to align technical solutions with business objectives.


🤝 What You Bring


Analytic Power: A strong background in Product Analytics, ideally in fast-paced scale-up eCommerce and/or digital subscription environments, with a proven track record of delivering impactful insights.
Domain Versatility: Ability and excitement to work across different domains; prior experience supporting Acquisition and Retention is considered a strong plus.
Technical Stack: High proficiency in SQL and experience with data visualization tools like Tableau, Looker, or Power BI. Familiarity with Segment is a plus.
Experimentation Rigor: Proven experience designing and running A/B tests (experience with Eppo is a significant advantage) and measuring the impact of new features.
AI Adaptability: An "AI-first" mindset with an openness to using tools like Claude to fast-track reporting, enhance documentation, and optimize analytical processes.
Project Management: Strong project management skills - you can take a complex question from a vague idea to a structured, delivered insight.
Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, with the ability to translate complex data into actionable recommendations for both technical and commercial stakeholders.


🚀 The Grover Way - How We Drive Success


Own It: We take ownership seriously and define what success looks like. We drive shared ownership and don't wait - we drive. We keep one another accountable and take responsibility when issues arise.
Challenge, Decide, and Commit: We engage in proactive support, active listening, and healthy conflict to reach the best outcomes. We value diverse perspectives and, once a decision is made, we commit to it fully.
Empower and Grow: We enable, trust, and coach one another toward high performance, always thinking and acting like owners. We seek growth, apply feedback, and support the development of our peers.
Respect, Transparency, and Clarity: We strive for clear, respectful, and open communication with no surprises. We simplify complex information so everyone knows the "what, why, and how".


❤️‍🔥 What You Will Love About Us


BVG monthly discount to drive you everywhere in Berlin
Virtual or In-person Coaching Sessions with the Fürstenberg Institut
Physical health support with Urban Sports Club
Annual learning budget of 750€
15 remote business days per year to work abroad
Exclusive Grover Tech discount for you & your loved ones
Engaging, open office located in Berlin-Schöneberg with regular events
A diverse global team of 75 nationalities (and counting!) - genuinely the nicest group of colleagues who will soon become friends


Embark on a rewarding journey with the Grover Rocketship, where your impact is felt, and together, we cultivate a more circular world. 💚

Grover is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and welcome every applicant, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, disability, or background.

We are looking forward to e-meeting you! 🚀

Title: Mitarbeiter Data & Analytics - Business Intelligence (w/m/d)
Description:
Begleite KPMG bei den zukünftigen Herausforderungen unserer Kund.innen. Begeistere auch Du Dich für die Vielfalt unserer Fragestellungen - und mach gemeinsam mit uns den Unterschied. Mit Deinem Analytics Team aus dem Bereich Markets entwickelst du Datenprodukte für unterschiedliche interne Zielgruppen – immer mit dem Ziel, datenbasierte Entscheidungen zu ermöglichen und echten Impact zu schaffen.

Deine Aufgaben

Du willst mit Daten echten Mehrwert schaffen, moderne Technologien einsetzen und unseren Go-to-Market aktiv unterstützen? Dann kannst Du Dich ab 01. Oktober 2026 hier einbringen:



Als Data Analyst in unserem internen Analytics-Teams gestaltest Du datengetriebene Entscheidungsprozesse auf Basis von internen KPMG-Daten und externen Datenquellen – mit Fokus auf Business Intelligence und ausgewählte KI-Use-Cases.
Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf der Analyse und Aufbereitung von Daten mit SQL sowie der Entwicklung von Dashboards und Reports in Power BI. Dabei unterstützt Du insbesondere Marketing, Targeting und Sales bei der Steuerung und Optimierung ihrer Aktivitäten.
Zudem unterstützt Du die Entwicklung von KI-Use-Cases und übernimmst dabei die Schnittstelle zwischen fachlichen Anforderungen und technischer Umsetzung.
Komplexe Analysen übersetzt Du in verständliche Insights für unterschiedliche interne Stakeholder. Dabei stehst Du im engen Austausch mit den Nutzer:innen, um Anforderungen zu verstehen, Ergebnisse zu präsentieren und Lösungen weiterzuentwickeln.
Erweiterte Analyse-Methoden, z. B. mit Python oder im Bereich Machine Learning, kannst Du bei Interesse in Use Cases wie Kundensegmentierung oder Lead Scoring einbringen und so Deine analytischen Fähigkeiten weiterentwickeln.



Dein Profil



Analytics Professional wirst Du bei uns mit einem abgeschlossenen Studium der Wirtschaftswissenschaften, (Wirtschafts-)Informatik/IT, Mathematik, Psychologie, oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang.
Du bringst erste Erfahrungen im Bereich Data & Analytics, Business Intelligence oder Marktforschung mit.
Du arbeitest sicher mit SQL und einer Programmiersprache wie Python oder R und kennst Dich bereits mit BI-Tools wie Power BI, Tableau oder Qlik aus oder hast Lust, Dich schnell darin einzuarbeiten. Erste Kenntnisse in Machine Learning oder KI-Anwendungen sind ebenfalls ein Plus.
Du denkst analytisch, arbeitest strukturiert und bereitest Ergebnisse klar und adressatengerecht auf. Zudem hast Du Freude daran, Ergebnisse zu präsentieren und stehst gerne im Austausch mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern.
Du hast sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.



Deine Benefits



Willkommen im Team Damit Du von Beginn an voll bei uns durchstarten kannst, begleiten wir Dich mit strukturierten Onboarding-Maßnahmen während der gesamten Orientierungsphase. Zudem fördert Deine Führungskraft gezielt Deine fachliche und persönliche Integration ins Team.
Vielfältige Karriereperspektiven Wir legen Wert auf die individuelle Entwicklung Deiner fachlichen und persönlichen Stärken: Deine eigenen Ambitionen reflektieren wir in strukturierten Entwicklungsgesprächen. Systematische und regelmäßige Feedback-Gespräche unterstützen Dich beim Erreichen dieser Ziele. Mit unserer Vielfalt an spannenden Kunden und Kundinnen sowie Fragestellungen bieten wir Dir interessante Karrieremöglichkeiten und somit wertvolle Einblicke in die Vielfalt unserer Tätigkeitsbereiche.
Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Privatleben Wir sind überzeugt, dass es vor allem Vielfalt und Flexibilität braucht, um Innovationen zu fördern und langfristige Erfolge zu sichern. Nur so können wir die besten Ideen entwickeln und wirklich innovative Lösungen finden. Mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten, Homeoffice-Option, Zeitkonten und Auszeiten schaffen wir Räume, um Privat- und Berufsleben miteinander zu vereinbaren.
Fort- & Weiterbildung Durch regelmäßige Trainings, Workshops und Weiterbildungen entwickelst Du Dich stetig weiter.
Die abgebildeten Leistungen können je nach Position und Standort leicht variieren.

Title: Principal Product Analyst (all genders)
Description:
THE ROLE & THE TEAM

Data is a critical pillar of our product development process, and the Product Analytics team serves as the chief advocate for its quality, consistency, and strategic usage.

We are seeking a data-driven and user-centric professional to drive the strategy, evaluation, and optimization of our digital products. In this role, you will define how we value user interactions, measure success, and tie product features directly to overarching business outcomes.

INCLUSIVE BY DESIGN

If you think you have what it takes, we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every single requirement. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles!

At Zalando, our vision is to be the leading pan-European ecosystem for fashion and lifestyle e-commerce – one that thrives on diversity and is truly inclusive by design. We believe that diverse teams fuel innovation and creativity, and we actively seek out talent from all backgrounds.

We actively seek to reduce bias in our hiring and employment processes, focusing on your qualifications, skills, and contributions. To support this, we kindly ask that you refrain from including personal details such as your photo, age, or marital status in your CV, ensuring a fair and equitable evaluation based solely on your abilities and potential.

We are committed to providing an exceptional and accessible candidate experience for everyone. If you require any accommodations to support you throughout the hiring process, please let us know – we are here to assist you.

Discover more about our commitment to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace https //jobs.zalando.com/en/our-culture/diversity-and-inclusion

WHAT WE’D LOVE YOU TO DO (AND LOVE DOING)



Drive the implementation and evolution of a standardized cross-organizational product performance measurement framework, eliminating metric fragmentation by establishing consistent core KPIs (such as Weekly Active Users, Conversion Rate, and the Overall Evaluation Criterion) across all business units.
Own the technical architecture and attribution models for user value scoring, developing complex data structures to quantify and weigh both upper-funnel engagement actions (e.g., browsing, saving, content interaction) and lower-funnel transactional behaviors.
Advance the content flywheel into a measurable insight engine that definitively proves how content experiences translate into long-term financial, visit frequency, and business value.
Lead the engineering of advanced data solutions and complex analytics pipelines, including session-level tracking, cross-premise identity stitching, and methodologies to mitigate the "Winner’s Curse" in product experiments.
Design, align, and analyze rigorous high-stakes experimentation, including A/B tests and quasi-experiments designed to drive sustainable growth across diverse business models.
Democratize insights and act as a strategic advisor to Senior Leadership Team, Product Managers and Applied Scientists.



WE’D LOVE TO MEET YOU IF



You have 7+ years of experience in product analytics, ideally within a large-scale e-commerce, or product-led environment.
You possess a strong analytical and technical background, with high proficiency in SQL and deep experience using Python or R for advanced analytics and building scalable data pipelines.
You are an expert in A/B testing frameworks, user behavior analytics, experiment design, and managing complex attribution or scoring systems.
You bring a dual understanding of funnel performance, mapping upper-funnel engagement metrics (views, watch time, retention) to lower-funnel transactional performance (conversion rate, contribution margin impact).
You have hands-on experience applying advanced causal inference methodologies (such as Propensity Score Matching, Difference-in-Differences, or Synthetic Controls) when randomized controlled trials are unfeasible.
You have proven leadership capability to excel in highly ambiguous environments, shift organizational models, and lead through influence to align senior executives.
You are a master storyteller with data, confident in communicating complex technical frameworks into simple, actionable strategic recommendations.
You have experience working with modern data visualization and analytics tools to scale data-driven accountability.



OUR OFFER

Zalando provides a range of benefits, here’s an overview of what you can expect. Ask your Talent Acquisition Partner to learn more about what we offer.



27 days of holiday a year to start for full-time employees (+1 day for every calendar year up to 30 days)
2 paid volunteering days a year
Employee shares programme
40% off fashion and beauty products sold and shipped by Zalando, 30% off Lounge by Zalando, discounts from external partners
Relocation assistance available (subject to prior agreement)
Family services, including counselling and support
Health and wellbeing options (including Wellhub, formerly Gympass)
Mental health support and coaching available
Drive your development through our training platform and biannual peer-to-peer review

Title: Associate Data Analytics (m/w/d), AI + Innovation
Description:
Associate Data Analytics (m/w/d), AI + Innovation




FGS Global berät die einflussreichsten Entscheider:innen der Welt, genau dort, wo Wirtschaft, Politik und öffentliche Meinung aufeinandertreffen. Wir unterstützen CEOs, Aufsichtsräte und Führungsteams in den entscheidenden Momenten: bei Transaktionen, Krisen, Transformationen und komplexen regulatorischen Herausforderungen.




Unsere Expert:innen vereinen Hintergründe aus Kommunikation, Finanzen, Recht, Politik, Journalismus und Datenwissenschaft. Was auch immer der Moment erfordert – wir verbinden unterschiedliche Perspektiven und bringen das richtige Team zusammen, damit Führungskräfte die nächsten Schritte antizipieren, die relevanten Stakeholder einbinden und greifbare Ergebnisse erzielen können. Dabei arbeiten wir als ein Team – über Grenzen und Disziplinen hinweg.




Mit 31 Büros weltweit nutzen wir die gesamte Expertise unserer globalen Teams – von Berlin, Frankfurt, Düsseldorf und München bis New York, London, Singapur und Tokio – damit unsere Mandant:innen mit Klarheit handeln, mit Zuversicht entscheiden und mit Vertrauen führen können. Wir sind vier Jahre in Folge die weltweit führende M&A-PR-Beratung nach Deal-Wert und Deal-Anzahl (Mergermarket, 2025) und werden von Chambers und Partners in der höchsten Kategorie für Crisis & Risk Management und Litigation Support geführt.




Verstärke unser Team am Standort Berlin, Frankfurt oder München als Associate Data Analytics zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt




Beratung lebt von Urteilsvermögen. Du hilfst uns, dieses Urteilsvermögen mit Daten zu untermauern. Als Associate Data Analytics bist du ein integraler Bestandteil der Business Unit AI + Innovation, einer Gruppe, die Standards dafür setzt, wie umsetzbare Intelligence-Lösungen im Beratungsumfeld aussehen. Wir verbinden Insight mit Foresight, um Kunden und Kollegen in entscheidenden Momenten erstklassige Beratung zu bieten.




Innerhalb des AI + Innovation-Teams arbeitet unser Decision-Intelligence-Team eng mit FGS Labs zusammen, einem Entwicklungsteam, das Software für interne und Kundenanwendungen entwirft und baut. Du sitzt an der Schnittstelle beider Welten: analytische Tiefe trifft strategische Beratungslogik.




Deine Aufgaben




Du analysierst Medienberichterstattung, öffentlichen Diskurs und digitale Konversationen, erkennst Muster, die andere übersehen, und übersetzt diese in strategische Empfehlungen zu Reputationsrisiken, Kampagnen-Performance und Stakeholder-Dynamiken.
Du überführst komplexe Kommunikationsherausforderungen in klare analytische Ansätze: Was sagen uns die Daten? Was bedeutet das für die Strategie des Kunden?
Du erstellst Reports, Dashboards und Präsentationen, die aus Datenpunkten handlungsrelevante Erkenntnisse machen, und berätst damit auf Augenhöhe mit erfahrenen Senior-Consultants.
Du unterstützt Pitches und Kunden-Briefings mit datenbasierten Argumenten und Intelligence, die den Unterschied zwischen einer guten und einer überzeugenden Empfehlung ausmachen.
Du arbeitest eng mit Beratern und internen Data Scientists zusammen und bist das Bindeglied zwischen analytischer Strenge und Beratungslogik.
Du hältst unser Methoden-Repertoire aktuell: neue KI-gestützte Tools, verbesserte Analyseframeworks, schärfere Visualisierungen.




Was du mitbringen solltest




Du hast Dein Hochschulstudium erfolgreich abgeschlossen oder stehst kurz vor dem Abschluss und hast die Zeit neben dem Studium genutzt, um Dir bereits erste relevante Praxiserfahrung aufzubauen.
Du hast eine ausgeprägte Nachrichtenaffinität: Du verfolgst nicht nur, was passiert. Du verstehst, warum eine Geschichte zieht, wie Themen gerahmt werden, welche Interessen dahinterstehen und was Berichterstattung antreibt.
Du denkst strukturiert, arbeitest zuverlässig und weißt, wie man komplexe Sachverhalte auf das Wesentliche verdichtet und Ergebnisse so aufbereitet, dass sie auch auf Vorstandsebene überzeugen.
Du bringst Eigeninitiative mit, interessierst Dich für KI und datengetriebene Ansätze und entwickelst gerne eigene Ideen. Programmierkenntnisse sind dabei nicht erforderlich.
Du kommunizierst klar und zielgruppengerecht, ob mit dem Analysten oder der Kunden-C-Suite und verwandelst Daten und Analysen in überzeugende Narrative.
Du verfügst über verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.




Was wir bieten




Ein internationales und inspirierendes Arbeitsumfeld
Vielfältige und abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben mit Raum für eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten
Strukturierte Einarbeitung und individuelle Betreuung durch erfahrene Kolleg:innen
Die Möglichkeit, aktiv an Prozessen mitzuwirken und neue Ideen einzubringen sowie deren Umsetzung mitzugestalten
Ein engagiertes, kollegiales und wachsendes Team mit ausgeprägtem Teamgeist und gegenseitiger Wertschätzung
Eine Unternehmenskultur, die Professionalität mit einem wertschätzenden Miteinander verbindet
Umfangreiche Möglichkeiten zur persönlichen und fachlichen Weiterentwicklung
Flexibles Arbeiten mit der Option, bis zu zwei Tage pro Woche mobil zu arbeiten




Du erfüllst nicht jede einzelne Anforderung? Kein Problem. Studien haben gezeigt, dass bestimmte Gruppen, etwa Frauen oder People of Color, seltener auf Stellen bewerben, wenn sie nicht jede Qualifikation erfüllen. Bei FGS Global sind wir dem Aufbau eines diversen, inklusiven und authentischen Arbeitsplatzes verpflichtet. Wenn du von dieser Stelle und unserem Unternehmen begeistert bist, dein Werdegang aber nicht perfekt zu jeder Anforderung passt, ermutigen wir dich, dich trotzdem zu bewerben. Du könntest genau die richtige Person für diese oder eine andere Stelle sein.




Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung. Bitte füge ein Anschreiben, einen aktuellen Lebenslauf sowie relevante Abschluss- und Arbeitszeugnisse bei. Weitere Fragen zur Stelle, zu FGS Global oder darüber hinaus? Mehr Informationen findest du hier FGS Global

Title: Liability Data Analyst
Place: Brighton And Hove, England, United Kingdom
Description:
Legal & General (L&G) is a leading UK financial services group and major global investor.



We’ve been safeguarding people’s financial futures since 1836, and strive to build a better society, while improving the lives of our customers and creating value for shareholders.



We are one of the world’s largest asset managers and provide powerful asset origination capabilities. Together, these underpin our retirement and protection solutions: we are an international player in pension risk transfer, in UK and US life insurance, and in UK workplace pensions and retirement income.



Our Group Functions provide the services that all areas of the business need. This requires a talented and diverse team behind the scenes, who enable everyone at L&G to do what they do best. 



Joining us means helping to improve the lives of our customers and contributing to the success of the business every day.





Job Description



We're looking for a Liability Data Analyst to join our Payroll & Reinsurance team within Institutional Retirement. This is an opportunity to work at the heart of Pension Risk Transfer operations, helping ensure complex liability data is accurate, reliable and delivered to the highest standards.



You'll work with a broad range of stakeholders, supporting major pension transactions while helping improve the quality and integrity of data used across the business. Whether you're already experienced in pensions data or looking to further develop your technical analytical skills, this role offers excellent exposure and development opportunities.



What you’ll be doing:



Managing data cleansing, validation and transformation activities
Supporting Pension Risk Transfer transactions from end to end
Consulting with stakeholders to understand data requirements
Improving the quality and integrity of data across systems
Supporting testing activities and documenting operational processes
Maintaining accurate audit trails and governance standards
Delivering timely and accurate data solutions to internal customers
Identifying opportunities to improve processes and ways of working

Who we’re looking for:



Advanced Microsoft Excel skills
Strong analytical and problem-solving capability
Experience working with complex data sets
Ability to manage priorities and meet deadlines
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
High attention to detail and commitment to quality
Experience with Python, SAS or SQL would be beneficial
Knowledge of Defined Benefit pensions would be advantageous

Whatever your role, we reward performance and behaviour with a package that looks after all the things that are important to you. Here are some of the benefits we offer:



The opportunity to participate in our annual, performance -related bonus plan and valuable share schemes
Generous pension contribution
Life assurance
Healthcare Plan (permanent employees only)
At least 25 days holiday, plus public holidays, 26 days after 2 years’ service. There’s also the option to buy and sell holiday
Competitive family leave
Participate in our electric car scheme, which offers employees the option to hire a brand-new electric car through tax efficient salary sacrifice (permanent employees only)
There are many discounts we offer – both for our own products and at a range of high street stores and online
We’re creating net‑zero carbon workplaces by 2030 by investing in our sustainable, modern offices across the UK, all designed to bring people together and elevate the in‑person experience


Additional Information



At L&G, we believe it's possible to generate positive returns today while helping to build a better future for all.



If you join us, you’ll be part of a welcoming, inclusive culture, with opportunities to collaborate with people of diverse backgrounds, views, and experiences. Guided by leaders with integrity who care about your future and wellbeing. Empowered through initiatives which support people to develop their careers and excel.



We care passionately about outcomes rather than attendance and are therefore open to discussing all kinds of flexible working options including part-time and job shares. Although some roles have limited flexibility due to customer demand, we accommodate requests when we can.



It doesn’t matter if you don’t meet every single criterion in this advert. Instead, think about what you excel at and what else you can bring in terms of strengths, potential and connection to our purpose.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Do you love turning data into meaningful insights? Are you naturally curious, analytical, and passionate about helping businesses make better decisions?

We're looking for a Data Analyst to join our Data & Insights team at Goodwood. Supporting a diverse range of departments across the Estate, you'll help uncover trends, understand customer behaviour, and provide valuable insights that influence business decisions.

No two days are the same at Goodwood, and you'll have the opportunity to work with data from our world-famous events, hospitality venues, leisure businesses, and customer experiences.

What You'll Be Doing

As a Data Analyst, you'll support the delivery of reporting and insights across the business, helping teams better understand performance and identify opportunities for improvement.

Your responsibilities will include:


Working closely with stakeholders to understand their reporting and insight requirements
Analysing data from a variety of sources to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities
Monitoring and reporting on key performance indicators using Power BI and other reporting tools
Producing customer insights to support marketing, sales, and commercial decision-making
Building, analysing, and reporting on survey results
Presenting findings and recommendations in a clear and engaging way, supporting stakeholders to act on insights and drive meaningful outcomes
Support the Data & Insights team with ad hoc analysis, report building and data projects
Help to maintain and continuously improve the accuracy and integrity of key customer data systems


What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who enjoys solving problems, has a keen eye for detail, and is excited by the opportunity to turn data into actionable insights.

You'll have:


Prior experience using Power BI and advanced Excel skills
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
The ability to interpret data and communicate findings clearly
Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy
Strong communication skills and the confidence to work with a variety of stakeholders
A proactive and curious approach, with a genuine interest in understanding customers and business performance
Strong presentation and communication skills, with the ability to translate data and insights into clear, engaging recommendations that support decision-making and drive positive outcomes


Why join us?

This is a fantastic opportunity to join a collaborative team and make a real impact through data.

At Goodwood, you'll gain exposure to a wide range of business areas while helping teams make informed decisions that enhance both operational performance and customer experience.

If you're passionate about data, curious by nature, and enjoy uncovering the story behind the numbers, we'd love to hear from you.

Title: RFID Analyst
Description:
Because we strive to put people first.

Culture, our way

Technology at Primark

What’s a career at Primark all about? The positive impact you’re making, the experiences you’re having and the people you’re with. You’re our inspiration. Embrace what sets you apart, own your career and develop in ways you never expected. Leave your mark. And do it your way.

Our technology team is actively shaping the next wave of advancements. Engaged with innovative initiatives, your expertise will propel our business into the future. Collaborating with a creative team of tech enthusiasts, you’ll contribute your unique skills to fuel our technological advancements.

What You’ll Get

People are at the heart of what we do here, so it’s essential we provide you with the right environment to perform at your very best.

Let’s talk lifestyle: Healthcare, Potential Bonus, Pension,27 days of leave, plus bank holidays and if you want, you can buy 5 more. Because Primark is all about tailoring to you, we offer Tax Saver Tickets, fitness centre, and a subsidised cafeteria.

What You’ll Do as a RFID Analyst

We want you to feel challenged and inspired. Here, you’ll develop your skills across a range of responsibilities:


Analyze RFID and operational data to identify high-volume continuity merchandise, recommending targeted actions in partnership with supply chain and logistics teams to improve availability and performance.
Evaluate and interpret RFID count saturation test results across departments and depots, providing insights to optimize inventory accuracy and operational effectiveness.
Identify, quantify, and drive value realization opportunities across all phases of RFID implementation, including sales growth, shrink reduction, and process efficiency improvements.
Develop and present robust business case proposals, partnering with Finance to validate benefits, costs, and return on investment.
Leverage industry best practices, vendor partnerships, and external retail networks to shape and deliver the RFID roadmap and future use cases.
Apply predictive analytics and market insights to drive performance improvements, while effectively communicating progress, risks, and opportunities to senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams.


What You’ll Bring

Here at Primark, we want everyone to feel valued – so please bring your authentic self to work, of course with some other key experience and abilities for this role in particular:


Minimum 2 years’ experience working with RFID-generated data, supporting deployments and identifying opportunities for new use cases and business value creation.
Over 5 years’ experience in retail or supply chain environments, with a strong understanding of central functions, operational processes, and performance drivers.
Advanced analytical skills with experience building dashboards and managing complex datasets using Power BI, Tableau, or similar business intelligence tools.
Strong ability to interpret data from multiple sources, draw evidence-based conclusions, and provide actionable recommendations that balance cost, value, and customer experience.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to present complex technical concepts, including RFID technology and strategy, to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Demonstrated strategic and innovative thinking, supported by a strong awareness of retail industry trends, emerging technologies, and cross-functional collaboration.


Does this sound like you? Great, because we can’t wait to see what you’ll bring. You’ll be supported within a team of equally capable people, celebrating who you are and aiding you reach your potential. At Primark, we’re excited about our future - and we’re excited to develop yours.

About Primark

At Primark, people matter. They’re the beating heart of our business and the reason we’ve grown from our first store in Dublin in 1969 to a £9bn+ turnover business and over 80,000 colleagues and over 440 stores in 17 countries today. Our values run through everything we do. In essence, we're Caring and always strive to put people first. We're also Dynamic, bravely pushing the boundaries to stay ahead. And finally, we succeed Together.

If you need any reasonable adjustments or have an accessibility request, during your recruitment journey, such as extended time or breaks between online assessments, a sign language interpreter, mobility access, or assistive technology please contact your talent acquisition specialist.

All offers of employment are subject to background checks, including right to work, reference education and for some roles criminal, and financial checks. If you have any concerns, please reach out to our talent acquisition team to discuss.

Title: Service Analyst
Description:
Job Description

Do you enjoy turning data into insights, identifying opportunities for improvement and helping shape better digital services? Then join East Sussex County Council’s IT & Digital team as a Service Analyst, where you'll help improve services, influence decision-making and support the delivery of customer-focused digital solutions across the organisation.

The Service Analyst sits within the Products & Services team in IT & Digital, supporting the design, delivery and continual improvement of services that meet the needs of colleagues and residents. You will analyse data, produce reports and presentations, coordinate customer requests and feedback, support continual service improvement activities, undertake business analysis and help define requirements for new and enhanced digital solutions.

This is an excellent opportunity to develop your analytical, business analysis and service management skills while making a real difference to how services are delivered.

We Are Looking For Candidates Who


Have experience working in a data analyst or similar analytical role.
Can analyse, interpret and clearly present data and information to support decision-making.
Have effective communication skills and can adapt messages for a variety of audiences.
Can build effective working relationships and collaborate across teams to achieve shared goals.
Are confident using technology including Microsoft 365, ITSM systems and reporting or analytical tools.


Please download the job description and person specification for more information.

We warmly welcome applications from all sections of the community. We are working towards recruiting a workforce that reflects our community, because we recognise the value of diverse perspective and experiences.

To apply for this role, please follow the ‘Apply Now’ button above and upload your CV and a Supporting Statement. When writing your supporting statement be sure to address how you meet all the criteria in the person specification drawing on any relevant work/life experience, education or personal interests.

For guidance on how to write an application see our how to apply page and our statement on the use of AI .

Interviews will take place in-person at County Hall, St Anne's Crescent, Lewes, East Sussex, BN7 1UE.

Interviews are expected to take place during September 2026. If you are unavailable, please let us know and we may be able to offer an alternative interview date.

Candidates who meet certain criteria are given priority when we shortlist. See our priority status page for details.

We offer a diverse range of benefits to help and support you during your employment. More information can be found on our benefits page .

Vocational Training through Apprenticeships is now available to our staff, ranging from entry level to degree level qualifications. You can talk to the hiring manager and the apprenticeship team about what qualifications would be relevant to you and this job role, and if it is possible to support you in apprenticeship training.

For an informal discussion about this opportunity contact Sharon Newman, Senior Service Analyst at sharon.newman@eastsussex.gov.uk to request a MS teams call or phone call.

Be part of something that makes a difference – for our communities, our colleagues and our future.

Choose East Sussex!

About Us

Additional Information

Your starting salary will be pro rata if the above position is part-time or term-time only.

If you require sponsorship to work in the UK please let the hiring manager know this in your application so we can check eligibility for sponsorship for the role. For further information please go to Work in the UK - GOV.UK (www.gov.uk) .

If you require any reasonable adjustments, due to disability, to enable you to participate fully in the process please contact the hiring manager on the contact details above.

Title: Pricing Analyst
Description:
Role Description

An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Pricing Analyst to join our growing Animal Health Technical Pricing Team. The team is responsible for building technical Pricing models and monitoring the risk to support the market leading brand PetPlan as well as our growing LV pet proposition. Our team is at the heart of achieving the company’s strategy and it is an exciting time for you to join and shape the future of our business.

This is a great role for someone looking to develop their data and analytics skills to drive and improve business outcomes. A great advantage of being a member of the Animal Health Pricing team is the extensive training provided. The UK team has collaborated with the worldwide Allianz Group, to deliver an accreditation scheme designed to train you in all aspects of pricing. From data science modelling in cutting edge software to automating optimisation calculation routines honed across global markets.

Pricing will play a key role in delivering this ambition. We are looking for individuals who have an eye for detail, love working with technology and have a passion for analysing data. You’ll be at the sharp end of our business, delivering analytical models that are used to drive commercial decisions, solve challenging problems, and deliver enhancements to our products and pricing techniques.

Location

This role is based in our Guildford office. This is a hybrid role with expectation of you attending the office one day per week

Salary Information

This role offers a circa range of £41,000 to £43,000 per year. Pay is based on relevant experience, skills for the role, and location. Salary is only one part of our total reward package.

About You


Build sophisticated technical Pricing Models using Willis Tower Watson tools (Emblem and Radar) and Machine Learning.
Develop demand forecasting models and contribute to the analysis of customer retention and cancellation patterns
Be part of strategic projects to create tariff of new products.
Monitor carefully the risk of our existing products and share any statistical analysis with other teams.
Be part of many projects involving Machine Learning: Data preparation, Classification and Regression Models, Automation, Risk monitoring
Consider any market disruptions (Covid, Economic crisis) that impact our models
Support initiatives to maintain our “Excellent” Technical Price Certification.
Share and promote knowledge, skills and best working practices within the team.
Be fully supported in your development and wider career ambitions
Be part of a motivated an exciting team where the word boring does not exist!


Essential Skills


Previous experience working in a business environment
Experience of using data analytics tools like WTW tools (Emblem / Radar), SAS, Python, SQL, Excel, VBA.
Qualified to degree level and have a high degree of numerical ability: E.g. Mathematics, Actuarial, Economics, Statistics
Well-developed problem-solving skills, logically working through scenarios and thinking multiple steps ahead to understand potential impacts
Experience of using machine learning.
Excellent analytical and data interpretation skills when working with large volumes of complex data
Ability to communicate findings to technical and non-technical audiences
Business acumen as well as a basic understanding of the insurance sector


We support the government scheme “Access to Work” please feel free to ask us about the access to work scheme.

Desirable Skills


You embrace innovation and like challenge
You take ownership of your projects
Responsible Artificial Intelligence usage is desirable but not essential


What We Will Offer You

Recognised and rewarded for a job well done, we have a range of flexible benefits for you to choose from- so you can pick a package that’s perfect for you. We also offer flexible working options, global career opportunities across the wider Allianz Group, and fantastic career development and training. That’s on top of enjoying all the benefits you’d expect from the world’s number one insurance brand, including:


Flexible buy/sell holiday options
Hybrid working
Annual performance related bonus
Contributory pension scheme
Development days
A discount up to 50% on a range of insurance products including car, home and pet
Retail discounts
Volunteering days


Our Ways of Working

Do you need flexibility with the hours you work? Let us know as part of your application and if it’s right for our customers, our business and for you, then we’ll do everything we can to make it happen. Here at Allianz, we are signatories of the ABIs flexible working charter. We believe in supporting hybrid work patterns, which balance the needs of our customers, with your personal circumstances and our business requirements. Our aim with this is to help innovation, creativity, and you to thrive - Your work life balance is important to us.

Inclusive Support & Accessibility

At Allianz, we are committed to fostering building an inclusive, accessible workplace where everyone can thrive. As a Disability Confident employer, we welcome applications from disabled and neurodivergent candidates and offer tailored adjustments throughout the recruitment process and in the workplace, whether that’s assistive technology, ergonomic equipment, flexible working arrangements, mentoring or coaching. We want to encourage candidates to speak with us about any adjustments they may need. We’re here to support you.

If you have a disability or long‑term health condition and meet the essential criteria, you can choose to be considered through our Offer an Interview Scheme.

Contact our Resourcing team to opt into this scheme or for any assistance with during the recruitment process including larger text, hard copies, or spoken applications. Hr-recruitment@allianz.co.uk

For any inquiries or to submit your application, please contact: Conor McCourt

If you are an at-risk candidate facing potential redeployment, please include this information in your CV.

Closing date: August 16th 2026

We reserve the right to close the advert early if we reach enough applications.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Hey! We're Huel, and we're pleased to meet you 👋

Our culture thrives on high performance, and we set the bar high for new Hueligans who join us.

We invite you to read the advert below for our new Data Analyst position to understand the role, and explore our 7 Huel values before applying to ensure we have the right working environment for you!

The role

Huel is looking for a Data Analyst to turn raw behavioural and commercial data into clear, actionable insights for Marketing, Trading, Product, and Retail teams. You’ll build measurement frameworks, run causal analyses, and create self-serve dashboards, helping the business move fast and make confident, data-driven decisions.

Key responsibilities include:


Owning end-to-end analysis – translate open-ended questions from Marketing, Trading, Product, and Retail into clear analytical briefs, run the analysis, and land unambiguous recommendations.
Designing & evaluating experiments – design A/B tests and causal-inference studies (lift analysis, hold-out tests) and communicate results in plain language.
Defining measurement frameworks – set the right KPIs and establish how new initiatives will be measured, ensuring every launch has a clear success metric and data plan from day one.
Scale our data foundations – team up with Engineering to design efficient, accurate data sets and schemas, define requirements for new data feeds, and automate the checks that keep everything running smoothly.
Championing self-serve analytics – develop and maintain live dashboards, document datasets, and run training sessions so non-analysts can answer routine questions without waiting in a queue.
AI & Automation - Champion the adoption of AI-powered analytics, using AI tools to enhance analysis, automate routine activities, uncover deeper insights, and improve productivity, while enabling colleagues to self-serve trusted data and answer business questions independently.
Spotting growth opportunities – combine behavioural and marketing data with commercial metrics to size new products, markets, and campaigns, prioritising by impact and effort.


This role is based at our HQ in Tring, Hertfordshire. We operate a hybrid working model, with office days on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays, and the flexibility to work from home on Wednesdays and Fridays.

Not yet sure if this is the right role for you? Click HERE to read a more detailed job description.

What we're looking for in you

We’re looking for a confident, curious analyst who’s comfortable working with statistics, behavioural data, and experiment design. You can move seamlessly between SQL, product analytics tools, and storytelling through slides. You’re proactive, independent, and always looking for high-impact opportunities to raise the bar on how we use data. In a fast-paced environment, you adapt quickly and communicate clearly - collaborating with both technical and non-technical teams to get things done.


SQL – you can write quick exploratory queries or optimise a multi-table join on Snowflake without breaking a sweat.
Product analytics – comfortable in platforms such as Heap, Amplitude or Mixpanel and happy to set up events, funnels and cohorts from scratch.
Statistical – solid on A/B testing, experiment design and the basics of causal inference; you know when a result is worth acting on.
Measurement mindset – you’ve built tracking plans and KPI frameworks that let teams see what “good” looks like before they ship.
Data - experience modelling data in dbt (or similar), automating checks and keeping feeds clean and accurate as they scale.


And as always, we’re on the lookout for new Hueligans who love a fast-paced environment and are always striving to be their best. We want people who aren’t afraid to think differently and push boundaries. If you’re all about setting big goals and believe that amazing things happen through creativity and teamwork, you’ll fit right in at Huel!

What do we offer in return?

We know that at times, our teams face demanding pressures, and exceptional effort deserves meaningful rewards. That's why we've created a world-class perks and benefits program designed to support our Hueligans in achieving their best, both professionally and personally, while celebrating the global impact they're making!

🕖 Hybrid working - We spend Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays in the office together. The remaining two days have the option to be worked from home.

🌴 30 days annual leave PLUS bank holidays

🥤 Free Huel to keep you going

🏖️ 2 weeks a year to work remotely from anywhere!

Our culture thrives on high performance, and we set the bar high for new Hueligans who join us.

We invite you to read the advert below for our new Data Analyst position to understand the role, and explore our 7 Huel values before applying to ensure we have the right working environment for you!

The role

Huel is looking for a Data Analyst to turn raw behavioural and commercial data into clear, actionable insights for Marketing, Trading, Product, and Retail teams. You’ll build measurement frameworks, run causal analyses, and create self-serve dashboards, helping the business move fast and make confident, data-driven decisions.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Owning end-to-end analysis – translate open-ended questions from Marketing, Trading, Product, and Retail into clear analytical briefs, run the analysis, and land unambiguous recommendations.
  • Designing & evaluating experiments – design A/B tests and causal-inference studies (lift analysis, hold-out tests) and communicate results in plain language.
  • Defining measurement frameworks – set the right KPIs and establish how new initiatives will be measured, ensuring every launch has a clear success metric and data plan from day one.
  • Scale our data foundations – team up with Engineering to design efficient, accurate data sets and schemas, define requirements for new data feeds, and automate the checks that keep everything running smoothly.
  • Championing self-serve analytics – develop and maintain live dashboards, document datasets, and run training sessions so non-analysts can answer routine questions without waiting in a queue.
  • AI & Automation - Champion the adoption of AI-powered analytics, using AI tools to enhance analysis, automate routine activities, uncover deeper insights, and improve productivity, while enabling colleagues to self-serve trusted data and answer business questions independently.
  • Spotting growth opportunities – combine behavioural and marketing data with commercial metrics to size new products, markets, and campaigns, prioritising by impact and effort.

This role is based at our HQ in Tring, Hertfordshire. We operate a hybrid working model, with office days on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays, and the flexibility to work from home on Wednesdays and Fridays.

Title: Business Analyst - Data & Analytics (18 Months FTC)
Description:
Because we strive to put people first.

Culture, our way.

Technology at Primark

What’s a career at Primark all about? The positive impact you’re making, the experiences you’re having and the people you’re with. You’re our inspiration. Embrace what sets you apart, own your career and develop in ways you never expected. Leave your mark. And do it your way.

Our technology team is actively shaping the next wave of advancements, bringing together innovative thinking and technical expertise to drive Primark’s transformation agenda. As a Data & Analytics Business Analyst, you will work across business and technology teams to understand processes, decision-making needs, data flows, and reporting requirements, translating them into clear business requirements that support modern data platforms, customer and trade analytics, improved reporting, and foundational data initiatives, ensuring practical, adoptable, and business-focused outcomes.

What You’ll Do as Business Analyst - Data & Analytics

In your role, you’ll collaborate with different people across a range of skillsets. Here’s a flavour of your day-to-day:


Support Primark’s Data & Analytics Transformation by capturing business requirements, data needs, process dependencies, and adoption considerations to enable a scalable modern data platform and analytics capability.
Drive Customer, Trade & Reporting Insights through engagement with stakeholders across Buying, Merchandising, Marketing, Digital, Retail Operations, and other functions to understand decision-making processes, reporting challenges, and analytics requirements.
Elicit, Analyse & Document Requirements using workshops, interviews, process mapping, and business analysis techniques, translating business needs into user stories, process maps, data flow diagrams, acceptance criteria, and functional documentation.
Assess Current & Future-State Processes by documenting business workflows, decision points, data ownership, reporting dependencies, controls, and change impacts, while helping establish trusted, governed, and usable data across the organisation.
Collaborate Across Delivery Teams by working closely with Project Managers, SMEs, Solution Architects, Data Engineers, Analytics Teams, Data Governance Leads, and Change Managers to prioritise, validate, and deliver business requirements successfully.
Enable Successful Adoption & Delivery through requirements traceability, risk identification, testing and UAT support, business readiness activities, stakeholder engagement, knowledge transfer, and the creation of clear documentation that supports long-term adoption of data, analytics, and reporting solutions.


What You’ll Get

This role is a hybrid opportunity, offering 2-3 days Working from office.

People are at the heart of what we do here, so it’s essential we provide you with the right environment to perform at your very best.

Let’s talk lifestyle: Healthcare, pension, and potential bonus. 27 days of leave, plus bank holidays and if you want, you can buy 5 more. Because Primark is all about tailoring to you, we offer Tax Saver Tickets, fitness centre, and a subsidised cafeteria.

What You’ll Bring

Here at Primark, we want everyone to feel valued – so please bring your authentic self to work, of course with some other key experience and abilities for this role in particular:


Degree qualified or equivalent experience, with 3+ years’ experience as a Business Analyst within data, technology, analytics, or business transformation environments.
Proven ability to gather, analyse, and document business requirements, translating stakeholder needs into clear user stories, functional requirements, process maps, and delivery-ready outputs.
Strong understanding of business processes, decision-making frameworks, data flows, reporting ecosystems, and operational dependencies, with the ability to identify improvements and drive business value.
Experience working on Data & Analytics, Business Intelligence, reporting, data platform, data governance, or enterprise transformation initiatives, supported by knowledge of data ownership, quality, lineage, and integration principles.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the confidence to influence, challenge constructively, and build trusted relationships across business teams, technology functions, delivery partners, and senior leadership.
Analytical, organised, and commercially minded, with experience supporting testing, UAT, business readiness, and change adoption, ideally within retail, customer, merchandising, supply chain, or other fast-paced operational environments.


Does this sound like you? Great, because we can’t wait to see what you’ll bring. You’ll be supported within a team of equally capable people, celebrating who you are and aiding you reach your potential. At Primark, we’re excited about our future - and we’re excited to develop yours.

About Primark

At Primark, people matter. They’re the beating heart of our business and the reason we’ve grown from our first store in Dublin in 1969 to a £9bn+ turnover business and over 80,000 colleagues and over 440 stores in 17 countries today. Our values run through everything we do. In essence, we're Caring and always strive to put people first. We're also Dynamic, bravely pushing the boundaries to stay ahead. And finally, we succeed Together.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Job Description

Do you care about the power of data to support positive, lasting change? Join us as a Senior Data Analyst at Transport for the South East and make a real impact towards a transport system that’s more sustainable, inclusive, and responsive to the needs of the 7.5 million people who live and travel across the region.

Transport for the South East (TfSE) is the sub-national transport body for the South East of England. Our partnership brings together 16 local transport authorities, district and borough councils, and a diverse community of stakeholders from the transport, business, and environmental sectors. East Sussex County Council acts as the host authority for TfSE.

Help TfSE turn data into evidence that shapes decisions for a more sustainable, inclusive and responsive transport system, supporting the 7.5 million people who live and travel across the South East. You'll work with our 2026 Regional Travel Surveys and build direct relationships with our 16 local transport authorities to help improve everyday journeys throughout the region.

As our Senior Data Analyst, you will play an important role in supporting the development of the analytical framework that guides strategic transport planning across the region. Your thoughtful insights will help shape regional transport policy and influence national investment decisions through clear, evidence-based analysis.

In this role, you’ll work with data to create meaningful insights that support informed decision-making and help improve everyday journeys for communities throughout the South East.

In this role, you’ll work with a variety of complex transport and demographic datasets, using tools such as GIS, data visualisation platforms, and statistical software. A key part of your work will involve uncovering insights from our regional travel survey and delivering tailored research projects that support the Transport Strategy and Strategic Investment Plan.

Your success will come from a blend of strong technical skills, strategic understanding, and the ability to communicate complex data in a way that is accessible and engaging for a wide range of audiences.

This is a fixed-term contract until 31 March 2027. Subject to future funding agreements, there may be an opportunity to extend the appointment beyond this date.

We Are Looking For Candidates Who Have


Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex, varied datasets to support decision-making
Technical competence in data analysis and visualisation tools such as advanced Excel, GIS and Power BI
Experience working with large datasets (e.g. from surveys or models), with a high level of accuracy and attention to detail
Knowledge of at least one programming language used in data analysis (e.g. SQL, VBA, Python, R)
The ability to communicate complex data clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences


Please download the Job Description and Person Specification for more information.

To apply for this role, please follow the ‘Apply Now’ button above and upload your CV and a Cover Letter of no more than 2 sides of A4 in length. We will be using your Cover Letter to shortlist so please be sure to address how you meet all the criteria in the person specification, drawing on any relevant work/life experience, education, or personal interests.

For guidance on how to write an application see our how to apply page and our statement on the use of AI .

Interviews will be held in person at County Hall, Lewes, East Sussex, in early September, within two weeks of the closing date. If you are unable to attend the allocated interview date, please let us know, and we may be able to arrange an alternative date.

Candidates who meet certain criteria are given priority when we shortlist. See our priority status page for details.

You'll work with the 2026 Regional Travel Survey, the follow-up to a genuinely successful 2024 survey, giving you a proven, trusted dataset to build on rather than starting from scratch. You'll build direct relationships with our 16 local transport authorities, Department for Transport, National agencies, in a small, high-visibility team where your findings get seen and used rather than lost in a large organisation.

We offer a diverse range of benefits to help and support you during your employment. More information can be found on our benefits page .

Vocational Training through Apprenticeships is now available to our staff, ranging from entry level to degree level qualifications. You can talk to the hiring manager and the apprenticeship team about what qualifications would be relevant to you and this job role, and if it is possible to support you in apprenticeship training .

For an informal discussion about this opportunity contact Joshua Jiao, analysis manager at Joshua.Jiao@transportforthesoutheast.org.uk to request a MS teams call or phone call.

For work that makes a difference, choose East Sussex!

I’ve worked with the council for over 10 years, and I stay here because I find it really rewarding. I know that I’m making a difference. Joe, Information Analyst

About Us

Additional Information

Your starting salary will be pro rata if the above position is part-time or term-time only.

If you require sponsorship to work in the UK please let the hiring manager know this in your application so we can check eligibility for sponsorship for the role. For further information please go to Work in the UK - GOV.UK (www.gov.uk) .

If you require any reasonable adjustments, due to disability, to enable you to participate fully in the process please contact the hiring manager on the contact details above.

Title: Pricing Analyst
Description:
An amazing opportunity to work for one of the worlds leading brands within the Automotive industry , my client are looking for a pricing analyst to join their high performing sales and marketing teams ,




You will be required at their offices close to Windsor 1 day per week .




This is an exciting opportunity for a highly analytical individual who enjoys translating complex data into actionable commercial insights. You'll work closely with Sales, Marketing and Business Intelligence teams, providing recommendations that directly influence pricing decisions and business performance




Professional qualification or degree in Business, Marketing, Economics, Finance, Data Analytics or a related discipline.
Experience in a Pricing Analyst, Commercial Analyst, Revenue Analyst or similar analytical role.
Knowledge of Power BI, KNIME or similar business intelligence and analytical tools.
Experience working within FMCG, automotive, retail or distribution environments.
