Title: Commercial Analyst
Description:
ABOUT THE COMPANY:

OAG is the essential intelligence partner transforming global travel. For nearly a century we've been the foundation the travel industry builds on: trusted, proven, essential. Today, we're going beyond.

We combine unmatched data quality, quantity and access with breakthrough technology and deep industry expertise to deliver what the industry truly needs: not just more data, but better answers. From real-time operational intelligence to strategic decision-making, we power the entire travel ecosystem, from airlines and airports to technology companies and financial institutions. And we're embedding AI throughout our intelligence layer, pairing decades of proprietary data with the latest technology to deliver answers that weren't possible before.

Travel moves the world, and we move travel. For more information visit www.oag.com

ABOUT THE ROLE:

The Commercial Analyst sits within OAG’s Strategic Analysis and Commercial Data Integrity function, reporting to the Senior Manager, Strategic Analysis. This is a hands-on individual contributor role for someone who genuinely enjoys the craft: building the models, running the numbers, querying the data and telling the story that comes out the other side. Working at the intersection of Commercial and FP&A, you will support the analysis behind some of the most important commercial decisions OAG makes, from commissions execution and territory planning to white space identification and conversion analysis. The function is also being rebuilt to be AI-first from the ground up, and you will play an active part in that build, helping reimagine how analytical work gets done: faster, automated where possible and AI-enabled wherever it adds value.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING:


Support the analytical work behind commissions execution: the calculations, validation and reconciliation that keep commissions reliable cycle after cycle.
Contribute to territory planning and white space analysis, helping quantify the opportunity in each region and identify under-penetrated accounts and segments.
Run conversion analysis across the funnel: lead to opportunity, opportunity to close, sales cycle dynamics and the drivers behind each transition.
Produce account, segment and regional analysis that supports pricing decisions, packaging design and commercial strategy.
Ensure Commercial and FP&A read from the same numbers, aligning definitions, source data and calculations for core metrics such as pipeline, bookings, ACV, conversion rate and win rate.
Support FP&A colleagues on commission modelling, capacity planning and commercial scenario analysis.
Help reimagine recurring analytical processes, identifying what can be automated, what can be AI-enabled and what should be redesigned entirely.
Build the tooling, dashboards and workflows that make analysis faster and more reliable across Salesforce data, revenue data and Snowflake transaction data.
Contribute to the analytical models behind ExCo and board conversations, and help shape standards and ways of working as the function grows.




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:


A solid analytical background, with experience in commercial analytics, revenue analytics or sales operations analysis, ideally gained in a B2B SaaS, data or intelligence-platform environment.
Genuine curiosity and capability with AI tooling for analysts: comfortable using LLMs for query generation, narrative drafting and analytical exploration, and willing to push the boundary of what AI can do in an analyst workflow.
Practical, hands on fluency with the modern data stack: SQL and Salesforce data fluency are essential, along with BI tooling such as Tableau, Power BI or Looker for production quality dashboarding.
Good commercial instincts, and a genuine interest in what a sales motion is, what conversion rates and AOV mean for the business, and why commission design matters.
Experience working alongside or within an FP&A function, with a practical grasp of how commercial and financial views of the business connect.
Excellent communication: able to turn complex analysis into a clear, well-framed story that senior commercial and finance audiences can act on.
A high standard for data integrity: the instinct to question numbers that don’t reconcile, and the discipline to fix root causes rather than work around symptoms.
A hands-on builder’s mentality: someone who enjoys building the models, dashboards, automations and workflows, and isn’t allergic to detail.




IF YOU HAVE THE FOLLOWING THAT WOULD BE GREAT:


Direct experience in or close to the aviation, travel or transport intelligence industry.
Snowflake or equivalent cloud data platform experience, or familiarity with Python or R for analytical work, modelling and automation beyond what SQL and BI tools can do.
Familiarity with commission design and incentive modelling in a multi-region sales organisation.
Exposure to a fast-growth or private-equity-backed environment, or a background that bridges commercial analytics with finance, marketing or product analytics.


If you don’t meet every requirement but feel excited about this role, we’d still love to hear from you.

WE WILL OFFER YOU:

💡 You will proactively explore and adopt AI tools and automation in your day-to-day work, keeping the customer at the centre of everything you do. You will share learnings with your team and approach new technologies with curiosity and an open mind. At OAG, finding better ways to work and putting customers first is everyone's responsibility.

🚀 Real responsibility on hard problems, with the autonomy to own decisions and act on them, in an open culture built on trust.

🏡 Flexible working arrangements that allow a mixture of office and home working

💰 An attractive compensation and benefits package, including private health insurance, a company bonus scheme and enhanced pension scheme

🏖️ 25 days holiday plus bank holidays, and a day off during your birthday month

⚡ Octopus EV salary sacrifice scheme

🌍 Work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 1 month per year

📚 Annual learning and development budget.

OAG is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and able to perform at their best.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and experiences. If you require reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know, we’re happy to have an open conversation about how we can support you.

Title: Business Systems Enablement Lead
Description:
At ActiveOps, we believe the ability to make every decision – the right decision, at the right time, will transform operations. Our blend of AI and human intelligence delivers the most complete and useful set of predictive and prescriptive insight to help service operations make better decisions - faster.




Role purpose

Ensure every function across the ActiveOps customer lifecycle has accurate data, trusted content, and clear standards to do their job well.

This role is the interface between the team who builds and maintains our CRM and knowledge management systems, and the business functions that use these services. It is the single point of contact for data, reporting, and collateral requests, and the first line of triage for system support. It works with data and content owners from the business functions to ensure quality and accessibility of information.




Skills and qualifications

Must have

Experience working within a CRM environment with enough system literacy to distinguish a data problem from a configuration issue
Strong data analysis and quality skills, comfortable with large datasets and
Experience building or maintaining reporting dashboards
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, flexibility to work globally and collaborate across a variety of business functions
Highly organised with the ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously
Self-starter who takes ownership and follows through without close supervision

Desirable

Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365, SharePoint, or a comparable CRM/ERP platform
Familiarity with knowledge management principles or content governance
Background in a CRM analyst, business analyst, or operations analyst role




Role responsibilities

Data quality/governance for CRM and knowledge management systems

Own data quality and integrity across the customer lifecycle in Microsoft Dynamics (MSD)
Define and maintain shared data standards and definitions across all functions
Monitor adherence to standards and escalate exceptions to functional data owners without taking on their ownership
Support data completion following system changes by agreeing correction plans with functions, maintaining oversight and escalating where needed
Maintain data lineage documentation across systems
Work with Data Engineering to ensure MSD data is accurately represented in Databricks and other reporting platforms




CRM Reporting and dashboards

Build and maintain MSD-native dashboards in Dynamics covering function and region-specific reporting
Establish and maintain reporting standards for all MSD-native dashboards across regions and functions
Act as first point of contact for all reporting requests, handling MSD-native requests directly and redirecting AO-wide requests to Data Engineering
Investigate and resolve reporting anomalies, working with the Business Systems Lead where system changes are needed




Knowledge management and collateral

Manage the content lifecycle for all ActiveOps trusted content across all functions, ensuring materials are correctly located, permissioned, and archived
Coordinate content review and approval with functional owners to keep materials current and trusted
Manage access and permissions for the knowledge management platform and MSD, including external users such as partners, coaches, and contractors
Own the collateral lifecycle for customer-facing materials across all functions without owning content creation
Develop, maintain and communicate document management standards to ensure the business understands how knowledge should be stored and shared




CRM integrations

Maintain visibility of all systems and tools that touch or integrate with MSD, ensuring integrations are documented and gaps are flagged
Act as the relationship owner between Business Systems and Data Engineering




Enablement and liaison

Act as single point of contact for all data, reporting, and collateral requests across the customer lifecycle
Capture and translate business requirements for system or data changes into clear specifications for the Business Systems Lead without directly configuring Dynamics
Train and enable teams on data standards, reporting tools, and lifecycle processes to build self-sufficiency
Gather and triage feedback on data, content, and system gaps, feeding into the Business Systems roadmap




Support and intake

Triage incoming support requests, resolving data and content issues directly or escalating configuration issues to the Business Systems Lead
Classify all requests and manage the review process accordingly
Maintain the Business Systems intake log, keeping all requests visible, prioritised, and communicated back to the requester
Responsible for communicating change to all affected functions clearly and promptly

Title: Pricing Analyst
Description:
About Pikl

Pikl is on a mission to enable the growth of digital marketplaces, starting with vacation rentals. We design and deliver insurance-enabled solutions that help platforms, property managers and owners unlock new revenue and deliver better customer experiences.




Founded in 2016, we began by protecting individual hosts and homeowners with specialist holiday-let cover. That experience now powers our insurance-enabled products, which increase participation, lift conversion and drive revenue across the marketplace value chain: platforms, homeowners and guests.




With offices in Norwich and London, and plans for international expansion, we work with some of the most recognised brands in travel as well as major insurance aggregators.




About the Role

Supporting the Pricing and Underwriting team in the delivery of pricing activity across Pikl's insurance products and partnerships. The role is responsible for pricing analysis, portfolio monitoring and supporting the development of pricing models to ensure sustainable and profitable growth.




Working collaboratively with Underwriting, Product, Claims and Partnership teams to understand performance drivers, identify opportunities and support pricing decision making. Supporting the pricing of new schemes and products, ongoing portfolio management and the continued development of pricing capability across the business.




Key Responsibilities

Support the development, maintenance and enhancement of pricing models across Pikl products.
Conduct pricing and portfolio analysis to identify trends, opportunities and areas of concern.
Monitor product and portfolio performance, including premium adequacy, loss ratios, rating performance and profitability.
Support the pricing of new products, schemes and partnership opportunities.
Produce pricing analyses, reports and recommendations to support business decision making.
Work closely with Underwriting, Claims, Product and Partnerships teams to understand portfolio performance and drivers of risk.
Support the ongoing monitoring and validation of pricing models and rating structures.
Contribute to the assessment and integration of internal and external data sources.
Undertake competitor and market analysis to support pricing recommendations.
Support the development of pricing processes, tools and reporting capabilities.
Ensure pricing activity complies with regulatory requirements and fair value principles.
Be a source of pricing and pricing delivery support within the business.




About You:

Experience in an insurance pricing, pricing support, actuarial or pricing-related analytical role.
Experience using data to support pricing decisions and business recommendations.
Strong Excel skills.
Experience of analysing large datasets and identifying trends and insights.
Ability to interpret data and translate findings into practical recommendations.
Good communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
Ability to manage competing priorities and work effectively within a fast-paced environment.
Collaborative approach with the ability to build relationships across teams.
Progress towards a professional qualification (e.g. IFoA) or interest in pursuing further professional development.
Experience within General Insurance pricing.
Experience using SQL for data extraction and analysis.
Experience using Python, R or similar analytical tools.
Experience using pricing software such as Radar or Earnix.
Understanding of insurance pricing concepts and portfolio performance metrics.
Exposure to predictive modelling, machine learning or statistical modelling techniques.
Experience working within an MGA, delegated authority or capacity-backed environment is desirable.




Our Values

At Pikl, our values are the foundation on which our success is built. They guide how we work together, how we make decisions for customers and colleagues, and what we recognise and reward.




Possibility

We think big and are fearless in turning challenges into opportunities. We stay curious, test ideas and learn quickly.




People

We put people first, building relationships rooted in empathy and trust. We respect, include, and learn from one another. We celebrate progress.




Progress

We unlock growth opportunities for our customers and each other yet make it our personal responsibility to own actions and see them through.




Why work at Pikl

Hybrid & Flexible working set up
Access to an incredible working space in Norwich and London
Annual leave entitlement of 28 days, plus bank holidays
35 hour working week
Employee Assistant Program with 24/7 GP support and wellbeing services for you and your immediate family
10% discount with Sykes Cottages
Training and development opportunities
Social events
Support from an awarding-winning CEO & Founder

Title: Space Data Analyst
Description:
About Us

It’s an exciting time to join London South Bank University (LSBU) Group. With the launch of our new LSBU Group Strategy, Connecting, we’re shaping the future of tertiary education for a global, technology-driven economy – rooted in London.

Professional and technical education has been central to LSBU Group’s mission since our founding in 1892. Today, as London’s first integrated tertiary education group, we continue to lead the way on learner-centred, skills-focused education.

Comprising London South Bank University, South Bank Colleges and South Bank Academies, connectivity lies at the heart of all we do.

Since 2019, LSBU Group has grown beyond its three founding institutions to form a powerful network of learners, staff, alumni, employers and policymakers – united in our mission: to challenge social and economic inequalities through applied education, insight and partnership .

We are a powerhouse for inclusive education, enterprise and economic growth, connecting potential to opportunity and enabling people to thrive. Our Group network enables us to create learning pathways and connect people and organisations. This ensures learners are supported through the education system to achieve their full potential and can contribute their skills and energies locally and to wider society.

Our new strategy, Connecting , sets out a bold, ambitious vision for LSBU Group and it’s developed in collaboration with colleagues, student groups, partners and stakeholders.

Focused on delivering good jobs for all our learners, we are proud to be employer and skills led, delivering excellent professional and technical teaching which supports future talent and careers to deliver impact for London and beyond.

Working for us

Turning passion into purpose

Our ambition is to create educational pathways that empower people of all backgrounds and talents to realise their aspirations, add to the knowledge base, and contribute their skills and drive to wider society.

To realise our ambition, we need people with energy, courage and imagination, who are enthused by our vision and recognise our values as theirs; people who bring ideas to enrich our approach to learning, research and innovation; collaborative people who love creating and spreading knowledge; brilliant people who seek growth and yearn to make a positive, personal difference.

At LSBU Group, you will get to contribute to a vibrant and dynamic culture, which is fuelled by purpose, built around people, and is genuinely diverse. You will be trusted and recognised for your unique contribution.

You will be part of a great team, turning your passion into purpose.

The role

The Space Data Analyst will form a key part of the Space & Workplace Team within the LSBU Group as they assume responsibility for the collection, validation and analysis of a wide range of data relating to the estate portfolio. The data will range from campus level information, individual space information, timetabling data, access control data and more.

The post holder will work closely with the wider Space & Workplace Team to support feasibility assessments of future projects, provide an evidence-based view to aid strategic decisions and make recommendations on how to achieve greater utilisation of space across the LSBU Group estate portfolio.

In addition, the Space Data Analyst will be responsible for the management of the Integrated Workplace Management System (IWMS) and the data within. The role will require that the data within is audited on a cyclical basis to ensure validity, updated when necessary and system reports are written to allow for efficient reporting of regular requests.

What You Will Bring


Have experience of working with property, estates, workplace or space-related data, with a strong focus on accuracy and data quality.
Be confident analysing data from multiple sources to identify trends, explain performance and support evidence-based decisions.
Have experience of using property data systems, ideally an Integrated Workplace Management System (IWMS).
Be able to create clear, accessible dashboards and reports using tools such as Excel, Power BI, Tableau or equivalent.
Communicate complex data and insights clearly to colleagues and stakeholders at all levels.
Be methodical, curious and collaborative, with the ability to manage priorities and continuously improve data and reporting processes.


Benefits and How to Apply:

As a leading Higher Education Institution LSBU offers staff a highly competitive benefits package including holiday entitlement starting at 26.5 days per annum, professional development opportunities and flexible working. Full details on the range of benefits we offer can be found here.

The person specification for this role alongside applicant guidance on what to submit within your application can be found within the candidate pack attached. Applications must be submitted via the &slshquot;Apply Online&slshquot; button below.

For an informal conversation ahead of applying please feel free to contact the hiring manager for this position,Head of Space and Workforce Transformation, Scott Standen - scott.standen@lsbu.ac.uk

The closing date for applications is Sunday 23rd August 23.59 pm

Interview/assessment - week commencing 7th September 2026

We are happy to talk flexible working and reasonable adjustments and aim to make our recruitment and selection process accessible to all, please contact us to discuss any support you need. The diversity of LSBU’s staff and students is a source of our strength and the richness of ideas and perspectives that this diversity brings makes LSBU a unique place to work.

Depending on your circumstances, this role may be eligible for sponsorship under the UKVI Skilled Worker route, more details on this can be found within the candidate pack.

If you have any questions related to your application, please email the recruitment team hrdsr@lsbu.ac.uk

We reserve the right to close the vacancy early, should we receive sufficient applications.

Title: Data Analyst – Fund Management
Description:
Data Analyst – Fund Management | London | Competitive + Bonus




SQL | Python | Data Visualisation (Power BI / Tableau) | Data Warehousing (Snowflake / Databricks)




Our client, a leading US private markets fund manager, is looking for a Data Analyst to join its London office and play a central role in building modern data and analytics capability across the business. This is a hands-on technical role where your SQL, Python, data visualisation, and cloud data warehousing skills will be used daily — and developed further.




The role:

Sitting at the intersection of the commercial business and technology, you'll design and deliver the data infrastructure, analytics, and reporting that drive client-facing and sales decision-making. Day to day you will:

Write and optimise SQL against a Snowflake cloud data warehouse, working across multiple source systems (CRM, sales, client, product, and flows data)
Use Python for analysis, automation of data retrieval and transformation, and prototyping new solutions
Build and maintain polished, well-governed dashboards and data models in Power BI / Tableau that give stakeholders genuine decision-grade insight
Support the development of scalable data pipelines and infrastructure, helping move the business beyond static reporting into automated, workflow-embedded intelligence
Identify and remediate data quality issues, championing governance, consistency, and structured data classification
Partner with sales, client-facing, and technology teams — translating commercial problems into practical data solutions and explaining technical concepts to non-technical audiences




The role requires:

Strong SQL — confident querying, joining, and modelling data, ideally in a cloud platform such as Snowflake (or Databricks/similar)
Working knowledge of Python for analytics and automation
Hands-on data visualisation experience with Power BI or Tableau, including data modelling and building scalable, performant datasets
Data warehousing experience — understanding of pipeline design, transformation, and working across multiple source systems
Experience gained as a Data Analyst or in a similar analytical role; backgrounds ranging from a few years' experience through to established analysts will be considered
Financial services / asset management exposure is a plus, not a prerequisite — as is any experience with AI-assisted analytics or ML use cases
A proactive, curious mindset with strong communication skills and attention to detail
Degree in a quantitative field (Data Science, Computer Science, Business Analytics or similar) preferred




What's on offer:

Hybrid working, generous holiday, strong health and wellbeing benefits, paid volunteering, professional development and qualification support, and genuine scope to shape how data, analytics, and AI are used across a growing function.

Title: Product BI & Ops Analyst
Description:
About Beamery

With the rapid expansion of AI and automation, the future of work has never been more challenging for organizations. Beamery’s unique jobs, skills and tasks data platform helps organizations navigate these challenges and make more informed decisions across Talent Lifecycle Management. Our solutions power recruitment, mobility, upskilling, diversity, work architecture and workforce planning for some of the world’s most forward-thinking companies.

We believe that where you work is much more than just a job. Millions of people are being left behind every day in their careers, and we’re on a mission to fix this by creating equal access to meaningful work, skills and careers for all.

We are an equal opportunity employer committed to building a representative Beamery, creating an equitable, inclusive and engaging environment for our people.

So, what are you waiting for? Join us and help us transform the future of work once and for all.

What’s ahead — and why it’s an exciting time to join the team:

Deepening our native integrations with SAP, Workday, Microsoft, and LinkedIn to seamlessly embed our skills intelligence into the platforms where critical workforce decisions are made.

Embedding our agentic AI to help customers plan smarter for the future—powering workforce strategies, internal mobility, and skills forecasting.

Advancing our use of proprietary LLMs and knowledge graph technology to help organizations unlock broader talent pools, make fairer decisions, and expand access to opportunity at scale.

But it’s not all about creating high-quality products, we also very much value the company culture we have worked hard to create; built on trust, empathy & honesty ensuring our workforce is able to bring their full selves to work.

Responsibilities


Build and maintain reporting that product managers, engineering leads, and the exec team actually use to tell stories and make decisions. This includes recurring dashboards in Hex as well as one-off analyses in response to specific product questions.
Partner directly with PMs across the portfolio (Talent CRM, Work Architecture, Work Intelligence) to answer product questions such as usage, adoption, retention, feature performance, conversion through key flows.
Maintain the product analytics tool stack (incl. Pendo, and Hex). Make sure they're configured well, integrated properly, and that PMs and designers can get to the answers they need without always going through you.
Enable PMs to self-serve. Build the dashboards, templates, and documentation that mean routine questions don't need an analyst in the loop. Your job is to make yourself unnecessary for the easy stuff so you can focus on the hard stuff.
Design and iterate AI agent workflows to automate prospecting, outreach, lead qualification, and follow-up
Leverage LLM-powered tools to build scalable, autonomous product ops processes (e.g. customer and market feedback ops, roadmap and planning, process and governance, internal communication and team enablement)
Instrument agents with feedback loops and quality controls
Evaluate emerging AI tooling and document agent architectures so workflows are reproducible and maintainable


What We're Looking For


Strong SQL. You'll be writing it daily, against messy real-world data, and you should be comfortable doing so as a stand-alone SME.
A track record in product analytics, ideally in a B2B SaaS environment, ideally somewhere with multiple products or a reasonably complex data model.
Hands-on experience with Pendo or a comparable product analytics tool (Amplitude, Mixpanel, Heap), and with a SQL-based exploration tool like Hex, Mode, or similar.
You can tell a clear story with data such as building a dashboard that doesn't need a tour, or present a finding to a PM or a VP with strong clarity and focus.
Pragmatism. Beamery's data isn't pristine. We need someone who can make progress in a real environment in the face of imperfect conditions.
Hands-on experience building AI/LLM-powered automation workflows - either in a business or personal context


Nice to have


Experience analysing AI/ML-powered product features.
Exposure to HR tech, talent acquisition, or workforce data.


Beamery is for Everybody. Diversity and open expression are fundamental to us. We acknowledge the challenges in our industry and strive to develop an inclusive culture where everybody can contribute. We are dedicated to creating an inclusive environment for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, religion, color, sexual orientation, gender identity, race, national origin, age, disability status, or caregiver status. Title: Data Analyst | Risk
Description:
About Marex

Marex Group plc (NASDAQ: MRX) is a diversified global financial services platform providing essential liquidity, market access and infrastructure services to clients across energy, commodities and financial markets. The group provides comprehensive breadth and depth of coverage across four core services: clearing, agency and execution, market making, and hedging and investment solutions. It has a leading franchise in many major metals, energy and agricultural products, with access to 60 exchanges. The group provides access to the world’s major commodity markets, covering a broad range of clients that include some of the largest commodity producers, consumers and traders, banks, hedge funds and asset managers. With more than 40 offices worldwide, the group has over 3,000 employees across Europe, Asia and the Americas.

For more information visit https://www.marex.com/

Role: VN3022

Department Description

Marex has unique access across markets with significant share globally both on and off exchange. The depth of knowledge amongst its teams and divisions provides its customers with clear advantage, and its technology-led service provides access to all major exchanges, order-flow management via screen, voice and DMA, plus award-winning data, insights, and analytics.

The Technology Department delivers differentiation, scalability, and security for the business. Reporting to the CTO, Technology provides digital tools, software services and infrastructure globally to all business groups. Software development and support teams work in agile ‘streams’ aligned to specific business areas. Our other teams work enterprise-wide to provide critical services including our global service desk, network and system infrastructure, IT operations, security, enterprise architecture and design.

The IT Group runs our enterprise-wide services to end users and actively manages the firm’s infrastructure and data. Within IT, Marex Technology has established a Data team that enables the firm to leverage data to increase productivity and improve business decisions, as well as maintain data compliance. The Data team encompasses Data Analysis, Data Architecture, and Data Intelligence. In recent years, they have developed a Data Lakehouse architecture that is relied upon by different departments across the firm. Marex now seeks to strengthen its capabilities further and elevate the role of data in the operating models of Marex's businesses, directed by a strategy that aims to:

Decentralise access for discovering and consuming data. Empower the data-savvy, entrepreneurial business leaders and citizen developers with the tools to interrogate data sets to explore and unlock opportunities for new or data-driven products and services.

Provide a market-beating digital experience for clients by providing greater insight into their own data.

Build communities of practice around data management. Increase awareness and raise the profile of the data-driven opportunities for the firm.

Ensure that the capabilities and tools of the Data Intelligence team infuse with the goals and operating models of each business within the firm.

Ensure paid-for data is used efficiently, in a manner that aligns with our commercial agreements, and that such usage can be audited with any associated costs fairly attributed across data beneficiaries.

Role Summary

As a Risk Data Analyst within the Data team, you will work closely with the Risk function to support effective, data-led risk management, oversight, monitoring and reporting across Marex.

You will act as a bridge between Risk and Technology for all things data, cultivating relationships with data creators, data owners and data consumers and helping to ensure that critical risk data assets are properly defined, governed and maintained within a central data catalogue.

Through your work you will develop a deep understanding of risk data, dataflows, controls and reporting processes across risk disciplines such as market risk, credit and counterparty risk, operational risk, risk governance and regional risk controls. You will help identify datasets for ingestion into Marex’s Data Platform and will work closely with other members of the Data Team to ensure data is efficiently ingested, correctly modelled, validated and made available for downstream risk reporting, analysis, governance and decision-making. You will also support data-related requirements gathering for Technology project work related to Risk.

Responsibilities

Role specific:


Identify and analyse structured and unstructured data within the Risk function, including data used for risk measurement, monitoring, controls, governance, regulatory reporting and management information. Document how it relates to other datasets, how it flows through the organisation, how it is stored, how it is controlled and how it is used by Risk stakeholders.
Identify risk datasets for ingestion into Marex’s Data Platform and work closely with other members of the Data Team to ensure data is efficiently ingested, correctly modelled and fit for use in risk analytics, dashboards, governance packs and control reporting.
Identify and cultivate relationships with key data creators, data owners and data consumers.
Ensure key risk data assets, definitions, ownership, lineage, quality rules and usage are properly documented and maintained within a central data catalogue.
Work with Risk, Technology and other control functions to identify, investigate and resolve data issues that could impact risk reporting, risk monitoring, escalation, governance or regulatory obligations.
Perform and automate data validation, reconciliation and exception reporting to improve the accuracy, completeness and timeliness of risk data and management information.
Support the design, development and maintenance of Power BI reports, dashboards and analytical models used by Risk stakeholders to monitor exposures, limits, trends, exceptions, emerging risks and control performance.
Translate Risk business requirements into clear data requirements, including source-to-target mappings, reporting logic, business definitions, data quality checks and acceptance criteria.
Develop and maintain procedures, workflows and documentation relating to risk data management, reporting controls, data lineage and issue remediation.
Contribute to risk governance forums, change initiatives and strategic projects by providing data analysis, reporting insight and evidence-based challenge where required.


All staff:


Ensuring compliance with the company’s regulatory requirements under the FCA, NFA, AMF, AFM, MAS.
Adhere to the operational risk framework for your role ensuring that all regulatory or company determined parameters are complied with.
Role model for demonstrating highest level standards of integrity and conduct and reflecting Company Values.
At all times complying with the FCA’s Code of Conduct
To ensure that you are fully aware of and adhere to internal policies that relate to you, your role or any other activities for which you have any level of responsibility
To report any breaches of policy to Compliance and/ or your supervisor as required
To escalate risk events immediately
To provide input to risk management processes, as required.


Competencies, Skills, Experience & Qualifications:

Skills and Experience:


Experience of working in a data, analytics, reporting or risk-related role aligned to or within a Risk function in the Financial Services sector.
Data modelling, cleansing and enrichment, with experience in conceptual, logical and physical data modelling for analytical, control or reporting use cases.
Familiarity with data warehouses, lakehouse platforms and analytical data structures used to support reporting, monitoring and decision-making.
Experience of data quality assurance, validation, reconciliation, lineage and control documentation.
Knowledge of software development methodologies (Sprints/Agile) and project management software (Jira).
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain data issues and insights clearly to both technical and non-technical Risk stakeholders.
Experience working in a regulated environment and an understanding of the risk and compliance requirements associated with financial services.
Ability to work with stakeholders across Risk, Technology, Finance, Operations and Compliance to agree definitions, resolve data issues and improve reporting processes.


Technical:


Relational, dimensional and analytical data modelling, including structures suitable for risk MI, exposure monitoring and control reporting.
Familiarity with SQL Server, Databricks SQL and other database technologies used to query, transform and validate risk data.
Advanced SQL scripting, including joins, aggregations, reconciliation logic, exception identification and performance-aware query design.
Familiarity with ETL/ELT tools and experience navigating data pipelines, orchestration processes and source-to-report dataflows.
Strong Power BI capability, including data modelling, DAX, report design, dashboard development and governance of recurring management information.
Experience using scripting languages such as Python or PowerShell to automate data extraction, validation, reconciliation and reporting processes.
Familiarity with Git or other source control software.


Desirable:


Knowledge of risk management concepts, including market risk, credit and counterparty risk, operational risk, risk appetite, limits, controls, governance, stress testing and regulatory reporting.
Understanding of capital markets products, trading lifecycle data, risk exposure measures, P&L drivers, client and counterparty data, and the data dependencies that support effective risk oversight.


Competencies:


An analytical problem solver, expert in spotting patterns and inferring connections in data.
A collaborative team player, approachable, self-efficient and influences a positive work environment.
Demonstrates curiosity.
Resilient in a challenging, fast-paced environment.
Excels at building relationships, networking and influencing others.
Strategic collaborator with insight and agility, able to anticipate future challenges, ensuring operational effectiveness.


Conduct Rules, You must:


Act with integrity
Act with due skill, care and diligence
Be open and cooperative with the FCA, the PRA and other regulators
Pay due regard to the interests of customers and treat them fairly
Observe proper standard of market conduct
Act to deliver good outcomes for retail customers


Company Values

Be collaborative - by working together across the organisation, we foster teamwork, can better respond to challenges and successfully deliver for our clients

Act with integrity - we pride ourselves on our honesty and high ethical standards. We apply these values when working with all our clients, colleagues and other stakeholders

Be adaptable and entrepreneurial - we embrace change as markets evolve to constantly increase our efficiency and create innovative solutions for our clients. We are interested in the world around us and inquisitive about understanding the challenges and opportunities our clients face.

Be respectful – how we treat each other, and our clients says everything about who we are. We always act respectfully and treat people fairly in everything we do.

Nurture talent – we aim to grow our own talent and make Marex the place ambitious, hardworking and talented people choose to build their career. This means giving and taking stretch opportunities, taking risks, and committing to career development and support – for ourselves, and our teams.

Marex is fully committed to being an inclusive employer and providing an inclusive and accessible recruitment process for all. We will provide reasonable adjustments to remove any disadvantage to you being considered for this role. We value the differences that a diverse workforce brings to the company. We welcome applications from candidates returning to the workforce. Also, Marex is committed to avoiding circumstances in which the appearance or possibility of conflicts of interest may exist within the hiring process.

If you would like to receive any information in a different way or would like us to do anything differently to help you, please include it in your application.

Role: VN3022

Department Description

Marex has unique access across markets with significant share globally both on and off exchange. The depth of knowledge amongst its teams and divisions provides its customers with clear advantage, and its technology-led service provides access to all major exchanges, order-flow management via screen, voice and DMA, plus award-winning data, insights, and analytics.

The Technology Department delivers differentiation, scalability, and security for the business. Reporting to the CTO, Technology provides digital tools, software services and infrastructure globally to all business groups. Software development and support teams work in agile ‘streams’ aligned to specific business areas. Our other teams work enterprise-wide to provide critical services including our global service desk, network and system infrastructure, IT operations, security, enterprise architecture and design.

The IT Group runs our enterprise-wide services to end users and actively manages the firm’s infrastructure and data. Within IT, Marex Technology has established a Data team that enables the firm to leverage data to increase productivity and improve business decisions, as well as maintain data compliance. The Data team encompasses Data Analysis, Data Architecture, and Data Intelligence. In recent years, they have developed a Data Lakehouse architecture that is relied upon by different departments across the firm. Marex now seeks to strengthen its capabilities further and elevate the role of data in the operating models of Marex's businesses, directed by a strategy that aims to:

Decentralise access for discovering and consuming data. Empower the data-savvy, entrepreneurial business leaders and citizen developers with the tools to interrogate data sets to explore and unlock opportunities for new or data-driven products and services.

Provide a market-beating digital experience for clients by providing greater insight into their own data.

Build communities of practice around data management. Increase awareness and raise the profile of the data-driven opportunities for the firm.

Ensure that the capabilities and tools of the Data Intelligence team infuse with the goals and operating models of each business within the firm.

Ensure paid-for data is used efficiently, in a manner that aligns with our commercial agreements, and that such usage can be audited with any associated costs fairly attributed across data beneficiaries.

Role Summary

As a Risk Data Analyst within the Data team, you will work closely with the Risk function to support effective, data-led risk management, oversight, monitoring and reporting across Marex.

You will act as a bridge between Risk and Technology for all things data, cultivating relationships with data creators, data owners and data consumers and helping to ensure that critical risk data assets are properly defined, governed and maintained within a central data catalogue.

Through your work you will develop a deep understanding of risk data, dataflows, controls and reporting processes across risk disciplines such as market risk, credit and counterparty risk, operational risk, risk governance and regional risk controls. You will help identify datasets for ingestion into Marex’s Data Platform and will work closely with other members of the Data Team to ensure data is efficiently ingested, correctly modelled, validated and made available for downstream risk reporting, analysis, governance and decision-making. You will also support data-related requirements gathering for Technology project work related to Risk.

Responsibilities

Role specific:

  • Identify and analyse structured and unstructured data within the Risk function, including data used for risk measurement, monitoring, controls, governance, regulatory reporting and management information. Document how it relates to other datasets, how it flows through the organisation, how it is stored, how it is controlled and how it is used by Risk stakeholders.
  • Identify risk datasets for ingestion into Marex’s Data Platform and work closely with other members of the Data Team to ensure data is efficiently ingested, correctly modelled and fit for use in risk analytics, dashboards, governance packs and control reporting.
  • Identify and cultivate relationships with key data creators, data owners and data consumers.
  • Ensure key risk data assets, definitions, ownership, lineage, quality rules and usage are properly documented and maintained within a central data catalogue.
  • Work with Risk, Technology and other control functions to identify, investigate and resolve data issues that could impact risk reporting, risk monitoring, escalation, governance or regulatory obligations.
  • Perform and automate data validation, reconciliation and exception reporting to improve the accuracy, completeness and timeliness of risk data and management information.
  • Support the design, development and maintenance of Power BI reports, dashboards and analytical models used by Risk stakeholders to monitor exposures, limits, trends, exceptions, emerging risks and control performance.
  • Translate Risk business requirements into clear data requirements, including source-to-target mappings, reporting logic, business definitions, data quality checks and acceptance criteria.
  • Develop and maintain procedures, workflows and documentation relating to risk data management, reporting controls, data lineage and issue remediation.
  • Contribute to risk governance forums, change initiatives and strategic projects by providing data analysis, reporting insight and evidence-based challenge where required.

All staff:

  • Ensuring compliance with the company’s regulatory requirements under the FCA, NFA, AMF, AFM, MAS.
  • Adhere to the operational risk framework for your role ensuring that all regulatory or company determined parameters are complied with.
  • Role model for demonstrating highest level standards of integrity and conduct and reflecting Company Values.
  • At all times complying with the FCA’s Code of Conduct
  • To ensure that you are fully aware of and adhere to internal policies that relate to you, your role or any other activities for which you have any level of responsibility
  • To report any breaches of policy to Compliance and/ or your supervisor as required
  • To escalate risk events immediately
  • To provide input to risk management processes, as required.

Competencies, Skills, Experience & Qualifications:

Skills and Experience:

  • Experience of working in a data, analytics, reporting or risk-related role aligned to or within a Risk function in the Financial Services sector.
  • Data modelling, cleansing and enrichment, with experience in conceptual, logical and physical data modelling for analytical, control or reporting use cases.
  • Familiarity with data warehouses, lakehouse platforms and analytical data structures used to support reporting, monitoring and decision-making.
  • Experience of data quality assurance, validation, reconciliation, lineage and control documentation.
  • Knowledge of software development methodologies (Sprints/Agile) and project management software (Jira).
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain data issues and insights clearly to both technical and non-technical Risk stakeholders.
  • Experience working in a regulated environment and an understanding of the risk and compliance requirements associated with financial services.
  • Ability to work with stakeholders across Risk, Technology, Finance, Operations and Compliance to agree definitions, resolve data issues and improve reporting processes.

Technical:

  • Relational, dimensional and analytical data modelling, including structures suitable for risk MI, exposure monitoring and control reporting.
  • Familiarity with SQL Server, Databricks SQL and other database technologies used to query, transform and validate risk data.
  • Advanced SQL scripting, including joins, aggregations, reconciliation logic, exception identification and performance-aware query design.
  • Familiarity with ETL/ELT tools and experience navigating data pipelines, orchestration processes and source-to-report dataflows.
  • Strong Power BI capability, including data modelling, DAX, report design, dashboard development and governance of recurring management information.
  • Experience using scripting languages such as Python or PowerShell to automate data extraction, validation, reconciliation and reporting processes.
  • Familiarity with Git or other source control software.

Desirable:

  • Knowledge of risk management concepts, including market risk, credit and counterparty risk, operational risk, risk appetite, limits, controls, governance, stress testing and regulatory reporting.
  • Understanding of capital markets products, trading lifecycle data, risk exposure measures, P&L drivers, client and counterparty data, and the data dependencies that support effective risk oversight.

Competencies:

  • An analytical problem solver, expert in spotting patterns and inferring connections in data.
  • A collaborative team player, approachable, self-efficient and influences a positive work environment.
  • Demonstrates curiosity.
  • Resilient in a challenging, fast-paced environment.
  • Excels at building relationships, networking and influencing others.
  • Strategic collaborator with insight and agility, able to anticipate future challenges, ensuring operational effectiveness.

Conduct Rules, You must:

  • Act with integrity
  • Act with due skill, care and diligence
  • Be open and cooperative with the FCA, the PRA and other regulators
  • Pay due regard to the interests of customers and treat them fairly
  • Observe proper standard of market conduct
  • Act to deliver good outcomes for retail customers

Company Values

Be collaborative - by working together across the organisation, we foster teamwork, can better respond to challenges and successfully deliver for our clients

Act with integrity - we pride ourselves on our honesty and high ethical standards. We apply these values when working with all our clients, colleagues and other stakeholders

Be adaptable and entrepreneurial - we embrace change as markets evolve to constantly increase our efficiency and create innovative solutions for our clients. We are interested in the world around us and inquisitive about understanding the challenges and opportunities our clients face.

Be respectful – how we treat each other, and our clients says everything about who we are. We always act respectfully and treat people fairly in everything we do.

Nurture talent – we aim to grow our own talent and make Marex the place ambitious, hardworking and talented people choose to build their career. This means giving and taking stretch opportunities, taking risks, and committing to career development and support – for ourselves, and our teams.

Marex is fully committed to being an inclusive employer and providing an inclusive and accessible recruitment process for all. We will provide reasonable adjustments to remove any disadvantage to you being considered for this role. We value the differences that a diverse workforce brings to the company. We welcome applications from candidates returning to the workforce. Also, Marex is committed to avoiding circumstances in which the appearance or possibility of conflicts of interest may exist within the hiring process.

Title: Royalty Data Analyst
Description:
Job Description Summary

Focus Partner firm, GRF, is seeking a Royalty Data Analyst to join our experienced and respected royalty audit team. The team is hoping to welcome a like-minded friendly team player that relishes taking on dynamic challenges. The Royalty Data Analyst is responsible for assisting the department in conducting compliance examinations on behalf of our entertainment clients and other rights holders.

This role would be fully remote with the candidate based in the UK.

Job Description

Primary Responsibilities


Assist managers with music royalty audits of record companies, music publishers, and merchandising companies, on behalf of clients that include many Multi-Platinum and Grammy-winning artists, writers, and producers
Download and summarize royalty statements
Work with large and complex datasets to identify trends, discrepancies, anomalies, and opportunities for further investigation
Maintain organization of electronic files and folder
Review and interpret contractual agreements to identify relevant royalty provisions, rates, definitions, deductions, and other key terms
Analyze various data flows and income types that contribute to royalty statements and assess the accuracy and completeness of reported information
Develop, maintain, and improve databases and analytical tools used to support royalty audits and data analysis
Utilize advanced Excel skills to manipulate, analyze, and present complex datasets; leverage Power BI and other data visualization tools as appropriate
Maintain strong client relationships through professionalism, integrity, responsiveness, and effective communication
Conduct Internet research
Other projects and duties as assigned


Qualifications


2+ years of relevant experience in royalty auditing, royalty accounting, data analysis, or a related field
Demonstrable experience working across Recorded Music, Music Publishing, and Neighbouring Rights is required
Advanced proficiency in Excel, including Pivot Tables and formulas (such as VLOOKUP and SUMIF) – bonus points for experience with Power Pivot and Power Query
Solid interpersonal skills and other key soft skills (i.e., communication, time management, emotional intelligence, adaptability, active listening, critical-thinking, etc.)
A genuine interest in the music business and music royalties
The candidate must also:
Be a self-motivated and detail-oriented analytical thinker
Possess excellent verbal/written communication skills and reading comprehension
Understand basic mathematical and accounting principles
Work well independently and in a team environment
Be eager to learn new skills and concepts
Want to help creative artists
While not required, experience or education in the music business, particularly music royalties and music royalty audits are beneficial

This position is a non-exempt position. The annualized base pay range for this role is expected to be between £35,000 - £38,000. base salary compensation range. Title: BI Developer
Description:
INEOS Automotive - Built For More

Story so far

Since we started our journey to build a no nonsense 4X4, we've come a long way. We've established INEOS Automotive as a serious contender in 4X4 development and manufacturing. We've partnered with some of the biggest names in the automotive industry. We've made our way from vision to prototype. We've secured a world-class production facility and delivery team. We've delivered Grenadiers to customers all around the world. We're building our double cab pick up, the Quartermaster.

People and Culture

Easy never changed anything. Not in manufacturing, science, engineering or energy - and certainly not elite sport. At INEOS we tackle every challenge head-on, and we help extraordinary athletes achieve extraordinary things. When it comes to making positive change, we know nothing gets done without grit, rigor and humor. Our Automotive team consist of around 1500 employees, 10 locations and 44 nationalities, we're an international team working together to challenge the ordinary.

If this sounds like you, let's talk.

Your role:

We are looking for a BI Developer to join Global Sales Operations, working alongside the Global Sales Reporting Lead to build and maintain the reporting estate that supports INEOS Automotive's global sales, retailer and customer experience operations.

This is a hands-on delivery role. Requirements, stakeholder decisions and go-live approvals are owned by the Reporting Lead; your focus is turning agreed requirements into robust, well-modelled Power BI solutions on top of our Snowflake data platform. You will work across a live portfolio of dashboards spanning leads, order take, handovers, retailer performance, inventory and customer experience.

Our stack is Microsoft Power BI (including composite models over Azure Analysis Services and shared enterprise datasets), Snowflake as the data warehouse, and Power Automate for reporting workflow automation.

This is an excellent opportunity to join a leading company. Our commitment to extending data and reporting products and services across the company provides great scope and opportunity to significantly develop and grow your career.

Responsibilities include (but are not limited to):


Scoping, designing, building, servicing, and supporting all new and existing reports / dashboards within the organisation with the goal of providing robust analytical solutions that support the strategic aims
Gathering, inspecting, cleaning, transforming and modelling data with the goal of discovering useful information, suggesting conclusions, and supporting decision-making
Capturing data requirements to design, extend or maintain, logical and physical data models which support new and existing BI initiatives
Delivering testing, maintaining test scenarios, user acceptance testing and end user training
Responsible for the BI estate and conducting approved technology upgrades, providing technical advice, product information and 1st line support for the BI user community


What we are looking for:


Strong, demonstrable Power BI development skill: data modelling, advanced DAX (filter context, time intelligence, performance), Power Query, and report design
Experience with composite models and shared/enterprise datasets (DirectQuery to Analysis Services or Power BI datasets), including their limitations around relationships and calculated columns
Strong SQL, with the ability to write, test and tune queries and views against a cloud data warehouse (Snowflake preferred)
Solid grasp of dimensional modelling (Kimball) and when to solve a problem in the warehouse versus the semantic model
Experience administering the Power BI Platform: licensing, security roles and permissions, and workspaces
Ability to work from written requirements independently, flag risks early, and respect approval gates on structural model changes
Fluent in English, with good verbal and non-verbal communication skills


Desired Experience:


Experience in report / dashboard development using PowerBI
Experience in managing the PowerBI Platform (licencing, security, workspaces)
Exposure to SAP-sourced data (S/4HANA, C4C) and ELT tools such as Dell Boomi
Power Automate (or similar) for scheduled data exports and workflow automation
Experience in coding with SQL and manipulating large datasets
Experience in building data pipelines (extract, transform and load) to transport a wide variety of data types and high volumes of data
Experience of developing end to end data solutions using the Microsoft stack namely, Microsoft Fabric
Experience with data platforms such as Snowflake
Experience in requirement gathering and report/dashboard design
Experience in time and project management using Agile or Waterfall principals
Experience in training, presenting, and communicating technical topics to a non-technical audience at all levels
Knowledge of Data Warehousing concepts and best practice - architecture and methodology (ideally Kimball) and BI Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)


Behavioural skills:


Pro-activity - the drive to actively own the products both in development and in operation
Communication - explain to the goals, objectives, and limitations of product design
Positivity - see the opportunities in situations; ensure the team understands the benefit of the work
Detail - question solutions and situations to ensure the business & team understand positions taken
Commerciality - understand the business reason for the work beyond the technical challenges
Pragmatism - pragmatic approach to solving conflict, between ideal solutions and immediate need


If the role sounds of interest and you want to learn more, please apply.

If your application is successful one of our team members will be in touch to arrange an initial conversation!

Title: Data Quality Control Analyst
Description:
We help partners understand the changing advertising landscape. Specialising in audience measurement, consumer targeting and in-depth intelligence into paid, owned and earned media, their global coverage and local expertise enable better understanding of media audiences and their relationships with brands.

Job Details

Job Title: Quality Control Analyst 

Location: London, Hanger Lane

Full-time/Permanent/Hybrid 

 

Job Details  

 

BARB (The Broadcasters' Audience Research Board) is responsible for the measurement of the number of people watching television in the UK, on behalf of the television companies and the advertising industry. 

 

The BARB Operations team is responsible for delivering daily TV ratings to the UKs broadcast industry and associated agencies. Tasks & Responsibilities 

 

This role is for a QC Analyst within a team of 7. 


Evaluating the data received from BARB homes and deciding on whether any potential faults need to be followed up.

Perform investigations to understand any unusual trends or patterns of viewing behaviour observed in daily results. 
Supervise the performance and efficiency of other members of the BARB team, including technicians and data entry 
Ensuring that all procedures are carried out in accordance with the client specification 
Undertake QC activities within specified timeframes to ensure that contracts' Service Level Agreements are satisfied

Good knowledge and experience in Microsoft Office tools, especially Excel, Access and Power BI. 
Experience of running statistical data analyses in a previous role or to satisfy an academic qualification. 
Familiarity with various tools and dashboards used for data investigation and quality control. Preferred but not essential (SQL/Python) 
Ability to evaluate and interpret data accurately to identify potential faults and unusual trends. 
Good time management skills. 
A confident person with good communication skills

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Tax Automation & Alteryx Data Analyst

Location: London (Hybrid – 2 days per week in office, either Mon/Wed or Tue/Wed)

Contract: 12-Month Fixed-Term Contract

Salary: £93,000 – £103,000 + Guaranteed Full Bonus

Reports to: Head of Tax Transformation

The Opportunity




My client is seeking a highly analytical Tax Automation & AI Data Analyst to join the Tax Transformation team on a 12-month fixed-term basis.

This role sits at the intersection of data engineering, automation and applied AI.




You will play a key role in helping the Tax function modernise its operating model by combining established automation technologies such as Alteryx with emerging AI capabilities, including LLM-powered tools and Agentic AI solutions.




Working directly with tax subject matter experts, you will help transform manual and spreadsheet-heavy processes into scalable, controlled and auditable solutions.




This is a hands-on delivery role focused on building practical automation and AI-enabled capabilities rather than leading people.




The successful candidate will be passionate about using data and technology to solve business problems, confident engaging with non-technical stakeholders and able to help teams identify new ways AI can create value across Tax operations.




Key Responsibilities

Design, develop and maintain Alteryx workflows that automate complex tax and finance processes.
Partner with Tax SMEs to identify, prioritise and build a pipeline of automation and AI use cases.
Use data engineering and automation techniques to reduce manual processing and improve operational efficiency.
Support the development and implementation of AI-enabled solutions, including LLM-based tools, Claude use cases and Agentic AI capabilities.
Help the Tax function understand how AI can be practically and responsibly applied to enhance processes and decision-making.
Build controlled, auditable solutions within a regulated financial services environment.
Source, cleanse, validate and reconcile data from multiple systems and datasets.
Develop reporting, dashboards and analytical outputs to support operational and strategic tax activities.
Create clear technical documentation and promote adoption of new tools and processes.
Work closely with data engineering colleagues to help meet growing demand for automation and AI initiatives across the department.
Proactively identify opportunities for continuous improvement and bring forward innovative solutions.




Essential Skills & Experience

Minimum Requirements

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate business challenges into data-driven solutions.
Hands-on experience developing business-critical workflows in Alteryx.
Alteryx certification or willingness to obtain certification quickly.
Experience working with complex datasets and data transformation activities.
Advanced Excel skills.
Experience applying AI technologies within business processes, particularly:
LLM-based tools (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT or similar)
Prompt engineering and AI-assisted workflows
Emerging Agentic AI capabilities
Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to engage and influence non-technical users.




Desirable Experience

Financial Services, Insurance or another highly regulated environment.
Experience supporting finance, tax, risk or control-related processes.
Knowledge of Power BI or similar visualisation tools.
Experience building AI-enabled automation solutions.
Understanding of governance, controls and risk considerations when deploying AI capabilities.
Exposure to tax, finance transformation or process improvement initiatives.




Candidate Profile

We're looking for someone who:

Has strong Alteryx expertise as their core capability.
Is excited by the practical application of AI in business environments.
Can bridge the gap between technical teams and business stakeholders.
Enjoys helping non-technical colleagues adopt new technologies.
Thinks creatively about how data and AI can transform processes.

Title: Expression of Interest - YouTube Data Analyst
Description:
LADbible Group is one of the world’s most engaged digital entertainment businesses, reaching over a billion people globally and amassing more than 13.9 billion social views each month. With a powerhouse portfolio across general lifestyle, entertainment, sport, gaming, and tech, our brands: - including LADbible, UNILAD, GAMINGbible, and UNILAD Tech, are some of the most recognised and culturally relevant on the internet.




YouTube is one of our biggest growth engines, home to some of the most distinctive channels, including LADbible Entertainment, LADbible Stories and SPORTbible. From working with the world’s biggest creators and A-list talent on hit formats like Snack Wars, to powerful storytelling through series such as Minutes With and Honesty Box, we’ve become one of the most exciting and influential players in the industry.




About the Role

Our YouTube team is growing, and we are on the proactive lookout for a Data Analyst. The Data Analyst produces insight that drives decisions across the YouTube team and informs the Originals commissioning pipeline.




What the opportunity looks like

Channel Performance - Analyse YouTube channel performance across watch time, CTR, audience retention, subscriber growth, CPMs, return viewers, and audience share to identify trends, risks, and growth opportunities.
Dashboard Management - Build, maintain, and optimise live reporting dashboards using Looker Studio and BigQuery, ensuring stakeholders have access to accurate, actionable performance data.
External Intelligence - Conduct competitive and market intelligence using tools such as Tubular Labs, Social Blade, and platform analytics to benchmark performance and identify emerging category trends.
Format Growth and Analysis - Deliver audience, content format, and growth analysis to inform channel strategy, content investment decisions, and new channel or format opportunities.
Portfolio Growth Tracking - Monitor portfolio performance against targets, proactively flagging underperformance and providing data-driven recommendations to support business and commercial objectives.




Skills and experience we'd like you to have

Proven experience in data analytics or digital/media analytics, ideally within YouTube, social media, or digital publishing environments.
Experience analysing YouTube performance metrics, including watch time, audience retention, CTR, subscriber growth, RPM/CPM, and viewer behaviour.
Ability to interpret large datasets and translate findings into clear commercial recommendations.
Proficiency in BigQuery, SQL, Looker Studio, and data visualisation best practices.
Familiarity with competitive intelligence and social analytics tools such as Tubular Labs, Social Blade, or similar platforms.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to present insights to both technical and non-technical audiences.

At LADbible Group we've rolled out blended working which means the majority of departments across the business (including London, Manchester and International offices) work in the office 3 days per week.

LADbible Group is an equal opportunities employer. We are determined to create a diverse group at all levels of our company and we welcome all members of the community to apply for openings with us. As the leading social youth publisher, we have a powerful global platform to better represent our audience and enable those that do not have equal opportunities to have their voices heard. As a business, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce, in an environment where everyone feels comfortable to be themselves.
