Title: Cloud Data Analyst (Methods Analyst II) (ID: 55798)
Description:
Are you passionate about leveraging modern cloud data architecture and artificial intelligence to make a tangible impact on public transit?

Edmonton Transit Service (ETS) is looking for an innovative and collaborative Cloud Data Analyst to act as the cloud infrastructure expert of our team. In this pivotal role, you will architect and scale end-to-end data pipelines (ETL/ELT) on the Google Cloud Platform, transforming over million rows of complex and raw transit telemetry daily into actionable insights and advanced AI models. Your technical expertise will directly support daily transit operations, optimize workforce scheduling for over 2,000 transit operators, and continuously improve the transit experience across our city. If you are driven by cloud computing efficiency, pipeline reliability, and writing scalable production code, this is your opportunity to build upon our existing enterprise architecture and scale it for the AI era!

What will you do?


Build & Scale Data Architecture: Design, maintain, and optimize robust ETL/ELT pipelines in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and BigQuery to process over a million rows of transit data daily
Optimize Cloud Costs & Performance: Continuously evaluate data compute environments using advanced SQL, table partitioning, and clustering techniques to ensure fiscal responsibility and performance efficiency
Automate Data Quality: Create automated validation framework rules to systematically clean data anomalies such as duplicate bus pings, corrupted data payloads and logical outliers - before data feeds AI agents and downstream applications
Enable Data-Driven Decision Making: Leverage applied statistics and predictive analytics to solve complex transit business problems. Transform the outputs of massive data pipelines into clear, enterprise-grade dashboards (using tools like Tableau or Looker) that empower cross-functional leadership to make strategic, data-informed decisions
Operational Support: Facilitate the Annual Operator Vacation Sign-Up process for nearly 2,000 transit operators, balancing operational needs with collective agreement parameters
Enable AI & Predictive Analytics: Structure and provision clean, reliable enterprise data feeds that serve as the foundational truth. In future phases of the roadmap, build, configure and deploy the AI micro-agents and predictive models that utilize this data
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Actively partner with analysts across Edmonton Transit Service (ETS) to ensure enterprise pipelines align with diverse operational workflows and municipal requirements



Qualifications:


University Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Management Information Systems, Data Science/Analytics, Applied Statistics, Operations Research, or a directly related technical field
Minimum of four (4) years of directly related hands-on experience in programmatic data engineering, cloud data architecture, and enterprise ETL/ELT pipeline development



Assets:


Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer or Google Cloud Professional Machine Learning Engineer certifications
Formal credentials or demonstrated experience in modern Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), or agentic AI frameworks
Experience or training in modern data orchestration tools (e.g., Apache Airflow, dbt)



Skills required for success:


Technical Mastery: Deep proficiency in programmatic data manipulation using Python and advanced analytical SQL. Highly capable of writing complex time-series logic utilizing Common Table Expression (CTEs) and Window Functions
Cloud & Orchestration Expertise: Demonstrated ability to manage cloud data warehouses and implement structural optimizations like table partitioning and clustering in Google BigQuery. Proven experience orchestrating complex production pipelines using Apache Airflow or dbt / Dataform, while adhering to software delivery best practices including Git and CI/CD
Pipeline Reliability: Proven track record of designing highly scalable, idempotent ETL/ELT pipelines that can process massive daily data volumes and safely recover from automated failures without duplicating records
Analytics & Visualization: Strong proficiency in applied statistics, enterprise BI tools (Tableau, Looker, PowerBI), and advanced data analytics (descriptive, diagnostic, and predictive). Demonstrated ability to go beyond basic reporting by transforming massive pipeline outputs into strategic, actionable insights that solve operational transit problems
Communication & Collaboration: Clear communication skills with proven ability to translate complex ETL/AI technical concepts into accessible insights for diverse non-technical team members and collaborators
Problem Solving & Time Management: Exceptional ability to independently navigate and process massive, high-velocity data streams under tight deadlines while balancing short-term operational demands with long-term architecture goals
Strict adherence to fiscal responsibility, demonstrating the ability to proactively balance scalable data architecture with rigid cloud compute budgets to prevent cost overruns
Alignment to our Cultural Commitments and Leadership Competencies ( https://bit.ly/4brRrXm )
Embracing a culture of equity, diversity, reconciliation and inclusion



Conditions of Employment:


Satisfactory completion of relevant background checks prior to commencement



Work Environment:


This role primarily operates in a standard, modern office setting with options for hybrid working arrangements in accordance with City of Edmonton policies. Physical demands are minimal and typical of a computer-focused administrative position

Title: Portfolio Analyst
Description:
Detailed Job Description

Join us in enabling trade through Canada's largest port

The Vancouver Fraser Port Authority is an arm’s-length federal agency responsible for the shared stewardship of the lands and waters that make up the Port of Vancouver, Canada’s largest port. Our mandate, as outlined in the Canada Marine Act, is to enable Canada’s trade objectives on behalf of all Canadians, ensuring the safe movement of goods through the Port of Vancouver while protecting the environment and considering local communities.

As an organization with a significant impact on communities and businesses across Canada, the Vancouver Fraser Port Authority is dedicated to diversity, inclusion, and sustainability. We strive to create a workplace that mirrors the richness of our community, empowering all employees to achieve their full potential.

The Portfolio Analyst supports effective management of the VFPA project portfolio by maintaining, optimizing, and analyzing the Project Portfolio Management (PPM) systems and toolkits. This role ensures data quality, upholds portfolio metadata standards, develops dashboards, and enables consistent, reliable portfolio reporting and visibility across the organization.

Working closely with project leads, PMO team members, and at times under the direction of the Senior Portfolio Advisor, the Portfolio Analyst supports portfolio monitoring, reporting, and PPM system and toolkit improvements. The role provides early warning signals and strengthens the integrity of information used in portfolio decision-making by collecting, validating, and maintaining portfolio data and reporting outputs. This role supports the enabling of efficient and scalable portfolio management practices across the VFPA.

What You Do


Provide PPM systems and toolkits expertise by offering guidance and tooling support related to portfolio reporting, controls, and standard templates; identify knowledge gaps and recommend improvements to ensure PPM systems and toolkits remain accessible, current, and fit for purpose.
Maintain portfolio metadata standards to ensure consistency and integrity across the PPM system.
Improve the efficiency and quality of portfolio reporting and system support by leveraging process automation, dashboards, AI tools, and other technology-enabled methods.
Monitor portfolio data and indicators for projects within the VFPA project portfolio and prepare regular assessments of data quality, key project performance indicators, and qualitative factors.
Establish and maintain portfolio data quality standards and controls (completeness, accuracy, timeliness), track exceptions, coordinate remediation, and escalate material or recurring issues as required.
Analyze project and portfolio data to identify trends, exceptions, and emerging risks, and provide early warning signals to support portfolio review forums and decision support.
Liaise with portfolio stakeholders – including internal teams and, where applicable, external delivery partners – to collect, validate, and reconcile portfolio data in support of portfolio reporting needs. Prepare and maintain portfolio status updates, dashboards, and reporting materials to support portfolio review forums and decision making.
Identify and escalate data anomalies, material risks, and gaps in reporting to the Manager, Project Portfolio Management and Senior Portfolio Advisor for timely action.
Demonstrate and promote the effective use of PPM processes and tools. Produce materials and guidance to support adoption and knowledge transfer.
Identify planning and scheduling interdependencies and conflicts within the VFPA project portfolio.
Support the identification and integration of lessons learned and improvement opportunities arising from pre-project and post-project reviews led by project leads.
Contribute analytical, technical, and systems expertise to department innovations and improvements, supporting the PMO leadership team in enhancing PMO processes, tools, standards, and capabilities.
Perform other assigned duties as required.



What You Bring


Completion of a two-year full-time diploma in data analytics, data engineering, management information systems, business administration, supply chain management, or another acceptable field.
Minimum three (3) years of experience in data analytics, portfolio reporting or business systems administration with at least one (1) year of experience in project management.
Experience configuring or administering Smartsheet, Smartsheet Control Center, SharePoint, or workflow/automation platforms and experience demonstrating the use of these tools to others.
Completion of a relevant foundational project or program management designation (e.g. CAPM) is an asset.
Strong technical aptitude with the ability to learn, configure, and optimize business systems, including PPM tools, workflow platforms, and reporting dashboards.
Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, assess data quality, and develop meaningful insights.
Strong understanding of project management concepts, terminology, and lifecycle processes, with the ability to apply this knowledge to portfolio monitoring and reporting.
Strong interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with project leads, technical teams, and PMO colleagues to clarify information and resolve issues.
Effective organizational and time management skills, including the ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines in a dynamic environment.



What We Offer


Market-competitive base salaries and variable incentive plan
Flexible remote work program
Earned time off program
Paid vacation and personal care leave
Learning, development, and advancement opportunities
Onsite gym with towel service in a national landmark in the heart of Vancouver’s waterfront
Friendly, unique, and respectful workplace
Generous and inclusive benefits offering including retirement benefits plan



Location: Vancouver, Canada

Job type: Bargaining Unit, Full-Time, Permanent, Hybrid

Working environment: Normal office conditions. Flexibility to respond to issues during non-working hours as required.

MARINE TRANSPORTATION SECURITY CLEARANCE

The incumbent must obtain and maintain a valid Marine Transportation Security Clearance as this position is required to access restricted areas/information as defined by the Marine Transportation Security Regulations.

This is Canadian-based employment, and all employees are expected to maintain legal eligibility to work in Canada. Applicants advancing in the hiring process may be subject to technical assignments, psychometric assessments, and/or background checks, including but not limited to criminal record, credit, and/or reference checks.

Description:
Convergint is looking for a team-oriented, results-driven, Supply Chain Data Analyst, to join our amazing culture. As the Supply Chain Data Analyst, you will be responsible for maintaining vendor item master catalogs and provide reporting and analytics to support the source to pay process. This role involves tasks like data entry, updates, and resolving discrepancies, with a strong focus on data integrity and efficiency in operations. This role has an emphasis on support of the supply chain and sales teams, and motivation in building effective business relationships with vendors and customers alike.

Who You Are

You have a passion for providing world-class service to customers, colleagues and communities. You are a person of integrity with a commitment to growth, accountability and delivering results. You want to join an organization with a positive culture that embraces inclusion and allows everyone to be the best version of themselves at work and home.

Who We Are

With 20-years of proven growth and exceptional performance, our mission is to be our customer’s best service provider. We realize the importance of diversity in achieving that goal. Our company was built upon a solid foundation of 10 Values and Beliefs which drive our unmatched culture, making us the #1 global, serviced-based systems integrator in the industry. We take great pride in protecting the lives and assets of our customers and their communities with the solutions we provide.

What you’ll do with “Our Training and Your Experience”


Creating, updating, and managing item records within relevant systems.
Ensure the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of item data, including descriptions, classifications, units of measure, vendor information, pricing, and other relevant details.
Conduct regular audits to identify and correct errors, duplicates, or outdated records.
Manage the lifecycle of item records, including creation, updates, and decommissioning.
Support for item master data management, including troubleshooting issues and assisting with system enhancements.
Interact with suppliers, manufacturers, and distributors on an on-going basis, which may include negotiating prices, discounts, credit terms, and logistics.
Participating in the development and implementation of best practices for item master data management.
Work with Supply Chain leadership to develop and implement best practices, demand planning, and other optimizations in order to help grow the business and to ensure process transparency, fairness, impartiality, and confidentiality.
Collaborate with global counterparts to align with process standardization and consistency in reporting across all regions.
Provide reporting and data analytics to Supply Chain leadership to show trends, address discrepancies, and generate accurate forecasting.
Develop constructive and cooperative working relationships with internal stakeholders and vendors alike and maintain them over time.
Executes all work in accordance with Provincial/State, local regulations, general best practices as well as company health and safety policies and procedures.
Acts as “our customer’s best service provider” at all times thereby ensuring Convergint Technologies is the customer’s first choice for service.
Communicates with and works with the other team members consistently to improve overall operations of the Convergint Technology Center, and company.
Keeps up to date and informed on all company policies.
Presents a professional image of Convergint Technologies at all times in appearance and behavior.
Performs other duties and responsibilities as requested or required.


What You’ll Need


Strong attention to details.
Strong verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills and ability to deal with a wide cross section of people both internal and external to the business.
Excellent Excel, Word, and Outlook skills.
Excellent proficiency in financial software specifically related to purchase order entry, accounts payable, and inventory management.
Strong negotiation skills.
Strong financial knowledge and skills—ability to understand basic financials such as accounts receivable/payable, purchase orders, work orders, etc.
Excellent organizational skills and the ability to handle multiple projects tasks simultaneously.
Excellent attention to detail.
Strong flexibility to adapt to changing priorities, work processes, department structure, environment and technology in a dynamic work environment.
Self-driven and motivated to meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
Strong analytical skills are necessary to resolve problems and look for solutions.
Strong ability to demonstrate independence, resourcefulness and tenacity.
Shows initiative – regularly engages in proactive behavior and looks for opportunities.


Requirements


Diploma and/or certificate in Business Administration or Purchasing required.
SCMP designation highly desirable.
Minimum of five years of procurement experience including elements of the supply chain
preferred.
Minimum of five years of negotiation and vendor management experience preferred.
Minimum of five years of customer service experience is required.
Experience in Ivalua, Salesforce, and NetSuite highly desirable.
Relevant industry experience in electrical, security, building automation, or fire is required

Title: Operations Analyst - Flow
Description:
YVR is a place of connection, bringing together people, places and cargo while ensuring a safe and efficient experience for everyone. Airport Operations an integral part to the success of the airport system, as a key role in facilitating safe and efficient and predictable movement of aircraft and all customers that those aircraft serve. Roles in Airport Operations are exciting and dynamic and require a strong team approach – which is key to everything we do.

Position Overview

Are you a data-driven, team player? As the Operations Analyst – Flow, you will be responsible for tracking and reporting on YVR’s real-time operational performance and will use this data to influence our operational performance to both our internal and external stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities Include


Maintaining a real-time operational metric database by reporting on all key flow areas across groundside, terminal, baggage and airside
Establishing a means to track real-time operational performance across all areas, and providing quantitative and qualitative reporting for day-of operations and forecasting
Identifying obstacles and anomalies through data analysis to help justify initiating projects aimed at improving operational efficiency
Managing all aspects of projects including creating documents and change management plans for stakeholders


Key Qualifications Include


At least two years of relevant experience in an operational environment, ideally in a major international airport, supplemented by at least two years of post-secondary training (Aviation Management, Business, Operations and/or Logistics preferred); or an equivalent combination of training and experience
Proficiency with MS Office and advanced skills in data analytics; preference for those with experience with major BI tools such as MS Fabric, PowerBI, Qlik and/or Databrick
Proven ability to quickly interpret abstract data from independent sources and present to a variety of stakeholders
Strong technical writing skills with excellent communication skills and a demonstrated ability to present to large audiences
Exceptional critical thinking and decision-making skills, with a proven ability to work with minimal supervision


Shift schedule with alternating day and night shifts will be required as this role supports the operation on a 24-hour basis, with a requirement to support winter operations for 24/7 operations. As an employee on a shifted work schedule, you may be eligible for shift and weekend premiums.

The results of this posting will apply to any subsequent part-time Operations Analyst – Flow positions that may become vacant as a result of filling the full-time position referenced in this posting (Ref #26-106). If no subsequent vacancies immediately arise from this posting within the Operations Analyst – Flow classification, future vacancies will be posted in accordance with standard procedures.

Although not required, French language skills are an asset as we are committed to providing bilingual services to our visitors and passengers. Candidates who do not speak French are still strongly encouraged to apply.

This position is open to Vancouver Airport Authority employees and external applications. Previous job performance will be taken into consideration for all internal candidates that apply for this position.

As part of our recruitment process, short-listed candidates may be required to participate in an assessment process.

Salary Range : $71,560 to $93,525 per annum, based on 37.5 hours per week. This is individually tailored to reflect your unique experience, qualifications and internal equity. At YVR, your work experience goes beyond the paycheck. We support your personal and professional development, well-being, and a thriving work culture with generous vacation days, extensive health benefits, retirement savings matching, wellness programs, community engagement, commuting support, and continuous learning opportunities. Learn more at https://careers.yvr.ca/benefits.

Who We Are

YVR is more than just an airport. We connect our beautiful province and all it has to offer to the world. We are all leaders and trailblazers for change and innovation, so no matter the department or team you’re a part of, the work you do matters.

At YVR, we are flexible in everything we do. We will work together to find ways to deliver customer excellence that helps us all thrive.

Whatever your background and wherever you’re from, you belong at YVR. If you have any questions about accessibility or require any assistance applying, please reach out at careers@yvr.ca.

Title: Data Analyst, ReBIRD
Description:
Your Opportunity at ARC’TERYX:
As the Data Analyst, ReBIRD, your expertise in analysis and data-driven insights supports key decisions on product service, repair, and long-term strategy. Reporting to the Senior Data Analyst, ReBIRD you will work closely with cross-functional partners of the ReBIRD program to deliver a best-in-class guest experience that extends the lifecycle of Arc’teryx products. You are a driven professional focused on creating a data-driven culture and enabling decision makers in the short- and long-term strategy to deliver on a best-in-class guest experience.




This role is based out of our North Vancouver office and is open to hybrid remote work. Candidates must be eligible to work in Canada.






Meet Your Future Team:




Under the Circularity umbrella, the ReBIRD team supports the operations of our warranty and repairs program, our service centers within retail, and resale.  The global ReBIRD program focuses on an exceptional Guest experience at all Commercial touchpoints, inclusive of Guest Services, After Sales, Branded activations, and especially within our owned Vertical channels, Retail and eCommerce. 







If you were in the Data Analyst, ReBIRD role now, here are some of the core activities you would be doing:


Performing data manipulation and analysis to support key performance metrics across the service and repair network


Maintaining recurring forecasts and supporting the development of new forecasting techniques


Building and maintaining dashboards in Power BI including troubleshooting and debugging errors, refreshing, and publishing data


Gathering business requirements and translating them into data requirements and specifications


Collaborating with cross-functional teams including Business Intelligence, Technology, Design, Quality Control, and Supply Chain; representing company needs in after-sales returns and service and working on projects to enable informed decision making


Improving data through research and analysis of product returns and trends in support of product insights and design teams


Understanding and teaching others about global service delivery systems and processes in relation to regional differences and constraints for reporting visibility





Here are some of the things you could be working on in the future:





Supporting the creation and reporting of sustainability metrics and measuring the impact of the service and repair program, in partnership with our Sustainability team


Contributing to the evolution of data tools across the business, providing subject matter expertise in future development of data platforms


Integrating APAC regions into greater data analytics work to better inform global ReBIRD analytics


Incorporating raw material data to support forecasting, ordering, managing, and fulfillment






Are you our next Data Analyst, ReBIRD?



You have a Bachelor’s Degree in Math, Economics, Statistics, Finance, Business or a related field


You have 3+ years' experience synthesizing complex analysis into actionable insights and presenting insights to senior leaders


You have excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to summarize and express ideas clearly through visualizations, written documents and presentations


You have extensive experience in data visualization and analysis software (e.g. Power BI, Excel, Tableau, SQL, etc.)


You have experience with data manipulation and management including ETL, user provisioning, and Power BI service management


You have experience balancing customer focus with long-term strategic goals and operational constraints, and you take initiative in documenting and presenting opportunities for improvement


You are proactive in identifying the root cause of issues and developing solutions.


You remain highly flexible and adaptable when faced with ambiguity.


Your passion for your work is paralleled by your passion for getting outside and living it.


You are able and willing to travel as required








CompensationThe salary range for this role is CAD$71,000 - CAD$93,000
















Total Rewards




Most new team members join between the start and midpoint of the range, where you can contribute right away while continuing to grow your craft, your collaborations, and your impact at Arc’teryx. This range reflects market alignment and the scope of the role. Individual pay is determined by your skills, experience, and level of responsibility. 










We’re committed to fair, equitable, and competitive pay, reviewed regularly to ensure internal alignment and market relevance. Transparency is part of how we follow through on our commitments and how we honour the value you bring to our team. 










In addition to base pay, Arc’teryx supports people through benefits designed to sustain both work and life: 












Health & wellbeing - Extended health, dental, and vision coverage, including mental health support, fertility benefits, gender-affirming care and a 24/7 Employee Assistance Program (EAP).


Financial wellbeing - RRSP matching and eligibility for Arc'teryx Annual Incentive Plan and access to Employee Stock Purchase program (ESPP) where applicable.


Time & Flexibility - Paid time off, wellness time, and No Wasted Day program (dedicated paid days to get outside & explore).


Family support - Parental leave top-up and a nesting period for new parents.


Growth, community & gear - Professional development opportunities, Arc'teryx Academies (outdoor skill-building events), Employee Belonging Councils, and access to employee discounts and Pro Deals (exclusive discounted pricing on gear). 











 *Eligibility for certain programs may vary by role. 








Equal Opportunity




 




Arc’teryx is committed to actively creating and fostering a culture of inclusivity where voices are heard, people are seen, and values are respected. We care about the uniqueness of our applicants, employees, and guests, and we do so in a safe space fueled by curiosity and acceptance. 




 




Creating an inclusive workplace is connected to our core value Do Right while also having the added benefit of helping make our business better. We believe inclusion helps us to create a healthier, happier workplace, drive creativity and innovation, and reflect the communities where we operate.  




 




All applicants, employees, and guests can expect equality of opportunity and fair treatment in alignment with our values.




 




Leave it Better




We believe that the mountains transform us, that how we adventure matters, and that there’s always a better way. 




Join us in creating positive change in ourselves, our communities, and the world. 




 




Live it. Get out there - the mountains make us better 




Disruptive evolution. In pursuit of better. Always. 




Commit. We set bold objectives and see them through.

Title: Content Analyst
Description:
As one of the world’s leading independent global investment firms, Invesco is dedicated to rethinking possibilities for our clients. By delivering the combined power of our distinctive investment management capabilities, we provide a wide range of investment strategies and vehicles to our clients around the world. If you're looking for challenging work, intelligent colleagues, and exposure across a global footprint, come explore your potential at Invesco.

Job Description

The team:

We are a unified, collaborative marketing team focused on creating meaningful client connections that drive business growth. We combine deep insights with strong partnerships to deliver timely, relevant, and impactful experiences for our clients. Our team is committed to continuous learning, innovation, and excellence in everything we do. We align closely with distribution partners to generate demand and unlock new opportunities across the business. Above all, we measure and optimize our efforts to ensure we consistently deliver value, drive engagement, and strengthen loyalty to Invesco.

The role:

The Content Enablement Content Analyst is a key role within Invesco’s Global Content Enablement team, supporting the Americas & EMEA Marketing organization. This position executes the content strategy and roadmap to enhance the quality, accessibility, and usability of content across the EMEA region. The role focuses on building and managing content infrastructure, ensuring accurate categorization, distribution, and access across platforms and audiences. It partners closely with business and technology stakeholders to deliver consistent, well-governed content solutions and ensure requirements are clearly defined and tested. This hands-on role is critical to improving content quality and driving engagement, ultimately enabling a stronger client and investment experience.

Responsibilities of the role:

Provides analytics support primarily for EMEA content domains, with additional support for North America.
Partners closely with EMEA Content Product Owners to deliver analysis across development, deployment, and research initiatives.
Defines and standardizes content quality metrics, building reporting and dashboards to provide visibility into content performance for senior leadership.
Collaborates with EMEA and NA domain experts to develop and maintain global taxonomy, aligning stakeholders to standardized definitions and fields.
Bridges business and technology teams to ensure solutions meet requirements and align with strategic priorities.
Maps business processes, develops expertise in content sources, and provides recommendations to improve content effectiveness.
Translates stakeholder needs into user stories and supports execution of content initiatives, including testing, impact analysis, and cross-team coordination.
Leads governance and documentation efforts, including content quality monitoring, process improvement, issue escalation, and maintaining records in tools such as Jira and Confluence.


Requirements of the role:

Bachelor’s degree, 5+ years in technology platforms, project management, or content development and distribution.
Experience with CMS and/or DAM platforms, content lifecycle management, and content migrations, including API-based integrations.
Familiarity with AI-assisted content analysis and UX or digital marketing concepts.
Strong skills in workflow/process mapping, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and operate effectively in ambiguous environments.
Advanced technical proficiency, including SQL and Excel (advanced formulas, pivot tables; VBA a plus), along with strong desktop tool capabilities.
Strong analytical and statistical reasoning skills, with ability to organize, analyze, and communicate large data sets with accuracy and attention to detail.
Knowledge of content categorization (campaign, program, asset class, product), with preferred experience in investment or asset management content.
Client-focused, execution-oriented professional with strong communication, organizational, relationship-building, and influencing skills, plus a data-driven approach to measuring content performance and impact.


The salary range for this position is $55,000 to $61,000 per year. The total compensation offered for this position includes salary and incentive pay and will vary based on skills, experience and location.

Full time

Pursuant to Invesco’s Workplace Policy, employees are expected to comply with the firm’s most current workplace model, which as of October 1, 2025, includes spending at least four full days each week working in an Invesco office. This reflects our belief that spending time together in the office helps us build stronger relationships, collaborate more easily, and support each other’s growth and development.

Hybrid working environment

By delivering the combined power of our distinctive investment management capabilities, we provide a wide range of investment strategies and vehicles to our clients around the world. If you're looking for challenging work, intelligent colleagues, and exposure across a global footprint, come explore your potential at Invesco.

Job Description

The team:

We are a unified, collaborative marketing team focused on creating meaningful client connections that drive business growth. We combine deep insights with strong partnerships to deliver timely, relevant, and impactful experiences for our clients. Our team is committed to continuous learning, innovation, and excellence in everything we do. We align closely with distribution partners to generate demand and unlock new opportunities across the business. Above all, we measure and optimize our efforts to ensure we consistently deliver value, drive engagement, and strengthen loyalty to Invesco.

The role:

The Content Enablement Content Analyst is a key role within Invesco’s Global Content Enablement team, supporting the Americas & EMEA Marketing organization. This position executes the content strategy and roadmap to enhance the quality, accessibility, and usability of content across the EMEA region. The role focuses on building and managing content infrastructure, ensuring accurate categorization, distribution, and access across platforms and audiences. It partners closely with business and technology stakeholders to deliver consistent, well-governed content solutions and ensure requirements are clearly defined and tested. This hands-on role is critical to improving content quality and driving engagement, ultimately enabling a stronger client and investment experience.

Responsibilities of the role:
  • Provides analytics support primarily for EMEA content domains, with additional support for North America.
  • Partners closely with EMEA Content Product Owners to deliver analysis across development, deployment, and research initiatives.
  • Defines and standardizes content quality metrics, building reporting and dashboards to provide visibility into content performance for senior leadership.
  • Collaborates with EMEA and NA domain experts to develop and maintain global taxonomy, aligning stakeholders to standardized definitions and fields.
  • Bridges business and technology teams to ensure solutions meet requirements and align with strategic priorities.
  • Maps business processes, develops expertise in content sources, and provides recommendations to improve content effectiveness.
  • Translates stakeholder needs into user stories and supports execution of content initiatives, including testing, impact analysis, and cross-team coordination.
  • Leads governance and documentation efforts, including content quality monitoring, process improvement, issue escalation, and maintaining records in tools such as Jira and Confluence.

Requirements of the role:
  • Bachelor’s degree, 5+ years in technology platforms, project management, or content development and distribution.
  • Experience with CMS and/or DAM platforms, content lifecycle management, and content migrations, including API-based integrations.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted content analysis and UX or digital marketing concepts.
  • Strong skills in workflow/process mapping, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and operate effectively in ambiguous environments.
  • Advanced technical proficiency, including SQL and Excel (advanced formulas, pivot tables; VBA a plus), along with strong desktop tool capabilities.
  • Strong analytical and statistical reasoning skills, with ability to organize, analyze, and communicate large data sets with accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Knowledge of content categorization (campaign, program, asset class, product), with preferred experience in investment or asset management content.
  • Client-focused, execution-oriented professional with strong communication, organizational, relationship-building, and influencing skills, plus a data-driven approach to measuring content performance and impact.

The salary range for this position is $55,000 to $61,000 per year. The total compensation offered for this position includes salary and incentive pay and will vary based on skills, experience and location.

Full time

Employee

Workplace Model

Pursuant to Invesco’s Workplace Policy, employees are expected to comply with the firm’s most current workplace model, which as of October 1, 2025, includes spending at least four full days each week working in an Invesco office. This reflects our belief that spending time together in the office helps us build stronger relationships, collaborate more easily, and support each other’s growth and development.

What’s in it for you?

Our people are at the very core of our success and we strive to provide employees with a competitive total rewards package which includes:
  • Hybrid working environment
  • RRSP Contributions
  • Health & Wellness Benefits
  • Work flexibility Programs
  • Parental Leave Benefits
  • Study Support

Title: Maximo Technical Data Package Analyst
Description:
Location: Halifax - Wilkinson, Canada

In fast changing markets, customers worldwide rely on Thales. Thales is a business where brilliant people from all over the world come together to share ideas and inspire each other. In aerospace, transportation, defence, security and space, our architects design innovative solutions that make our tomorrow's possible.

Maximo Technical Data Package Analyst

Halifax, NS, Canada (Hybrid)

Position Summary

Thales has a vacancy for a Maximo Technical Data Package Analyst to act as the primary integrator between Technical Data, ILS, Supply Support, Life Cycle Material Managers (LCMMs), and Engineering departments. They are responsible for identifying and resolving part changes within the Technical Data Package (TDP), managing the full lifecycle of Document Change Requests (DCRs) via a JIRA board, and ensuring total data alignment across internal and government systems.

Regulatory Compliance Requirements


This position requires direct or indirect access to hardware, software or technical information (data) controlled under the Canadian Export Control List and/or the ITAR or the US the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). All applicants must be eligible or able to obtain authorization for such access.
Requires a positive Controlled Goods assessment as you will have direct access to hardware, software, technology or technical data controlled under the Canadian Controlled Goods Program
Required to obtain and maintain a Security Clearance at the NATO Secret Level



Key Areas of Responsibility


Technical Data Package (TDP) Management & Configuration Control: Conduct deep-dive audits of the TDP to ensure National Stock Numbers (NSNs), part numbers, and vendor references are current; perform hands-on updates to technical documentation to reflect the as-supported fleet configuration; and resolve technical discrepancies between engineering drawings and procurement/cataloguing systems.
Change Management & Workflow Coordination: Manage and maintain a dedicated JIRA board to track technical changes; coordinate DCRs from identification through approval and implementation by obtaining required inputs from LCMMs and Engineering; and identify and resolve process bottlenecks to advance stalled requests.
Data Integrity & System Administration: Reconcile data between Maximo and DRMIS to ensure consistency; execute high-accuracy data entry and maintenance within Maximo to support maintenance and supply activities; and maintain accurate supply support records derived from LSA data.
Cataloguing & Government System Liaison: Interface with the Canadian Government Cataloguing System (CGCM/CGCS) to resolve cataloguing discrepancies and facilitate new NSN assignments.
Data Analysis, Reporting & Database Management: Utilize Excel (VLOOKUPs, Pivot Tables) to conduct mass data cleanses and identify trends; develop and maintain Power BI dashboards to provide visibility into part changes and obsolescence risks; and leverage Microsoft Access to manage complex datasets requiring structured, searchable records.
Obsolescence & Supply Support Planning: Proactively identify parts approaching end-of-life, collaborate with the Obsolescence department to identify and catalogue suitable alternatives, and translate LSA data into actionable supply support records to prepare the supply chain for future maintenance requirements.



Chorus Role


Prepare and Deliver Customer Service



Minimum Qualifications


Technical System Expertise: Proven experience using both Maximo and DRMIS (or CGCS/CGCM) is mandatory.
Software Proficiency: Advanced Excel skills are essential (VLOOKUP’s, Pivot Tables, and complex data reconciliation).
Change Management: Demonstrated experience managing workflows and tasks within JIRA.
Experience: 5 years in ILS, Supply Support, or Technical Data Management within a defence or aerospace environment.
Critical Thinking: The candidate must be a self-motivated problem solver capable of investigating complex data discrepancies independently.



If you’re excited about working with Thales, but not meeting the requirements for this position, we encourage you to join our Talent Community!

Preferred Qualifications


Data Analytics & Database Tools: Proficiency in Power BI and Microsoft Access is considered a strong asset.
Defense & In-Service Support Experience: Experience with DND In-Service Support (ISS) contracts and experience supporting an operational military asset.
Logistics Support Analysis Expertise: Familiarity with Logistics Support Analysis (LSA) and exposure to Logistics Support Analysis application software such as OmegaPS.
Technical Publications & Documentation Standards: Knowledge of Canadian Forces Technical Orders (CFTOs) and government-adopted technical publications.
Digital Technical Data Standards: Knowledge of the S1000D specification and Interactive Electronic Technical Manual (IETM) format.
Language Requirements: Bilingualism (English/French).



Special Position Requirements


Schedule: Core business hours Monday – Friday, 40 hours per week.
Physical Environment: Hybrid position – which is a mix of working from home and onsite (in office, at customer site or on-board ships alongside in harbour.
Physical Demands: Predominantly office work but may be required to work in dockyards and onboard Naval ships.
Travel: Occasional domestic travel maybe required in support of the ships.



What We Offer

The reference Total Target Compensation (TTC) market range for this position, inclusive of annual base salary and the variable compensation target, is between Total Target Cash (TTC) $74,146.88– $126,733.63 CAD Annual. This reflects how companies in a similar industry and geographic region generally pay for similar jobs. This range helps the Company make pay decisions as one data point among many. Where a position falls within this range is also dependent on other factors including – but not limited to – the employee’s career path history, competencies, skills and performance, as well as the company’s annual salary budget, the customer’s program requirements, and the company’s internal equity. Thales may offer additional benefits and other compensation, depending on circumstances not related to an applicant’s status protected by local, state, or federal law.

AI

We use artificial intelligence–enabled tools as part of our recruitment process to support activities such as candidate discovery, résumé matching, and interview scheduling. These tools may help screen and assess applications and recommend potential matches based on the requirements within the job description. All hiring decisions, including candidate evaluation, selection, and disposition, are made by human recruiters. Artificial intelligence does not make hiring decisions on our behalf.

Company paid Extended Health, Dental, HSA, Life, AD&D, Short-term Disability, Cancer Care Program, travel insurance, Employee Assistance Plan and Well-Being program.
Retirement Savings Plans (RRSP, DCPP, TFSA) with a company contribution and a match to a DCPP, with no vesting period.

Title: Talent Acquisition Analytics & AI Specialist
Description:
About Boomi and What Makes Us Special

Are you ready to work at a fast-growing company where you can make a difference? Boomi, the data activation company for AI, powers the agentic enterprise by bringing data to life across the business. The award-winning Boomi Enterprise Platform is the active data foundation that delivers essential agentic infrastructure enabling organizations to drive agentic transformation and harness the power of AI with secure, scalable connectivity.  Trusted by over 30,000 customers and supported by a network of 800+ partners, Boomi helps organisations of all sizes achieve agility, efficiency, and innovation at scale. At Boomi, you’ll work with world-class people and industry-leading technology. We hire trailblazers with an entrepreneurial spirit who can solve challenging problems, make a real impact, and want to be part of building something big. If this sounds like a good fit for you, check out boomi.com  or visit our Boomi Careers page to learn more.

How You'll Make An Impact

Are you a data-fluent, technically minded analytics professional looking to build the future of Talent Acquisition (TA)? We are looking for a TA Analytics & AI Specialist to join our team during a pivotal chapter. 

In this role, you won't just pull standard reports—you will own the data pipeline from our source systems into Snowflake, build advanced dashboards in Power BI, and architect AI agents to automate high-friction TA workflows. If you are a systems thinker who thrives on writing optimized SQL, configuring API connections, and leveraging advanced prompt engineering to scale operations, this role is for you.

What You'll Do

Implementation & Data Architecture 

Act as the technical data lead, ensuring data fields, schemas, and historical data migrate with 100% integrity.
Partner with IT and Enterprise Data teams to manage our TA data pipelines inside Snowflake and write optimized SQL queries to blend disparate datasets.
Audit, clean, and rebuild calculated fields, data schemas, and dashboards to ensure absolute data integrity across platforms.

 AI Agents & Automation Orchestration

Design, test, and deploy autonomous AI agents and automated workflows to eliminate manual TA administrative tasks and maximize operational efficiency.
Leverage advanced LLMs like Claude (including Artifacts, Projects, and API connections) for rapid data prototyping, drafting complex code scripts, and building intelligent automation loops.
Find creative ways to use generative AI and API integrations to streamline TA operations, absorbing manual administrative overhead through tech.

 Cross-Functional Reporting & Predictive Analytics

Own the end-to-end delivery of weekly, monthly, and quarterly TA metrics, narrative reports, and automated dashboards for critical stakeholders, including the Head of TA, the Executive Leadership Team (ELT), Finance, HRBPs, and Regional TA Leaders.
Translate complex datasets into clean, scannable visual stories and data packets that cross-functional, non-technical stakeholders can easily action.
Move beyond standard, lagging indicators to design advanced capacity models, hiring velocity forecasts, and pipeline bottleneck analytics.
Design and execute data projects that bridge the gap between TA and the business—such as correlation studies tying interview/assessment data to on-the-job performance.

 The Experience You Bring

Experience: 2–5 years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or systems operations
The Hard Tech Stack: Strong, hands-on proficiency in writing complex SQL queries and building dynamic dashboards in Power BI or Tableau. Direct experience working with relational databases and data warehousing tools like Snowflake is highly preferred
AI & Agent Fluency: Advanced proficiency using Claude or similar LLMs to build reports, analyze complex datasets, and prototype technical data solutions. Practical understanding of prompt engineering, connecting APIs, and building AI agents/automated workflows
Systems Thinker: High attention to detail. You enjoy figuring out how "Field A" in one system impacts "Report B" in another, and you understand how data orchestration impacts downstream analytics

 Bonus Points If You Have

Exposure to HR/Talent Acquisition data structures and schemas.
Hands-on experience building integrations or orchestrating workflows using the Boomi platform. 

 Aren’t sure if you’re a match? We know that impostor syndrome and the confidence gap can prevent us from meeting spectacular candidates — so don’t hesitate to apply; you could be the perfect fit!

Compensation and Benefits 

Boomi is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. Base compensation for this position in our Vancouver hub ranges from $92,000 - $115,000 CAD annually + applicable bonus. Final compensation will be determined by various factors including the candidate’s knowledge, skills, experience, and geographic location.

 

Be Bold. Be You. Be Boomi. We take pride in our culture and core values and are committed to being a place where everyone can be their true, authentic self. Our team members are our most valuable resources, and we look for and encourage diversity in backgrounds, thoughts, life experiences, knowledge, and capabilities.  

Boomi strives to create an inclusive and accessible environment for candidates and employees. All employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications.

Title: Underwriting Analyst
Description:
We are seeking an Underwriting Analyst to join our team in Toronto, Winnipeg, or Burnaby. The Underwriting Analyst supports and enhances underwriting tools, reporting, pricing, and quoting systems while developing technical solutions for ad hoc underwriting requests.

The Underwriting Analyst Will


Analyze and interpret large and complex datasets to identify trends, risks, opportunities, and actionable insights for clients and internal stakeholders.
Develop, maintain, and enhance reporting tools, dashboards, and data models using Excel, Power Query, and other analytical tools.
Assist with the development and continuous improvement of underwriting tools, processes, reporting automation, and data management practices.
Gain familiarity with pricing analysis and evaluating new business opportunities through TPA channels in order to be able to maintain and improve existing quote tools.
Analyze claims experience, demographic data, financial results, and carrier proposals to develop recommendations and support strategic decision-making.
Collaborate with carriers, consultants, Account Managers, brokers, and internal teams to gather data and ensure accurate underwriting outcomes.
Identify plan performance, claims trends, and reporting issues, and recommend solutions to internal stakeholders.
Prepare renewal analysis and reporting packages, including support for insurer negotiations.
Support new sales initiatives and revenue growth objectives through data-driven analysis and underwriting expertise.
Provide underwriting and analytical consulting services to various stakeholders.
Maintain effective working relationships with insurers, Plan Sponsors, Plan Administrators, consultants, and internal partners.


To be successful as an Underwriting Analyst with People Corporation, you will need:


Post-secondary education in Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Finance, Actuarial Science, Business Analytics, or a related discipline; equivalent experience will also be considered.
3–5 years of experience in underwriting, insurance, group benefits, financial analysis, or a similar analytical role.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including Pivot Tables, advanced formulas, data analysis, and data clean up techniques.
Experience using Power Query to transform, validate, and automate data processes.
Experience with VBA or other automation tools is considered a strong asset.
Demonstrated experience working with large datasets and producing insightful reports, analyses, and recommendations.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills with a high degree of accuracy and attention to detail.
Ability to interpret complex data and communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
Effective verbal and written communication skills.
Strong collaboration and teamwork skills, including the ability to work across departments and with external partners.
Knowledge of group benefits, underwriting principles, and/or the insurance industry is an asset.
GBA designation or progress toward a professional industry designation is an asset.


What's In It For You


Learn by working alongside our experts
Extended health care and dental benefits
A retirement savings plan with company contributions
A suite of Health & Wellness offerings
Mental Health programs and support for you and your family
Competitive compensation


At People Corporation we are committed to helping businesses succeed. We are a national provider of benefits, retirement, wealth, wellness, and human resource solutions. Our experts and solutions serve over 20,000 clients representing nearly 3 million Canadians. We offer customized solutions designed to fit the unique needs of businesses and their employees, members and stakeholders.

Providing an inclusive, accessible environment, where all employees and clients feel valued, respected and supported is something we're committed to. We are dedicated to building a workforce that reflects the diversity of the communities in which we live, and to creating an environment where every employee has the opportunity to reach their potential. If you require an accommodation or an alternative format of any posting please reach out to careers@peoplecorporation.com

The base salary range for this position is $65,000 - $80,000 per annum.

Title: Continuous Improvement Specialist
Description:
The Continuous Improvement Specialist bridges the gap between operational data and real-world execution. This role is responsible for analyzing courier, customer, and partner performance data to uncover hidden inefficiencies, designing structured "test and learn" pilots, and validating proof-of-concepts before they are scaled across global markets. The ideal candidate thrives on turning complex data into actionable recommendations and running live experiments in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment. Ultimately, this role is critical to optimizing our global logistics footprint, directly impacting courier satisfaction, cost efficiency, and customer loyalty.

Key Responsibilities


Data Analysis & Opportunity Identification
Analyze operational performance data and key performance indicators (including courier utilization, complaints, and delivery reliability) to identify trends, bottlenecks, and service risks.
Quantify and articulate specific areas of opportunity across courier experience and support touchpoints.
Partner with data teams to enhance dashboards and reports (utilizing tools like Tableau or SQL) to back all improvement initiatives with hard data.
Lead process improvement initiatives focused on service quality, operational efficiency, capacity utilization, and cost reduction.
Facilitate process mapping, root cause analysis, Kaizen events, and problem-solving workshops.
Pilot Execution & Experimentation
Develop and deliver continuous improvement initiatives across all courier experience and courier support touchpoints, ensuring cohesive plans, ongoing measurement and impact to couriers and team members
Adopt a strict "test and learn" culture by designing, launching, and managing live pilots to continuously experiment with operational hypotheses.
Drive a globalised and aligned approach while adapting for local needs
Establish clear success metrics for pilots to quickly determine feasibility for scaling across various markets.
Monitor, validate, and report on the realized benefits, cost-effectiveness, and productivity impacts of all implemented pilot programs.
Stakeholder Engagement & Scaling
Collaborate closely with operations leaders, market teams, and global functions to ensure pilots align with business priorities and local regulations.
Clearly present data-driven insights, pilot proposals, and project milestones to key stakeholders and management.
Develop current and future-state process documentation to ensure a seamless handoff to Operations, Training and QA teams when a pilot is approved for scaling.

Qualifications & Competencies


Experience: 3–4 years of experience in continuous improvement, business analysis, operations management, or logistics.
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Operations Management, Data Analytics, Engineering, or a related field.
Technical Skills: Strong analytical thinking with a data-driven approach ; experience using Tableau, SQL, or other data analytics tools is highly preferred.
Methodologies: Practical experience with Lean principles, root cause analysis, and project management practices.
Soft Skills: Exceptional stakeholder management skills ; independent thinker who is proactive and highly comfortable navigating ambiguity.


Why work at Skip?

Skip is the kind of workplace that garnered a “Top Places to Work in Manitoba” and it was no small coincidence. We set out to make this a place our employees are proud to tell their Mothers, Fathers, friends and anyone who will listen that they work here. Skip team members feel pride knowing their input and uniqueness are not only embraced but make an impact on a major Canadian company and its satisfied customers. As the company grows, so do you — you meet and surpass new challenges every day. That’s just a small taste of what it’s like to work at one of Canada’s leading tech companies. If you’re hungry for opportunity, growth, and something meaningful in a dynamic, fun and challenging environment, we’d love to hear from you.

SKIP is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive environment where all employees feel they truly belong and where everyone is included, seen, heard and respected.

In keeping with our values, all applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of: gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, ancestry, national origin, religion, age, marital/domestic partner status, (dis)ability, neurodivergence, or any other characteristic protected by law. Should you require any accommodations throughout the hiring process, we encourage you to reach out to your talent acquisition specialist.

Note


All employees will be asked to sign a Consent for Disclosure of Personal Information in order to complete a background check. Job offers will be conditional upon results that the Company determines to be satisfactory.
This is a hybrid role, requiring 3 days per week in our Winnipeg office and 2 days per week working remotely from home.

Knowledge of Microsoft Fabric and Power Platform
Ability to gather requirements and translation business needs into analytical, reporting, automation, or low-code solutions.

Collect, clean, transform, and analyze data from multiple business systems and data sources

Branch: Electric

Affiliation: MoveUP

Employment Status: Full-Time Regular

Salary: $4,134.00 Biweekly

Short-term Incentive Eligible: No

Workplace Flexibility: No

Posting End Date: Open until filled

As the province’s largest energy provider with more than 100 years of knowledge and experience, we proudly deliver renewable energy, natural gas, electricity and propane to 1.3 million customers.

We're actively seeking new talent to join our mission of delivering a stronger energy future in B.C. As one of BC's Top Employers with a diverse team of over 2,700 employees, we are committed to a safe and inclusive culture where each of us can connect, belong, and grow. Join us, and together, let's shape a brighter future for B.C.

Responsibilities


Analyzes and translates business information requirements into logical database designs; develops the data infrastructure that best supports the business; maps data models to existing data design interfaces; conducts performance tuning and optimization.
Works with system developers to develop data models, design alternatives and approaches; reviews and revises estimates for design and implementation activities.
Monitors data base performance using various monitoring tools and develops solutions with application teams and software vendors to address and resolve performance issues for medium to large databases; monitors the growth of data bases and performs further tuning as required; analyzes operational problems and data base recoveries to determine and implement problem fixes.
Reviews technical infrastructure for single points of failure and evaluates the business requirements to ensure high availability for application, database and network systems.
Works closely with the application developer and operations teams as needed to complete the application fail-over and recovery strategy; makes recommendations for disk storage configurations.
Develops, communicates, and maintains the data architecture and data models at the conceptual, logical, and physical levels; presents the data and database architectures to project teams; coordinates work to apply data models to existing databases.
Interfaces with development team members and management to develop, upgrade, optimize and troubleshoot the database systems as required in a SQL Server and Oracle environment.
Participates in the development of enterprise data architecture, policies, standards and guidelines related to the system wide integration of data.
Evaluates and selects tools to support data modeling and design; identifies, evaluates and recommends technologies to support the database architecture.
Identifies issues of data ownership across the enterprise, including data integration issues for consolidation and transformation.
Provides direction, guidance, and technical support to clients, applications, and operations areas; co-ordinates production turnover procedures with operations and application maintenance personnel.
Performs other duties of a minor nature related to the above responsibilities, which do not affect the evaluation of the job.


Requirements

Location: Regina, SK

Reports To: Senior

Salary Range: $85,776 - $111,492

Position Overview

The Manager, Data and Analysis is responsible for collecting, analyzing, interpreting, and reporting data related to milk production, quota management, producer payments, market trends, and dairy industry performance. The role supports evidence-based decision-making, regulatory reporting, and strategic planning.

Key Responsibilities


Collect, validate, maintain, and analyze dairy industry, production, and financial data.
Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and performance metrics.
Monitor milk production, quota utilization, producer shipments, and market demand.
Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual reports for management and stakeholders.
Support forecasting related to milk production, transportation, demand, and revenue.
Create data visualizations using Power BI or similar tools.
Analyze quota, production, and market information to support regulatory programs.
Support reporting requirements for provincial and national dairy organizations.
Assist with producer payment calculations and verification processes.
Maintain data integrity, accuracy, and consistency across systems.
Identify and resolve data quality issues.
Develop reporting procedures, business rules, and documentation.
Present findings and recommendations to management and stakeholders.
Support board reporting, strategic planning, and industry analysis.


Qualifications

Education & Experience


Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Economics, Business, Finance, Mathematics, or a related field.
3–5 years of experience in data analysis, reporting, or business intelligence.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
Experience with Power BI, or data visualization tools.
Experience using SQL and relational databases.


Definite Assets


Experience with forecasting and statistical analysis.
Experience in agriculture, dairy, agri-food, or commodity marketing.
Knowledge of dairy industry regulations and quota systems.


Skills & Competencies


Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with proficiency in data analysis, modelling, and interpretation.
Ability to work with datasets related to quota, production, transportation and market trends.
Experience with tools such as Excel (advanced) and Power BI.
Strong communication skills, including the ability to translate complex analytical findings into accessible language.
High attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
Comfortable working both independently and in a collaborative team environment.


Attributes


Evidence-driven, curious, and committed to continuous improvement.
Professional, diplomatic, and capable of handling sensitive or complex issues.
Adaptable and solution-oriented with sound judgment.
Dedicated to supporting the sustainability and success of Saskatchewan’s dairy sector.


What We Offer


A dynamic and challenging work environment.
A competitive salary with a comprehensive benefits package, including a pension.
Various leave options, including vacation, scheduled days off (SDO), and family/personal leave.
Opportunities for professional growth and advancement.

The successful candidate shall be subject to a Criminal Record Check as a condition of employment.

Closing Date

The closing date for applications is August 13, 2026; however, the competition will remain open until a suitable candidate has been appointed.

We thank all applicants however only those selected for an interview will be contacted by email.

Title: Advanced Data Analyst - EA Sports FC Live
Description:
Description & Requirements

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

Advanced Data Analyst - FC Live Service Forecasting

Our FC Data & Analytics team is looking for an Advanced Analyst to join our group, leading forecasting and performance modelling for FC’s live service business. Reporting to a Senior Analytics Manager, you will be part of a growing team providing data and insights around player behaviour and live content performance within the FC franchise. We’re looking for someone who combines strong quantitative forecasting expertise with business intuition, bringing the ability to translate historical trends, player behaviour, and live content strategies into actionable projections that inform decision-making. This role sits at the intersection of analytics, strategy, and live service operations - helping shape how FC plans and measures performance at scale.

What You'll Do On Our Team


Own the forecasting framework that underpins performance measurement, planning, and strategic decision-making across FC’s live service business.
Employ an extensive toolkit of financial modelling techniques, time series analysis, and a deep knowledge of their use cases.
Develop a robust model that projects our live service funnel metrics to a high degree of fidelity, incorporating player behaviour, in-game content, and macroeconomic trends.
Collaborate with partners across Product Management, Finance, and Commercial teams to align on projections, and keep the business updated on how our latest live service performance impacts our model’s assumptions.
Establish scalable forecasting processes that enable us to work with our cross-functional partners to efficiently & effectively refine our projections over time.
Lead presentations to diverse audiences including senior and executive level management, distilling complex model results into clear insights & recommendations.
Run risk and opportunity scenarios based on live content plans, new feature additions, and other potential changes in the FC product.
Mentor and collaborate with other analysts in order to collaboratively develop our forecasts, working together to drive evolutions in our modelling in this space.


What We're Looking For


A degree in a quantitative discipline (Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Finance, or similar)
7+ years of experience in a data-driven role performing quantitative analysis with big data to help guide decisions
4+ years of experience developing financial/product performance projections and forecasts using various modelling techniques
Strong experience in statistical and/or time series modelling for predictive purposes
Expertise in SQL and working with large-scale, complex datasets
Proficient in analyzing large datasets using programmatic tools (e.g. Python, R)
Experience with data visualization software (e.g. Tableau, PowerBI)
Strong capabilities in project management processes
Very comfortable presenting analysis in an executive facing environment


Pay Transparency - North America

Compensation And Benefits

PAY RANGES


British Columbia (depending on location e.g. Vancouver vs. Victoria) *$114,300 - $156,200 CAD


Pay is just one part of the overall compensation at EA.

For Canada, we offer a package of benefits including vacation (3 weeks per year to start), 10 days per year of sick time, paid top-up to EI/QPIP benefits up to 100% of base salary when you welcome a new child (12 weeks for maternity, and 4 weeks for parental/adoption leave), extended health/dental/vision coverage, life insurance, disability insurance, retirement plan to regular full-time employees. Certain roles may also be eligible for bonus and other incentive programs.
