Title: Workforce Analyst
Description:
Enercare Inc. is one of Canada’s largest home and commercial services companies servicing over one million customers across Ontario, Manitoba, Saskatchewan, Alberta, British Columbia, Quebec and New Brunswick. Enercare is the Experts at Home, operating under several brands including Enercare, HydroSolution, and Pioneer Plumbing & Heating.




A proudly Canadian-owned company, we are the Experts at what we do and deeply care about our customers. We value a diverse, collaborative culture, and take pride in our commitment to health and safety, and knowing our work serves and supports our communities every day. No matter your role, we invest in making sure you have opportunities to grow, learn, and become the Expert you want to be.




If you are ready to become one of our Experts, we would love to hear from you.




Role: Workforce Analyst

Status: Full-Time

Location: Markham - Hybrid

Compensation: $69,136 - $110,618




Please note that the compensation range listed includes base salary and potential incentive pay. Incentives such as bonuses are not guaranteed and depend on individual performance and company results. Actual compensation within the range will be determined based on skills, experience, and qualifications.




Summary:

The Workforce Analyst – Capacity Planning is a pivotal role at Enercare HVAC Services, leveraging advanced analytics to ensure optimal workforce capacity and exceptional customer outcomes. This position is responsible for real-time monitoring of service queues, and workforce utilization, while driving predictive planning and weather-driven demand forecasting.




This role is central to balancing real-time operational demands with long-term workforce strategy. Effective monitoring, forecasting, and analytics directly influence technician efficiency, customer satisfaction, and Enercare’s ability to consistently deliver same-day, high-quality HVAC service. The Real-Time Capacity & Workforce Analyst is instrumental in maintaining operational excellence and driving proactive improvements across the organization.




Responsibilities

Monitor service queues continuously, ensuring optimal call and task routing to dispatch teams.
Identify and escalate risks of SLA breaches and service delays on all service dispatch related queues.
Track technician idle time, utilization, and route efficiency to maximize productivity.
Provide live operational recommendations to management for stabilizing service delivery.
Ensure appropriate staffing levels are in place based on forecast analysis and real time insights into service queue volumes.
Develop and maintain capacity forecasting models across intraday, short‑term, medium‑term, and long‑term horizons.
Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards and executive-level reports for operational visibility.
Generate and analyze reports from IFS systems and other operational datasets.
Conduct KPI trend analysis across productivity, service levels, and technician performance.
Perform predictive modelling to anticipate workload surges, staffing gaps, and potential service risks.
Translate complex data into actionable insights for operational leadership and decision-making.
Provide insights and recommendations on balancing technician supply vs demand by hour, skill, and geography.
Conduct scenario and sensitivity analyses to assess operational risk.
Build demand forecasting models utilizing historical data, seasonality, and weather patterns.
Support seasonal hiring and workforce ramp-up/ramp-down strategies to align with anticipated demand
Coordinate with marketing teams on maintenance campaigns and proactive service initiatives.
Collaborate with HR, operations, and vendor management teams to ensure staffing matches projected demand across all teams within end to end service lifecycle.




Qualifications:

Preferred diploma or degree in business management, analytics, data science or a related area of study
3+ years of capacity, workforce or related analytics experience
1-2 years of business process experience with a proven ability to clearly communicate and articulate business requirements and use cases
Ability to create and deliver presentations to senior leadership
Strong collaboration skills
Strong change management skills
Analytical – ability to pull multiple data sets and present areas of opportunity
Knowledge of HVAC industry an asset




Enercare is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, colour, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, citizenship, marital status, disability, pregnancy, military status, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by applicable law. Enercare’s recruitment process includes accommodation for applicants with disabilities in accordance with applicable provincial accessibility laws and regulations. All accommodations will take into account the applicant’s accessibility needs due to disability and are available upon request.




Our company leverages artificial intelligence (AI) tools as part of the candidate screening process to help review applications efficiently and fairly. These tools may assist in evaluating qualifications against job requirements. All decisions regarding hiring are ultimately made by our recruitment team. All roles posted are opportunities we’re actively recruiting for, unless stated otherwise.

Title: (CAN) Software Developer II (CA)
Description:
Position Summary...This role is responsible for enabling data-driven business solutions through analytics, data engineering, and modeling practices. The role may support data strategy, governance, and solution delivery by translating business needs into scalable, high quality data and analytical outcomes.

What You'll Do...

This role is responsible for supporting the design and delivery of analytics and data solutions that address defined business problems. The role may contribute to problem formulation, clarify requirements, and apply appropriate analytical or automation techniques to generate actionable insights aligned with intended outcomes.

This role supports business understanding by applying knowledge of operations, metrics, and practices across multiple functional areas. The role may assist with business case development, support assigned project activities, contribute to process improvements, and adapt solutions to evolving requirements under guidance.

This role enables data sourcing, transformation, and modeling activities by identifying suitable data sources, performing initial data quality checks, and developing data pipelines and models. The role may apply data integration, warehousing, and modeling techniques to support analytical use cases and scalable data structures.

This role also supports data governance, strategy, and solution implementation by following defined standards, ethical practices, and policies. The role may contribute to documentation, solution testing, deployment support, stakeholder collaboration, and knowledge sharing, and may also provide guidance or development support to others as required.

Qualifications


Advanced SQL skills using SQL Server, Teradata, or Oracle with no less than 2+ years of experience in this area
Advanced Python and Spark skills with 3+ years of experience
Knowledge of Business Warehouse of technologies, no less than 2 years of experience in this area
Practical knowledge of a 1-2 Business Intelligence tools
Dashboard optimization knowledge and experience leading to an ability of creating appealing and effective visual dashboard and reports
Nice to have: experience with data visualization software such as Tableau or similar


Minimum Education Required BSc Or Similar

Minimum Years of Experience Required 4+ years

Leadership Expectations

Respect the Individual:

Demonstrates and encourages respect for others; drives a positive associate and customer experience for all; embraces differences in people, cultures, ideas, and experiences; supports workplaces where associated feel seen and connected through a culture of belonging, so all associates thrive and perform; contributes to an environment allowing everyone to bring their best selves to work.

Demonstrates engagement and commitment to the team, developing others through feedback, coaching, mentoring, and developmental opportunities; and recognizes others’ contributions and accomplishments.

Builds strong and trusting relationships with team members and business partners; works collaboratively to achieve objectives; communicates with impact and listens attentively to a range of audiences; and demonstrates energy and positivity for own work.

Acts With Integrity

Maintains and promotes the highest standards of integrity, ethics and compliance; models the Walmart values and leads by example to foster our culture; supports Walmart’s goal of becoming a regenerative company by making a positive impact for associates, customers, and the world around us (e.g., creating a sense of belonging, eliminating waste, participating in local giving).

Follows the law, our code of conduct and company policies, and encourages others to do the same; supports an environment where associates feel comfortable sharing concerns; reinforces our culture of non-retaliation; listens to concerns raised by associates and takes action; acts with accountability for achieving results in a way that is consistent with our values.

Is consistently humble, self-aware, honest, and transparent.

Serve Our Customers

Delivers results while putting the customer first and applying an omni-merchant mindset and acts with an Every Day Low Cost mindset to drive value and Every Day Low Prices for customers.

Adopts a broad perspective that considers data, analytics, customer insights, and different parts of the business when making plans.

Strive For Excellence

Consistently raises the bar and seeks to improve; demonstrates curiosity and a growth mindset; seeks feedback, asks thoughtful questions; supports innovation and intelligent risk-taking; and exhibits resilience in the face of setbacks.

Implements and supports continuous improvements and willingly embraces new digital tools and ways of working.

Our Values

Driven Waybuilders. We pursue challenges that inspire us to build, create, and innovate.

Relentless Curiosity. We seek to understand and improve our customers’ experience.

Smart Risk-Taking. We transform risk into progress through data, experience, and intuition.

Fearless Ownership. We deliver what we promise and learn along the way.

We’re Looking For

We are seeking a Business Intelligence Engineer who is solutions-oriented, proactive, and thrives in ambiguity. This individual will not simply respond to requests but will lead initiatives, identify opportunities, and use data to unlock business growth. You will play a key role in maintaining data flow across systems, building scalable data models, and partnering across teams to inform decision-making. The ideal candidate will have 2+ years of experience in Business Intelligence and Data Warehousing, with deep expertise in SQL, data pipelines, visualization tools, and cloud-based data architecture.

You Are


Proactive. You take full ownership of your domain and drive action independently.
Insightful. You generate meaningful, data-driven insights that fuel decision-making.
Collaborative. You work closely with cross-functional stakeholders to solve complex problems and improve processes.
Technical. You have a strong command of data engineering, visualization, and analytical tools.


You Will


Take ownership of the Business Intelligence domain, surfacing insights, solving problems, and driving data-driven decisions
Partner with stakeholders in product, sales, and operations to ensure data quality, availability, and effective usage
Manipulate and transform large datasets using SQL and scripting languages to generate impactful business insights
Design, execute, and analyze A/B tests and other experiments to optimize strategies
Apply data science fundamentals to build predictive models and trend analyses
Develop scalable data models, dashboards, and reports using tools such as Domo
Continuously improve data pipelines, infrastructure, and analytical capabilities
Mentor colleagues to enhance analytics capabilities and foster a data-driven culture

2+ years of experience in Data Warehousing and Business Intelligence
Advanced SQL skills and experience with relational databases (e.g., Snowflake, Redshift, Oracle, SQL Server)
Strong experience in ETL/ELT development and data pipeline management
Proficiency in scripting languages (e.g., Python, JavaScript, Java, Scala)
Strong foundation in data modeling, governance, and structuring datasets for long-term use
Expertise in data visualization and dashboarding (Domo preferred)
Advanced spreadsheet skills (Excel, Google Sheets)
Self-starter with strong problem-solving and strategic thinking capabilities


Nice To Have’s


Experience working with DOMO specifically
Understanding of cloud-based data architectures and security best practices
Experience creating and implementing data governance strategies
Background in data science or machine learning application
Familiarity with API integrations and automation techniques

Competitive pay

Immediately vested 401K (US) or RRSP (Canada) with company match

Title: Operations Analyst
Description:
Charger logistics Inc. is a world- class asset-based carrier with locations across North America. With over 20 years of experience providing the best logistics solutions, Charger logistics has transformed into a world-class transport provider and continue to grow.

We are seeking an individual with excellent communication and leadership skills to join the company. Charger logistics invests time and support into its employees to provide them with the room to learn and grow their expertise and work their way up. We are entrepreneurial-minded organization that welcomes and support individual idea and strategies.

We are looking for a data-driven Operations Analyst to join our team. The ideal candidate will combine strong analytical skills with industry knowledge to drive continuous improvement in our damage mitigation programs.

Responsibilities:

Support Sales, Operations, and Customer Service teams with competitive pricing, in-depth performance analysis, and data-driven insights
Perform costing analysis and develop multi-scenario pricing options to support customer negotiations
Assist in building and evaluating pricing strategies; analyze volume, profit potential, and market trends
Monitor customer performance across volume, revenue, and margin; identify gaps and inconsistencies
Respond to pricing inquiries and resolve discrepancies in a timely manner
Write SQL queries to extract, transform, and analyze data from internal operational databases
Build custom reports and analytics dashboards using Tableau and other BI tools; present findings to leadership
Ensure accurate, clean reporting flows directly to leadership and upper management
Organize and maintain internal and external databases to support decision-making
Generate monthly and quarterly damage analysis reports and performance summaries for senior management
Conduct thorough investigations of equipment damage incidents — tractors, trailers, and cargo handling equipment
Analyze damage patterns and root causes; prepare detailed reports with photographic documentation and cost assessments
Review and process damage claims from initial report through full resolution
Coordinate with insurance carriers, repair vendors, and legal teams on complex claims
Negotiate settlements and manage vendor relationships for cost-effective repairs
Maintain accurate claims databases and tracking systems
Identify high-risk routes, facilities, and operational scenarios through trend analysis
Develop and maintain SOPs to reduce costs and improve operational efficiency
Create and implement driver training programs focused on damage prevention
Work with safety teams to establish best practices; conduct cost-benefit analyses for prevention initiatives
Present findings and recommendations to cross-functional teams


Requirements


Bachelor's degree in Business Analytics, Supply Chain, Statistics, Engineering, or related field.
3+ years of experience in transportation, logistics, or insurance industries is an asset.
Strong analytical skills is preferred.
Experience with claims management systems and processes.
Knowledge of commercial vehicle operations and equipment types.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Detail-oriented with strong problem-solving abilities.


Preferred Qualifications:

Experience in trucking, freight, or transportation industry.
Professional certifications in risk management or claims analysis.
Familiarity with DOT regulations and commercial vehicle safety standards.
Background in fleet management or equipment maintenance.



Benefits


Competitive Salary
Healthcare Benefit Package
Career Growth

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Role: Sr AI Ops Analyst




The Employee Experience Insights & AI Enablement Team is looking for a Senior Insights Analyst to sit at the intersection of AI strategy, IT operations, and enterprise analytics. This is not a traditional BI role. You will build the analytics foundation that helps client's Central Technology team understand, govern, and accelerate our AI investments while simultaneously driving operational intelligence across IT service delivery.

You will own the design and delivery of analytics platforms that span ITSM performance, AI cost

governance, and knowledge worker productivity measurement. You will be embedded in a team that is actively deploying agentic AI infrastructure (LiteLLM, AWS Bedrock, Claude/Anthropic), and migrating to cloud-native data platforms (Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric). Additionally, identify metrics to measure the effectiveness of the Employee Experience Insights and AI Enablement Team.




If you are energized by building from scratch, thrive in ambiguity, comfortable with a fast

moving environment, and want your analytics work to directly shape how a global company runs its AI strategy this role is for you.




What You’ll Own

1. AI Cost Analytics & Spend Governance

 Develop executive-facing dashboards (CEO/CFO-level) that connect AI spend trends to strategic

outcomes, surfacing anomalies and efficiency signals in a self-service format.

 Evolve and maintain client's AI cost analytics platform currently built on LiteLLM,

Snowflake, and LangSmith into a scalable, production-grade observability system.

 Build and own the architecture that integrates AI gateway telemetry (LiteLLM) with enterprise

data platforms (Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric) to enable per-team, per-application, and per-

model token attribution.

 Partner with Cloud Services (AI Infrastructure), InfoSec, and Finance to ensure spend

governance models are accurate, auditable, and aligned to enterprise reporting standards.




2. ITSM Analytics & Operational Intelligence

 Design, build, and maintain dashboards and datasets that drive IT service delivery performance

across the Global Service Desk, endpoint operations, and employee experience functions.

 Normalize and integrate data from ServiceNow (ITSM/HRSD), DEX Performance Analytics,

Description:
Business Intelligence & Data Specialist




Location: Toronto, ON

Work Arrangement: onsite or hybrid (depending on profile)

Compensation: $80,000 to $90,000 + discretionary bonus

Level: Mid-Level | 4+ years of experience




About the Opportunity: Our client is a growing, multi-entity organization investing heavily in data and reporting capabilities. This is a hands-on opportunity for a BI professional who wants meaningful ownership of Power BI, data modeling, and reporting.




The role will work closely with Finance, Operations, and IT to turn business requirements into reliable reporting solutions. The ideal candidate is analytical, detail-oriented, technically strong, and comfortable working independently in a fast-moving environment.




What You'll Do

Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards, reports, and data models used across the organization.
Build advanced DAX measures and use Power Query to transform and clean source data.
Write and troubleshoot SQL/T-SQL, including complex queries, views, CTEs, and stored procedures.
Connect and integrate data from multiple business systems and sources.
Maintain data models, relationships, and reporting structures to support scalable analytics.
Investigate reporting discrepancies and trace issues back to the underlying source.

Partner with Finance, Operations, and IT to translate business needs into practical technical solutions.
Manage competing priorities and communicate progress, issues, and blockers proactively.

4+ years of hands-on Power BI development in a production environment.
Experience owning the data model, not just building visualizations.
Understanding of dimensional modeling and data architecture.
Strong DAX and Power Query capabilities.
Solid SQL Server/T-SQL experience.
Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot data issues and validate reporting accuracy.
Strong attention to detail and a natural curiosity around data.
Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders.
Comfortable working independently and adapting to changing priorities.




Nice to Have

DataRails or Vena
SharePoint or Power Automate
Power BI workspace/security administration
Experience in a multi-entity or complex operating environment
Financial reporting experience
Python or SSIS

Job description:

Allstate Canada Group is currently going through an important transformation of its Data environment with the implementation of a new Policy, Claims and Billing systems while continuing to support legacy platforms. We are growing our team and are actively looking to hire an Analyst - Operational Reporting Enablement to join our team!

Reporting to the Manager, Operational Reporting Enablement, you will be providing key technical expertise to acquire, investigate, manipulate and analyze data to support Allstate Canada Group’s business plans and results. The candidate will require an in-depth understanding of the data structure and environment and understand the implications from the day-to-day insurance business. This role enables accurate, traceable, and auditable data and analytics to support ongoing, ad‑hoc, and go‑live reporting needs for internal and external stakeholders. The candidate will require an in-depth understanding of the data structure and environment as well as the implications of insurance business processes on regulatory reporting outcomes. The candidate will also foster efficiency, bring forward creative solutions, and create awareness of opportunities to strengthen data quality and enablement across reporting initiatives. A proactive approach, strong collaboration skills, and the ability to think beyond standard approaches are expected.

Accountabilities:


Interpret the data from the user interface of the different source systems and master how it translates into the backend database
Build strong relationships with Claims, Policy and Finance teams to enable their needs in operational reporting and analytics needs
Help design and provide requirements for new or enhanced operational reporting data, analytics, and supporting reporting solutions
Monitor and ensure data quality of curated operational reporting data sets using appropriate validation, reconciliation, and audit‑support methods
Be heavily involved in testing of newly integrated data sources and/or environments
Develop and improve SAS/SQL programs to perform various complex analyses
Analyze change requests in the source systems or projects, assess their impact to operational reporting data layers and downstream reporting
Collaborate with DBAs, other IT teams, Architecture as required
Implement internal data process improvement: automating manual processes, optimizing data delivery, redesign/restructure database for more efficiency
Develop expertise and aim to become a subject matter expert on the entire data and analytics ecosystem
Develops a solid tactical understating of how the business works, what their operational processes look like, and provides directions as to where data and analytics could be leveraged to make more effective data-driven decisions.
Understands data visualization and develops solutions using tools such as Power BI in order to effectively communicate and support the translation of data and analytics insights in business terms to key stakeholders.


Qualifications:


Demonstrated experience applying analytical techniques to solve business problems and support data-driven decision making, with a strong focus on accuracy and reliability
Strong business acumen and the ability to communicate insights in both technical and non-technical terms.
Skilled in data visualization tools - Power BI
Proactive, curious mindset with the ability to quickly learn and navigate new data models and evolving environments.
Hands-on experience with modern analytics ecosystems and methodologies (e.g., data lakes, data warehouses, data marts, ETL processes, data modeling, and data governance).
Proficiency in SQL/SAS programming for data development, cleansing, validation, integrity checks, reconciliation, and process optimization.
Skilled in MS Office tools, including Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and VBA.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities, with strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills; detail‑oriented with a disciplined approach to quality, controls, and documentation


Bonus Qualifications:


Proficiency in Microsoft Fabric and Python programming - understand data ingestion, data transformation, and data modeling

Responsabilités :


Interpréter les données provenant de l’interface utilisateur de nos systèmes sources et très bien comprendre leurs effets sur notre structure de la base de données.
Établir des relations solides avec les équipes des réclamations, du traitement des polices et des finances afin d’optimiser et de mettre en capacité des rapports réglementaires conformes et de répondre aux besoins en matière d’analytique.
Aider à concevoir et à fournir les exigences en vue de l’optimisation et de la mise en capacité des données opérationnelles nouvelles ou améliorées des rapports et des solutions visant les rapports de soutien.
Surveiller et assurer la qualité des ensembles de données de rapports réglementaires sélectionnés en utilisant des méthodes appropriées de validation, de rapprochement et de soutien à l’audit.
Participer très activement à la mise à l’épreuve de sources ou d’environnements de données nouvellement intégrés.
Développer et améliorer les programmes SAS/SQL pour effectuer diverses analyses complexes.
Analyser les demandes de changement dans les systèmes sources ou les projets et évaluer leurs répercussions sur les couches de données de rapports réglementaires et en aval.
Collaborer avec les administrateurs de bases de données, d’autres équipes des Technologies et des équipes des services d’architecture, au besoin.
Améliorer les processus internes relatifs aux données et les rendre plus efficaces par le biais de l’automatisation des processus manuels, de l’optimisation de la diffusion des données, ainsi que la refonte/restructuration de la base de données.
Développer une expertise dans l’écosystème entier des données et de l’analytique et viser à devenir un expert ou une experte en la matière.
Développer une solide compréhension tactique du fonctionnement de l’entreprise, de ses processus opérationnels et fournir une orientation au sujet de l’endroit où les données et les analyses pourraient être mises à profit pour prendre des décisions plus efficaces fondées sur les données.
Comprendre la visualisation des données et élaborer des solutions à l’aide d’outils comme Power BI afin de communiquer efficacement et d’appuyer la traduction des données et de l’analytique en termes opérationnels aux intervenants clés.


Exigences :


Expérience démontrée dans l’application de techniques analytiques pour résoudre des problèmes opérationnels et soutenir la prise de décision basée sur les données, en accordant une forte priorité à l’exactitude et à la fiabilité;
Solide sens des affaires et capacité à communiquer des analyses à la fois en termes techniques et non techniques;
Compétence en outils de visualisation de données tels que Power BI;
Esprit proactif et curieux avec la capacité d’apprendre rapidement et de naviguer dans de nouveaux modèles de données et des environnements en évolution;
Expérience pratique avec les écosystèmes et méthodologies analytiques modernes (par exemple, lacs de données, entrepôts de données, magasins de données, processus d’extraction, de transformation et de chargement de données, modélisation des données et gouvernance des données);
Maîtrise de la programmation SAS/SQL pour le développement des données, le nettoyage, la validation, les contrôles d’intégrité, la réconciliation et l’optimisation des processus;
Bonnes connaissances des outils MS Office, y compris Word, PowerPoint, Excel et VBA;
Excellentes capacités d’analyse et de résolution de problèmes, avec de solides compétences en communication, en collaboration et en gestion des parties prenantes; souci du détail avec une approche disciplinée de la qualité, des contrôles et de la documentation.


Exigences additionnelles :


Maîtrise de Microsoft Fabric et de la programmation Python; compréhension de l’ingestion, de la transformation et de la modélisation des données.

Description du poste :

En plus de continuer à soutenir ses plateformes existantes, le Groupe Allstate du Canada est en plein processus de transformation importante de son environnement de données dans le cadre de l’implantation de nouveaux systèmes de traitement des polices, des réclamations et de la facturation. Notre équipe, dès lors en plein essor, est à la recherche d’un ou d’une analyste - optimisation orientée rapports réglementaires!

Relevant de la directrice, optimisation orientée rapports réglementaires, le ou la titulaire de ce poste mettra à profit ses compétences techniques pour acquérir, manipuler et analyser des données, ainsi qu’enquêter sur celles-ci, afin de soutenir la production de rapports liés à la réglementation du Groupe Allstate du Canada. Le ou la candidat·e devra posséder une compréhension approfondie de la structure et de l’environnement des données ainsi que de l’incidence des processus d’assurance sur les résultats des rapports liés à la réglementation. Elle s’occupera de l’optimisation et de la mise en capacité de données et d’analyses caractérisées par leur exactitude, leur traçabilité et la possibilité de les vérifier afin de soutenir les besoins de production de rapports continus, ponctuels et de lancement pour les parties prenantes internes et externes. Il ou elle favorisera l’efficacité, proposera des solutions créatives et sensibilisera autrui aux occasions de renforcer la qualité des données et leur mise en œuvre dans le cadre des projets liés aux rapports. Une approche proactive, de solides compétences en collaboration et la capacité de penser au-delà des approches standard sont attendues.

Responsabilités :

  • Interpréter les données provenant de l’interface utilisateur de nos systèmes sources et très bien comprendre leurs effets sur notre structure de la base de données.
  • Établir des relations solides avec les équipes des réclamations, du traitement des polices et des finances afin d’optimiser et de mettre en capacité des rapports réglementaires conformes et de répondre aux besoins en matière d’analytique.
  • Aider à concevoir et à fournir les exigences en vue de l’optimisation et de la mise en capacité des données opérationnelles nouvelles ou améliorées des rapports et des solutions visant les rapports de soutien.
  • Surveiller et assurer la qualité des ensembles de données de rapports réglementaires sélectionnés en utilisant des méthodes appropriées de validation, de rapprochement et de soutien à l’audit.
  • Participer très activement à la mise à l’épreuve de sources ou d’environnements de données nouvellement intégrés.
  • Développer et améliorer les programmes SAS/SQL pour effectuer diverses analyses complexes.
  • Analyser les demandes de changement dans les systèmes sources ou les projets et évaluer leurs répercussions sur les couches de données de rapports réglementaires et en aval.
  • Collaborer avec les administrateurs de bases de données, d’autres équipes des Technologies et des équipes des services d’architecture, au besoin.
  • Améliorer les processus internes relatifs aux données et les rendre plus efficaces par le biais de l’automatisation des processus manuels, de l’optimisation de la diffusion des données, ainsi que la refonte/restructuration de la base de données.
  • Développer une expertise dans l’écosystème entier des données et de l’analytique et viser à devenir un expert ou une experte en la matière.
  • Développer une solide compréhension tactique du fonctionnement de l’entreprise, de ses processus opérationnels et fournir une orientation au sujet de l’endroit où les données et les analyses pourraient être mises à profit pour prendre des décisions plus efficaces fondées sur les données.
  • Comprendre la visualisation des données et élaborer des solutions à l’aide d’outils comme Power BI afin de communiquer efficacement et d’appuyer la traduction des données et de l’analytique en termes opérationnels aux intervenants clés.

Exigences :

  • Expérience démontrée dans l’application de techniques analytiques pour résoudre des problèmes opérationnels et soutenir la prise de décision basée sur les données, en accordant une forte priorité à l’exactitude et à la fiabilité;
  • Solide sens des affaires et capacité à communiquer des analyses à la fois en termes techniques et non techniques;
  • Compétence en outils de visualisation de données tels que Power BI;
  • Esprit proactif et curieux avec la capacité d’apprendre rapidement et de naviguer dans de nouveaux modèles de données et des environnements en évolution;
  • Expérience pratique avec les écosystèmes et méthodologies analytiques modernes (par exemple, lacs de données, entrepôts de données, magasins de données, processus d’extraction, de transformation et de chargement de données, modélisation des données et gouvernance des données);

Requisition ID: 250035

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.

The Data Platform Operations Analyst will support the capture of multiple stakeholder requirements to enable the implementation of data management principles along with modern Data Platform Management features. This role provides an excellent opportunity for individuals interested in leading governance of operations in the field of data platforms. This role requires working closely with multiple tenants’ team and assisting in various projects to support data-driven decision-making processes.

Is this role right for you? In this role, you will:


Identify trends, patterns, and outliers on the data platform along with providing improvisations to align platform with recommended solutions by collecting, cleaning and analyzing data from diverse sources to extract meaningful insights
Contribute to the development of data visualizations and presentations for internal stakeholders
Understand and collaborate on requirements from multiple key stakeholders/end users and effectively solve the requirements for Data Platform Management feature delivery
Address process automation and improvement objectives outlined by stakeholders, and collaborate with development team for design and solution feedback
Ensure Data Platform Management features are implemented correctly by working closely with development/testing teams
Work in an Agile mindset to accelerate delivery of data platform governance and management
Provide demonstrations of product features to stakeholder groups in sprint reviews / cadence(s)
Support end user onboarding, and inquiries on data platform management features
Establish and evolve end user documentation; collaborate with fellow team members to maintain documentation


Skills

Do you have the skills that will enable you to succeed in this role? We'd love to work with you if you have:


5+ years of industry experience along with a completed degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related field
3+ years of experience on Data Platforms (Data Lake and Data Warehouse), with exposure to various analytics & data project life cycle (e.g. ETL).
3+ years of experience with platform monitoring through tools (Cloudera Manager, Grafana)
2+ years of experience on big data technologies (Cloudera/Hortonworks, Spark, Hive), along with hands-on experience of data manipulation and analysis using tools such as Python or SQL
Able to implement & enhance various dashboards through data visualization tool(s) such as Tableau or PowerBI
Strong communication skills (i.e.: spoken/written/presentation) to engage wide array of users to elicit requirements and feedback
Self-motivated to solve problems and able to work collaboratively with other team members.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Strong process documentation and optimization skills to articulate workflow requirements
Understanding of data management principles would be an asset
Knowledge of agile project methodology and artifacts, on software/application development lifecycle in an agile fashion would be an asset
Knowledge of relational databases (Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL) would be an asset
Productivity/Project collaboration tools experience: Confluence, Jira, Sharepoint
Databricks experience would an asset.
Fluency in Spanish Language to converse confidently for work related communication would be an asset

Title: Business Intelligence Analyst
Description:
About Metergy Solutions Inc. (“Metergy”)
Metergy has the energy, rapid growth and excitement of a startup, together with a rock-solid, recession-proof business that has a 45 year track record. We’re a technology company that drives huge carbon emission reductions. This is a once-in-a-career opportunity.

As one of North America’s most experienced submetering providers, Metergy has brought turnkey solutions to clients for over 45 years. Metergy supplies, installs and remotely reads meters to measure individual suite consumption of electricity, water, gas, and thermal energy in multi-residential and commercial buildings, and bills and collects for the cost of commodities and administrative charges for the services provided. The business model allows for long-term recurring revenue through an innovative Submetering as a Service (SaaS) model. Submetering is proven to reduce in-suite energy consumption by 40%, driving decarbonization efforts for Metergy’s clients. This performance has enabled Metergy to issue green bonds and obtain green financing.

Positioned as the #1 submeter provider in the New York and Canadian markets, and one of the largest in North America, Metergy has more than 900,000 contracted meters, issues over 4M utility bills annually and has over 500 team members. Metergy is a portfolio company of Brookfield Infrastructure Partners. Brookfield is one of the world’s largest investors, owners and operators of infrastructure assets across the utilities, transport, energy, data and sustainable resources sectors. This sponsorship provides Metergy with access to large-scale capital, infrastructure investment expertise and global reach.

Our Mission
Provide building owners and occupants with accurate and reliable utility consumption data through market-leading expertise in turnkey submetering and billing, while fostering a workplace with inspired team members empowered to do more good.

At Metergy, we don’t just believe in our people; we champion them. When individuals feel valued, supported, and inspired to grow, incredible things happen. That’s why we’re thrilled to be recognized as a Great Place to Work for the second consecutive year! This achievement reflects our unwavering commitment to building a workplace that’s respectful, inclusive, and high-performing.

Come be part of a team that leads with passion, thrives on positivity, and delivers with precision. We’re proud of who we are and even prouder of where we’re headed.

Metergy office location is in Markham but will be moving to North York toward the end of 2026!
Position Summary
The Business Intelligence analyst is accountable for the management, development and execution of the Business Intelligence (BI) & Revenue Assurance Program, Annual Rate Increases, operations dashboards, and reporting, and overall Gross Margin (GM) Integrity.

Key Responsibilities:



Extract, clean, and analyze large volumes of data to identify trends, patterns, and insights
Conduct deep dive business intelligence analysis into operational areas within Operations to provide analysis and insight on the interplay between the various key performance indicators (e.g., workforce performance & management, Revenue Assurance, productivity, cost and quality drivers)
Effectively collaborate with stakeholders to develop insights and recommendations to enable strategic discussions among leadership
Provided monthly management insight for performance opportunities, financial Rate and Volume variance analysis to help identify resource allocation opportunities
Accountable for understanding regulation changes and launching organizational projects to implement changes in all impacted areas in submetering (includes non-responsible departments)
Plans, develops and approves all operational policies in all functional areas, with standard operating procedures, and quality management systems for revenue assurance
Monitor daily performance against key metrics to identify opportunities and anomalies
Constantly review current operational processes and be a strategic partner in making recommendations for improvements
Work with all departmental owners to implement and ensure controls are in place to support the lead to cash process for all (billing model) revenue streams
Develop and champion revenue leakage issues across organization by engaging key stakeholders on activity and resource requirements necessary to drive revenue maximization
Stay updated on the latest trends in Business Intelligence, data analytics and emerging technologies
Evaluate and incorporate new tools or techniques that could enhance BI capabilities




Qualifications:



Degree in Statistics, Computer Science, Math, Economics, Business or other quantitative fields
High proficiency in data modelling and analysis with demonstrated acumen using the following tools Excel, PowerBI (Power Query) & SQL
Basic knowledge of Python is an asset
2+ years of experience in Data Analytics, Operations, or relevant work experience at a fast-growing utility company is preferred
Preference to additional training with Data Analytics / IT
Preference for experience with data visualization tools
Excellent collaboration skills to build strong working partnerships with stakeholders
Understanding and experience working with statistical revenue and costing information to provide business insight and opportunities to reduce cost
Strong technical skills to mine large volumes of data
Ability to apply superior data knowledge & discovery skills into building effective analysis
Ability to conduct basic statistical and correlation analysis to identify patterns and trends
Industry or working experience with customer billing environments with large transaction volumes such as Utility or Telecommunications,
Attention to detail and quality, strong time management and project/work planning skills
Proven ability to work with and deliver Industry Leading Best-in-Class reporting and analytical solutions
Excellent interpersonal and customer interaction skills to include communications, presentation and conflict resolution skills




Any shown ranges reflects base salary. We offer discretionary bonus and additional benefits, including health and retirement, as part of our total rewards program.

Benefits & Perks


Fully company covered heath and dental benefits from day 1
Company funded Health Spending Account
Plan for retirement with Deferred Profit Sharing Plan (DPSP) and RRSP Matching
Grow with us! We provide support for continuous learning
Paid personal and sick days on top of your vacation
Summer hours to enjoy the weather
Company sponsored social events & more!

Description:
Data Scientist, Analytics

(Remote, Canada)

Events in recent years have made us all too familiar with the havoc that natural disasters can wreak, and the increasing frequency and intensity with which they are occurring. Despite record levels of losses, conventional methods of risk modeling continue to paint at best an incomplete picture of these threats.

ZestyAI uses novel data gathering and data science methods to produce higher quality information about the risks to property from catastrophes like storms and wildfires. While AI alone may not be able to thwart these disasters, it can help us become more prepared for them, and ultimately that will lead to better outcomes.

As a Data Scientist, Analytics, you will work closely with product, engineering, and machine learning teams to apply data science to complex product and business problems.You will use diverse data sources to evaluate product performance, generate actionable insights, and support evidence-based decision-making across ZestyAI's products.You will also help establish the analytical processes, monitoring frameworks, and best practices needed to maintain product quality and scale the organization. You thrive in a collaborative, creative environment that moves fast and are comfortable implementing structures and processes to help the company scale.

The Opportunity:


Translate product management, engineering, and business questions into structured analytical approaches, applying appropriate statistical, experimental, and data science methods to measure product performance and guide decision-making
Own data quality of ZestyAI data products
Spearhead product monitoring and quality assurance by designing and owning dashboards and KPIs
Develop automated ETL and data workflows
Iterate rapidly on everything; all of the above happens in a fast-paced business-driven environment that you must be comfortable with


What You Bring to the ZestyAI Team:


BA / BS degree in Math, Physics, Engineering, Computer Science, or Economics
MS or Ph.D. is certainly a bonus
2–3 years of experience in analytics, data science, or related roles, including experience building data workflows, defining metrics, and developing dashboards or monitoring tools
Strong organizational and management skills with past experiences implementing best practices and processes
Strong analytical problem-solving skills and comfort working with ambiguous, cross-functional questions
Proficient in SQL
Proficient in programming language (Python or R)
Experience working with cloud platforms (Google Cloud Platform, AWS, etc)
Must be legally eligible to work in Canada

Nice to Have:


1 - 2 years of experience working with imagery and/or geospatial data
Working knowledge of modeling framework and performance metrics

DBT Experience

Data Visualization Experience

Market competitive comp and equity incentives to give you a stake in our future

Title: Pricing Analyst
Description:
Clio is the global leader in legal AI technology, empowering legal professionals and law firms of every size to work smarter, faster, and more securely.

We are transforming the legal experience for all by bettering the lives of legal professionals while increasing access to justice.

Summary:

We are currently seeking a Pricing Analyst to join our Marketing Team in Vancouver, Calgary, or Toronto.

What your team does:

The Monetization team leads Clio’s AI-first pricing and packaging strategy and execution across all regions, including initiatives for new and existing customer segments, products, plans, bundles and cross-portfolio upgrades. This is a highly strategic team contributing to Clio’s success in a highly cross functional role working across nearly all functions at Clio.

Who you are:

You're analytical and curious about customer behaviour, comfortable working through large volumes of data to find the story in the numbers. You like turning ad hoc, manual processes into something repeatable, and you enjoy building partnerships across the business. You're also detail-oriented, organized, and self-managing, with a habit of verifying your own work. You build in checks, flag what looks off, and hold a high bar for accuracy.

What you’ll work on:

As a Pricing Analyst, you'll own the execution and measurement of pricing changes, from account migrations in our billing systems and Salesforce to the modeling, reporting, and testing that tell us whether a change worked.


Own recurring price-based account migrations end to end, from cohort segmentation and batch processing through QA and post-migration validation, and build the formula-driven templates that make them repeatable and auditable at scale
Support the models that price new releases and size the impact of changes on existing customers, and help package the findings into recommendations
Partner with Data & Insights to build the dashboards and automated reporting that track realized vs. list price, discount depth, and ARPA by cohort, so the team catches problems early
Work across Billing Ops, Sales Ops, CS Ops, and Enablement to automate the manual steps in pricing execution and equip Sales and CS when prices change
Help design and run in-market price tests to validate willingness to pay before changes roll out broadly
Use AI tooling to compress the analysis and execution cycle, from generating and QA'ing migration cohorts to automating the handoff into Salesforce and building intuitive internal pricing calculators and price sheets


What you may have:


2+ years in financial or business analysis and modeling, preferably for B2B SaaS, including heavy spreadsheet work with nested logic and QA across large datasets
Hands-on experience in a subscription billing system (Zuora, Stripe, Chargebee, or similar) and a CRM like Salesforce, including bulk updates and data validation across large account sets
2+ years building dashboards and queries in Looker, Tableau, or similar
Experience with pricing analysis across SaaS charge models, such as subscription, usage-based, tiered, and per-seat
Experience running cross-functional projects in Asana or similar, coordinating with ops and GTM teams to keep work moving
Strong communication skills, with the ability to deliver clear status updates, business insights, and recommendations in written, presentation, and spoken form
Experience using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) to support analysis, workflows, and day-to-day productivity


Serious bonus points if you have:


Experience with Workato or similar integration and task-automation tools
Prior experience executing pricing or plan migrations at scale


This role is a backfill for an existing position.

What you will find here:

Compensation is one of the main components of Clio’s Total Rewards Program. We have developed a series of programs and processes to ensure we are creating fair and competitive pay practices that form the foundation of our human and high-performing culture.

Some highlights of our Total Rewards program include:


Competitive, equitable salary with top-tier health benefits, dental, and vision insurance
Hybrid work environment, with expectation for local Clions (Vancouver, Calgary, Toronto, Dublin, London, New York City and Sydney) to be in office min. twice per week.
Flexible time off policy, with an encouraged 20 days off per year.
$2000 annual counseling benefit
RRSP matching and RESP contribution
Clioversary recognition program with special acknowledgement at 3, 5, 7, and 10 years


The expected salary range for this role is $97,300 to $131,700 CAD. Initial placement within the range is informed by geographic region, experience, and skillset, with room to progress as impact and tenure grow. Final offer amounts will vary based on candidate profile.

This position is responsible for real-time monitoring of service queues, and workforce utilization, while driving predictive planning and weather-driven demand forecasting.




This role is central to balancing real-time operational demands with long-term workforce strategy. Effective monitoring, forecasting, and analytics directly influence technician efficiency, customer satisfaction, and Enercare’s ability to consistently deliver same-day, high-quality HVAC service. The Real-Time Capacity & Workforce Analyst is instrumental in maintaining operational excellence and driving proactive improvements across the organization.




Responsibilities

Monitor service queues continuously, ensuring optimal call and task routing to dispatch teams.
Identify and escalate risks of SLA breaches and service delays on all service dispatch related queues.
Track technician idle time, utilization, and route efficiency to maximize productivity.
Provide live operational recommendations to management for stabilizing service delivery.
Ensure appropriate staffing levels are in place based on forecast analysis and real time insights into service queue volumes.
Develop and maintain capacity forecasting models across intraday, short‑term, medium‑term, and long‑term horizons.
Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards and executive-level reports for operational visibility.
Generate and analyze reports from IFS systems and other operational datasets.
Conduct KPI trend analysis across productivity, service levels, and technician performance.
Perform predictive modelling to anticipate workload surges, staffing gaps, and potential service risks.
Translate complex data into actionable insights for operational leadership and decision-making.
Provide insights and recommendations on balancing technician supply vs demand by hour, skill, and geography.
Conduct scenario and sensitivity analyses to assess operational risk.
Build demand forecasting models utilizing historical data, seasonality, and weather patterns.
Support seasonal hiring and workforce ramp-up/ramp-down strategies to align with anticipated demand
Coordinate with marketing teams on maintenance campaigns and proactive service initiatives.
Collaborate with HR, operations, and vendor management teams to ensure staffing matches projected demand across all teams within end to end service lifecycle.




Qualifications:

Preferred diploma or degree in business management, analytics, data science or a related area of study
3+ years of capacity, workforce or related analytics experience
1-2 years of business process experience with a proven ability to clearly communicate and articulate business requirements and use cases
Ability to create and deliver presentations to senior leadership
Strong collaboration skills
Strong change management skills
Analytical – ability to pull multiple data sets and present areas of opportunity
Knowledge of HVAC industry an asset

Job description:

Allstate Canada Group is currently going through an important transformation of its Data environment with the implementation of a new Policy, Claims and Billing systems while continuing to support legacy platforms. We are growing our team and are actively looking to hire an Analyst - Operational Reporting Enablement to join our team!

Reporting to the Manager, Operational Reporting Enablement, you will be providing key technical expertise to acquire, investigate, manipulate and analyze data to support Allstate Canada Group’s business plans and results. The candidate will require an in-depth understanding of the data structure and environment and understand the implications from the day-to-day insurance business. This role enables accurate, traceable, and auditable data and analytics to support ongoing, ad‑hoc, and go‑live reporting needs for internal and external stakeholders. The candidate will require an in-depth understanding of the data structure and environment as well as the implications of insurance business processes on regulatory reporting outcomes. The candidate will also foster efficiency, bring forward creative solutions, and create awareness of opportunities to strengthen data quality and enablement across reporting initiatives. A proactive approach, strong collaboration skills, and the ability to think beyond standard approaches are expected.

Accountabilities:


Interpret the data from the user interface of the different source systems and master how it translates into the backend database
Build strong relationships with Claims, Policy and Finance teams to enable their needs in operational reporting and analytics needs
Help design and provide requirements for new or enhanced operational reporting data, analytics, and supporting reporting solutions
Monitor and ensure data quality of curated operational reporting data sets using appropriate validation, reconciliation, and audit‑support methods
Be heavily involved in testing of newly integrated data sources and/or environments
Develop and improve SAS/SQL programs to perform various complex analyses
Analyze change requests in the source systems or projects, assess their impact to operational reporting data layers and downstream reporting
Collaborate with DBAs, other IT teams, Architecture as required
Implement internal data process improvement: automating manual processes, optimizing data delivery, redesign/restructure database for more efficiency
Develop expertise and aim to become a subject matter expert on the entire data and analytics ecosystem
Develops a solid tactical understating of how the business works, what their operational processes look like, and provides directions as to where data and analytics could be leveraged to make more effective data-driven decisions.
Understands data visualization and develops solutions using tools such as Power BI in order to effectively communicate and support the translation of data and analytics insights in business terms to key stakeholders.


Qualifications:


Demonstrated experience applying analytical techniques to solve business problems and support data-driven decision making, with a strong focus on accuracy and reliability
Strong business acumen and the ability to communicate insights in both technical and non-technical terms.
Skilled in data visualization tools - Power BI
Proactive, curious mindset with the ability to quickly learn and navigate new data models and evolving environments.
Hands-on experience with modern analytics ecosystems and methodologies (e.g., data lakes, data warehouses, data marts, ETL processes, data modeling, and data governance).
Proficiency in SQL/SAS programming for data development, cleansing, validation, integrity checks, reconciliation, and process optimization.
Skilled in MS Office tools, including Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and VBA.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities, with strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills; detail‑oriented with a disciplined approach to quality, controls, and documentation


Bonus Qualifications:


Proficiency in Microsoft Fabric and Python programming - understand data ingestion, data transformation, and data modeling

Description du poste :

En plus de continuer à soutenir ses plateformes existantes, le Groupe Allstate du Canada est en plein processus de transformation importante de son environnement de données dans le cadre de l’implantation de nouveaux systèmes de traitement des polices, des réclamations et de la facturation. Notre équipe, dès lors en plein essor, est à la recherche d’un ou d’une analyste - optimisation orientée rapports réglementaires!

Relevant de la directrice, optimisation orientée rapports réglementaires, le ou la titulaire de ce poste mettra à profit ses compétences techniques pour acquérir, manipuler et analyser des données, ainsi qu’enquêter sur celles-ci, afin de soutenir la production de rapports liés à la réglementation du Groupe Allstate du Canada. Le ou la candidat·e devra posséder une compréhension approfondie de la structure et de l’environnement des données ainsi que de l’incidence des processus d’assurance sur les résultats des rapports liés à la réglementation. Elle s’occupera de l’optimisation et de la mise en capacité de données et d’analyses caractérisées par leur exactitude, leur traçabilité et la possibilité de les vérifier afin de soutenir les besoins de production de rapports continus, ponctuels et de lancement pour les parties prenantes internes et externes. Il ou elle favorisera l’efficacité, proposera des solutions créatives et sensibilisera autrui aux occasions de renforcer la qualité des données et leur mise en œuvre dans le cadre des projets liés aux rapports. Une approche proactive, de solides compétences en collaboration et la capacité de penser au-delà des approches standard sont attendues.

Responsabilités :


Interpréter les données provenant de l’interface utilisateur de nos systèmes sources et très bien comprendre leurs effets sur notre structure de la base de données.
Établir des relations solides avec les équipes des réclamations, du traitement des polices et des finances afin d’optimiser et de mettre en capacité des rapports réglementaires conformes et de répondre aux besoins en matière d’analytique.
Aider à concevoir et à fournir les exigences en vue de l’optimisation et de la mise en capacité des données opérationnelles nouvelles ou améliorées des rapports et des solutions visant les rapports de soutien.
Surveiller et assurer la qualité des ensembles de données de rapports réglementaires sélectionnés en utilisant des méthodes appropriées de validation, de rapprochement et de soutien à l’audit.
Participer très activement à la mise à l’épreuve de sources ou d’environnements de données nouvellement intégrés.
Développer et améliorer les programmes SAS/SQL pour effectuer diverses analyses complexes.
Analyser les demandes de changement dans les systèmes sources ou les projets et évaluer leurs répercussions sur les couches de données de rapports réglementaires et en aval.
Collaborer avec les administrateurs de bases de données, d’autres équipes des Technologies et des équipes des services d’architecture, au besoin.
Améliorer les processus internes relatifs aux données et les rendre plus efficaces par le biais de l’automatisation des processus manuels, de l’optimisation de la diffusion des données, ainsi que la refonte/restructuration de la base de données.
Développer une expertise dans l’écosystème entier des données et de l’analytique et viser à devenir un expert ou une experte en la matière.
Développer une solide compréhension tactique du fonctionnement de l’entreprise, de ses processus opérationnels et fournir une orientation au sujet de l’endroit où les données et les analyses pourraient être mises à profit pour prendre des décisions plus efficaces fondées sur les données.
Comprendre la visualisation des données et élaborer des solutions à l’aide d’outils comme Power BI afin de communiquer efficacement et d’appuyer la traduction des données et de l’analytique en termes opérationnels aux intervenants clés.


Exigences :


Expérience démontrée dans l’application de techniques analytiques pour résoudre des problèmes opérationnels et soutenir la prise de décision basée sur les données, en accordant une forte priorité à l’exactitude et à la fiabilité;
Solide sens des affaires et capacité à communiquer des analyses à la fois en termes techniques et non techniques;
Compétence en outils de visualisation de données tels que Power BI;
Esprit proactif et curieux avec la capacité d’apprendre rapidement et de naviguer dans de nouveaux modèles de données et des environnements en évolution;
Expérience pratique avec les écosystèmes et méthodologies analytiques modernes (par exemple, lacs de données, entrepôts de données, magasins de données, processus d’extraction, de transformation et de chargement de données, modélisation des données et gouvernance des données);
Maîtrise de la programmation SAS/SQL pour le développement des données, le nettoyage, la validation, les contrôles d’intégrité, la réconciliation et l’optimisation des processus;
Bonnes connaissances des outils MS Office, y compris Word, PowerPoint, Excel et VBA;
Excellentes capacités d’analyse et de résolution de problèmes, avec de solides compétences en communication, en collaboration et en gestion des parties prenantes; souci du détail avec une approche disciplinée de la qualité, des contrôles et de la documentation.


Exigences additionnelles :


Maîtrise de Microsoft Fabric et de la programmation Python; compréhension de l’ingestion, de la transformation et de la modélisation des données.

Skills

Elle s’occupera de l’optimisation et de la mise en capacité de données et d’analyses caractérisées par leur exactitude, leur traçabilité et la possibilité de les vérifier afin de soutenir les besoins de production de rapports continus, ponctuels et de lancement pour les parties prenantes internes et externes. Il ou elle favorisera l’efficacité, proposera des solutions créatives et sensibilisera autrui aux occasions de renforcer la qualité des données et leur mise en œuvre dans le cadre des projets liés aux rapports. Une approche proactive, de solides compétences en collaboration et la capacité de penser au-delà des approches standard sont attendues.

Responsabilités :

  • Interpréter les données provenant de l’interface utilisateur de nos systèmes sources et très bien comprendre leurs effets sur notre structure de la base de données.
  • Établir des relations solides avec les équipes des réclamations, du traitement des polices et des finances afin d’optimiser et de mettre en capacité des rapports réglementaires conformes et de répondre aux besoins en matière d’analytique.
  • Aider à concevoir et à fournir les exigences en vue de l’optimisation et de la mise en capacité des données opérationnelles nouvelles ou améliorées des rapports et des solutions visant les rapports de soutien.
  • Surveiller et assurer la qualité des ensembles de données de rapports réglementaires sélectionnés en utilisant des méthodes appropriées de validation, de rapprochement et de soutien à l’audit.
  • Participer très activement à la mise à l’épreuve de sources ou d’environnements de données nouvellement intégrés.
  • Développer et améliorer les programmes SAS/SQL pour effectuer diverses analyses complexes.
  • Analyser les demandes de changement dans les systèmes sources ou les projets et évaluer leurs répercussions sur les couches de données de rapports réglementaires et en aval.
  • Collaborer avec les administrateurs de bases de données, d’autres équipes des Technologies et des équipes des services d’architecture, au besoin.
  • Améliorer les processus internes relatifs aux données et les rendre plus efficaces par le biais de l’automatisation des processus manuels, de l’optimisation de la diffusion des données, ainsi que la refonte/restructuration de la base de données.
  • Développer une expertise dans l’écosystème entier des données et de l’analytique et viser à devenir un expert ou une experte en la matière.
  • Développer une solide compréhension tactique du fonctionnement de l’entreprise, de ses processus opérationnels et fournir une orientation au sujet de l’endroit où les données et les analyses pourraient être mises à profit pour prendre des décisions plus efficaces fondées sur les données.
  • Comprendre la visualisation des données et élaborer des solutions à l’aide d’outils comme Power BI afin de communiquer efficacement et d’appuyer la traduction des données et de l’analytique en termes opérationnels aux intervenants clés.

Exigences :

  • Expérience démontrée dans l’application de techniques analytiques pour résoudre des problèmes opérationnels et soutenir la prise de décision basée sur les données, en accordant une forte priorité à l’exactitude et à la fiabilité;
  • Solide sens des affaires et capacité à communiquer des analyses à la fois en termes techniques et non techniques;
  • Compétence en outils de visualisation de données tels que Power BI;
  • Esprit proactif et curieux avec la capacité d’apprendre rapidement et de naviguer dans de nouveaux modèles de données et des environnements en évolution;
  • Expérience pratique avec les écosystèmes et méthodologies analytiques modernes (par exemple, lacs de données, entrepôts de données, magasins de données, processus d’extraction, de transformation et de chargement de données, modélisation des données et gouvernance des données);
  • Maîtrise de la programmation SAS/SQL pour le développement des données, le nettoyage, la validation, les contrôles d’intégrité, la réconciliation et l’optimisation des processus;
  • Bonnes connaissances des outils MS Office, y compris Word, PowerPoint, Excel et VBA;
  • Excellentes capacités d’analyse et de résolution de problèmes, avec de solides compétences en communication, en collaboration et en gestion des parties prenantes; souci du détail avec une approche disciplinée de la qualité, des contrôles et de la documentation.

Exigences additionnelles :

  • Maîtrise de Microsoft Fabric et de la programmation Python; compréhension de l’ingestion, de la transformation et de la modélisation des données.

Si vous postulez pour un poste ouvert aux candidats à travers le Canada, sauf indication contraire, de solides compétences en anglais sont requises pour une communication efficace régulière avec les clients, les conseillers ou les employés à l'échelle nationale.

Title: Data Analyst, Investment Data Management
Description:
Interested in joining one of Canada’s top performing asset managers? We are looking for a Data Analyst for an existing vacancy on our Investment Data Management (IDM) team. The IDM Team resides within the middle office and is responsible for managing data centric processes and data quality that supports the investment management business. Connor, Clark & Lunn Financial Group Ltd. (CCLFG) manages a wide range of global assets and heavily relies on the output of the Data Management Team for a variety of functions from the front office to the back. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a dynamic strategic team whose scope and importance continues to grow enterprise wide. We place a high value on maintaining an entrepreneurial spirit and creating a culture where each of us has opportunities to succeed. We are a solution orientated and collaborative team seeking like-minded individuals who thrive in a challenging and dynamic environment. Our offices currently operate on a hybrid model with a combination of in-office and remote working days throughout the week.

What You Will Do


Maintain and validate accuracy of equity/fixed income/derivative data across multiple systems/databases to enable Investment Manager modeling, trading, and risk monitoring.
Manage and enable a myriad of scheduled processes for vendor systems, internal and market data transfers, valuation, and benchmarking data inputs to the investment process.
Deliver timely data signoffs to investment teams; develop and analyze data-quality exceptions and ensure timely resolution.
Provide analysis on operational needs, ad-hoc data/data-history requests for multiple business partners to support pre- and post-trade portfolio management functions.
Identify process/workflow improvements to increase operational efficiency, mitigate risk, improve data-quality, and increase service levels provided to stakeholders.
Supporter of other operational or engineering staff, senior or managers on a variety of ad-hoc tasks and projects.


What You Bring


You have a degree in Finance, Commerce, Business Administration, Business Operations, or a related field. Relevant designation, such as the MBA, CFA, or FRM is an asset.
2-6 years of relevant experience in the investment management industry with exposure to securities data, data quality and process management. Hands-on experience working with Bloomberg, FTSE, ICE Bond Edge, Charles River and related financial tools, platforms is an asset
You possess an analytical mindset and able to break down complex processes into components to logically deduce the root cause of issues in data and technology.
You have a collaborative spirit that helps you to work well with others and you communicate effectively to team/cross-team members, and upward to key stakeholders.
You have a passion for advancing the quality, scale, and efficiency of data processes and can take ownership of multiple processes with keen attention to detail.
You constantly take a critical eye to processes with the goal of finding improvement opportunities and bring an ability to manage multiple projects.


The salary range for this position is $60,000-$90,000. The salary range provided reflects the base salary range for this position as required by legislation. In addition, there is an annual performance bonus which contributes to the total compensation for this position. Further questions may be directed to the HR team during the interview process.

  

For a closer look at how you can build your career with us, we invite you to explore cclgroup.com. 

CC&L Financial Group is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation or expression, disability, or age. 

Your application will be reviewed by a member of the hiring team - AI is not used in the screening, assessment or selection of applications at this time.

Title: Analyst, Retail Labour & Expenses
Description:
WHO WE ARE



Indigo is a physical and digital place inspired by and filled with books, ideas, beautifully designed lifestyle products, and the creative people who help make it all happen. We believe in real books, living life fully and generously, being kind to each other and to the environment, and that stories – big and little – connect us. Indigo is our customer’s happy place – for joyful moments of discovery and to connect with people who share their passion for reading, their belief in ideas, and their commitment to making the world a better and more beautiful place.



OUR GUIDING PRINCIPLES



Our Mission is to inspire reading and enrich the lives of booklovers. As such, we believe in the power of people and their stories. We aim to attract top talent, nurture the potential of our employees, and create space for everyone to thrive. Our Guiding Principles are the few key ideas that are meant to influence everything we do, every day.



We Will Hire, Inspire, Promote and Retain the Best – A’s Hire A’s.
We Will be Customer Centric.
We Will Be Data Driven – System Thinking – Entrepreneurial.
We are Committed to True and Shared Value Creation.
We Will be Human-Centered and AI Enabled.
We are Committed to Caring About Each Other, Our Communities, Our Environment.


Job Description



MISSION



The Labour Analyst, Retail Labour and Expenses is accountable for supporting Indigo’s strategic objectives through labour planning, expense forecasting, financial analysis, and operational reporting that optimize store profitability while balancing the operational and customer experience requirements across the store network.



KEY PERFORMANCE METRICS



Monthly Forecast Accuracy for Wage Ratio, Average Wage and Labour Spend
Annual Labour and Expense Plan Accuracy
EBITDA
Indigo Help SLAs

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES – what the work is



Budgeting:
Create accurate pre-season store labour and expense budgets and in-season forecasts using historical analysis, store performance trends, operational drivers, and industry research, with focus on productivity, customer experience, and EBITDA
Support other SMEs in the creation of Retail OPEX budgets and facilities budgets
Collaborate with the Workforce Management lead to ensure labour planning models and system drivers remain aligned with business needs, leveraging analysis of store performance and forecast variances to improve planning accuracy
Modelling:
Create and continuously evolve labour models for Small Format and Large Format stores to ensure efficient use of labour while maintaining operational and customer experience standards
Create and continuously evolve store development financial models to determine the most profitable product mix and resulting budgets for new, renovation and relocation stores, with significant impact to budget and limited time to payback
Utilize customer data to assess over and under performance across the store base
Provide analytical support and backup coverage for sales forecasting models and reporting processes as required
Analytics:
Design and maintain labour, productivity, and expense reporting which supports the Field Leadership and stores in driving KPI performance and managing expenses in line with balanced scorecard expectations
Monitor and analyze reporting to identify business opportunities and present these findings weekly
Deliver timely and accurate reporting to end users
Provide analysis on customer data to support initiatives which drive traffic, retain or grow customer base
Ensure continuity of data projections across organization by partnering cross-functionally to facilitate the compilation of knowledge from department SMEs to arrive at accurate data projections
Training:
Develop training resources to ensure store teams are fluent at using the reports available to them to drive KPI performance and manage expenses
Shares technical knowledge with others and actively seeks to learn from those more knowledgeable than self.
Act as the designated backup for the Workforce Management lead, maintaining knowledge of workforce management systems, forecasting methodologies, and operational processes to ensure effective support and business continuity
Support the drive for a customer centric culture within stores and Home Office by consistently modelling customer-focused behavior, integrating customer needs into decision-making, and proactively anticipating and addressing customer expectations
Identify and communicate continuous improvement opportunities, challenging the status quo and proactively resolving issues across all systems and functions within the area of responsibility
Encourage others to freely share their point of view and be open to feedback

SCOPE



Reports to: Director, Retail Operations & Profitability



Manager once Removed (MOR): VP, Retail Experience & Operations



KEY RELATIONSHIPS



Internal:



Chief Customer Officer and SVP Retail,
Upper Field Leaders and Store Leadership teams
Human Resources and Total Rewards team
Employee Communications team
Finance and Accounting team
Business Intelligence and Customer Insights teams
Merchandise and Planning teams

External:



Vendors


Qualifications



QUALIFICATIONS



University degree in the field of Business or Finance is required
3-5 years of experience directly executing a Retail or Labour Analytics role is required
Proficient in data management required: demonstrated ability to create effective financial and operational solutions from large data sets using Excel and various databases
Strong financial modelling and analysis skills
