Title: Evaluation and Measurement Analyst
Description:
Overview

At KPMG in Canada, our people bring their unique perspectives to Canada’s most important challenges. Here, you can build momentum that reaches beyond our business, develop skills for the future, and take ownership of your career with support at every stage. Join a firm where your career can make a difference.

The Training Evaluation & Measurement Analyst is responsible for assessing the effectiveness and impact of learning programs by supporting the design of measurement strategies, analyzing training data, and providing actionable insights to improve learning outcomes and business performance. This role works closely with course owners, SMEs, and stakeholders to ensure training delivers measurable value.

Data Collection & Analysis


Collect and validate data from multiple sources (e.g., LMS, surveys, assessments)
Analyze quantitative and qualitative data to identify trends, gaps, and improvement opportunities
Perform statistical analysis (e.g., pass rates, item difficulty, distractor analysis) to assess assessment quality


Reporting & Insights


Review dashboards and reports to communicate training performance and outcomes
Translate data into clear, actionable insights for course owners and stakeholders
Provide recommendations for course improvements based on findings


Continuous Improvement


Monitor training effectiveness throughout the lifecycle (pre-, during, and post-delivery)
Partner with SMEs and course owners to refine content, assessments, and delivery methods
Support post-course evaluations and follow-up analysis (e.g., behavior and performance impact)


What You Will Do

As a Training Evaluation & Measurement Analyst, you will play a key role in helping KPMG Business School understand and improve the effectiveness of its learning programs. Working closely with course owners, subject matter experts (SMEs), and other stakeholders, you will transform learning data into meaningful insights that drive better learning experiences and business outcomes.

In this role, you will


Collect, validate, and analyze data from multiple sources, including learning management systems, surveys and assessments.
Identify trends, patterns, learning gaps, and opportunities for improvement through quantitative and qualitative analysis.
Conduct measurement and evaluation activities, including assessment analysis, learner feedback reviews, pass rate analysis, item difficulty reviews, and other evaluation methodologies.
Maintain reporting dashboards and metrics to monitor learning effectiveness and learner performance.
Translate complex data into clear, actionable insights and recommendations for stakeholders and course owners.
Support the evaluation of learning initiatives throughout the training lifecycle, from pre-deployment through post-course analysis.
Collaborate with course owners and SMEs to identify opportunities to improve course content, assessments, learner engagement, and overall learning impact.
Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of evaluation frameworks, measurement strategies, and reporting standards.
Support the preparation and presentation of findings, recommendations, and evaluation results to various stakeholders.
Assist with special projects and initiatives related to learning analytics, measurement, and continuous improvement.


What You Bring To The Role

You are a curious and analytical professional who enjoys turning data into meaningful insights. You have a passion for learning and development and are motivated by the opportunity to improve learning experiences through evidence-based decision-making.

You bring


3 years experience in learning analytics, training evaluation, data analysis, research, or a related field.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify trends, interpret data, and make practical recommendations.
Experience working with data visualization and reporting tools such as Excel, Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms.
Knowledge of learning measurement and evaluation methodologies, such as the Kirkpatrick Model or other evaluation frameworks, is an asset.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy and quality.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building skills, with the ability to work across teams and influence decision-making through data-driven insights.
Experience working with Learning Management Systems (LMS) and learning technologies is considered an asset.
A continuous improvement mindset and a passion for enhancing learning outcomes through measurement and evaluation.

Title: Data Scientist, ADE Analytics
Description:
Description

The Alexa Daily Essentials team delivers experiences critical to how customers interact with Alexa as part of daily life. Alexa users engage with our products across experiences connected to Timers, Alarms, Calendars, Food, and News. Our experiences include critical time saving techniques, ad-supported news audio and video, and in-depth kitchen guidance aimed at serving the needs of the family from sunset to sundown.

As a Data Scientist on our team, you'll work with complex data, develop statistical methodologies, and provide critical product insights that shape how we build and optimize our solutions. You will work closely with your Analytics and Applied Science teammates. You will build frameworks and mechanisms to scale data solutions across our organization. If you are passionate about redefining how AI can improves everyone's daily life, we’d love to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities

Key job responsibilities

Problem-Solving


Analyze complex data to identify patterns, inform product decisions, and understand root causes of anomalies.
Develop analysis and modeling approaches to drive product and engineering actions to identify patterns, insights, and understand root causes of anomalies. Your solutions directly improve the customer experience.
Independently work with product partners to identify problems and opportunities. Apply a range of data science techniques and tools to solve these problems. Use data driven insights to inform product development. Work with cross-disciplinary teams to mechanize your solution into scalable and automated frameworks.


Data Infrastructure


Build data pipelines, and identify novel data sources to leverage in analytical work - both from within Alexa and from cross Amazon
Acquire data by building the necessary SQL / ETL queries


Communication


Excel at communicating complex ideas to technical and non-technical audiences.
Build relationships with stakeholders and counterparts. Work with stakeholders to translate causal insights into actionable recommendations
Force multiply the work of the team with data visualizations, presentations, and/or dashboards to drive awareness and adoption of data assets and product insights
Collaborate with cross-functional teams. Mentor teammates to foster a culture of continuous learning and development


Basic Qualifications


2+ years of data scientist experience
2+ years of data querying languages (e.g. SQL), scripting languages (e.g. Python) or statistical/mathematical software (e.g. R, SAS, Matlab, etc.) experience
2+ years of machine learning/statistical modeling data analysis tools and techniques, and parameters that affect their performance experience
Master's degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM), or experience working in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM)


Preferred Qualifications


Knowledge of machine learning concepts and their application to reasoning and problem-solving
Experience in Python, Perl, or another scripting language
Experience in a ML or data scientist role with a large technology company
Experience working on multi-team, cross-disciplinary projects
Experience applying quantitative analysis to solve business problems and making data-driven business decisions
Experience effectively communicating complex concepts through written and verbal communication

Title: Data (Python) Developer
Description:
Your Job

DarkVision is looking for a Data (Python) Developer to join the Data Development Team in North Vancouver, BC. In this role, you will work collaboratively with teammates and other departments in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment to develop and advance the data analysis deliverables supporting the multi-million-dollar operations of our customers.




You will support the Data Analysis Delivery team by writing and maintaining scripts to automate their analysis and deliverable workflows. You will work with the Product team to prototype new deliverables (inspection reports and 3D visualizations), and work with the Engineering Team to diagnose issues that affect Data Analysis Deliverables, and suggest improvements.




This regular full-time position is 100% on-site in our HQ in North Vancouver, BC, where employees enjoy full access to our facility amenities including a well-equipped gym, squash court, climbing wall, steam room, and more!




Immigration sponsorship or support is not available for this position.




Our Team

DarkVision’s acoustic imaging technology captures terabytes of high-fidelity data with each run. Our Data Analysis Development team plays a critical role in the commercial process by supporting the Data Analysis Delivery team in building and maintaining tools to streamline the analysis workflow, advancing and improving new deliverables, and improving processes for quality assurance.




There will always be new software tools and scripts to write and improve, new technologies to exploit and generate deliverables on, and new ways to make processes better, faster, and more sustainable and scalable. This entails a detail-oriented mindset, a default-to-action work ethic, and a multi-disciplinary perspective.




What You Will Do

Develop and maintain scripts to automate analysis workflows.
Develop and maintain analysis dashboards for higher level tracking of project status and Key Performance Indicators.
Develop and maintain analysis procedures that streamline a sustainable and scalable workflow.
Work with other analysts, Sales, Product, and Engineering teams to document and investigate issues, and prevent their reoccurrence.
Gather and analyze test data that will be used to prove out feasibility of new technology and deliverable products.
Develop new and innovative ways of representing and visualizing current data to generate new customer deliverables.
Work with the Product team in the data gathering, analysis, and writing of technical conferences papers.
Help analysts debug issues in their analysis workflow, and reproduce, document, and raise issues for other functional teams.
Interface with our Research, Machine Learning, Software, and Product teams to ensure the Data Team’s needs are met, and vice versa.




Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)

Able to work 100% on-site in our North Vancouver office.
Experience developing production code in Python (code used in a product or professional setting, not academia- or research-only applications).
Experience developing workflow automation scripts (to automate manual steps performed by analysts).
Data visualization experience.
Git experience.




What Will Put You Ahead

Excellent communication skills.
Detail oriented; meticulous in documentation.
Default-to-action personality.
Independent - can operate with little guidance while providing results at regular intervals for feedback.
Collaborative - works to meet the needs and goals of the team.
Experience in the development of ML models (data gathering, training, testing, and/or deployment)
Image processing experience.
MATLAB experience.
3D data experience.
3D rendering experience.
Proficiency in PowerBI.
Ultrasonic imaging experience.
Software and algorithm development experience.
Atlassian product experience.




General Salary Range

For this role, we anticipate paying $70,000 - $115,000 per year. This role is eligible for variable pay, issued as a monetary bonus or in another form.




At Koch companies, we are entrepreneurs. This means we openly challenge the status quo, find new ways to create value and get rewarded for our individual contributions. Any compensation range provided for a role is an estimate determined by available market data. The actual amount may be higher or lower than the range provided considering each candidate’s knowledge, skills, abilities, and geographic location. If you have questions, please speak to your recruiter about the flexibility and detail of our compensation philosophy.




Who We Are

DarkVision Technologies Inc. is a Canada-based tech company disrupting the industrial imaging market since 2013. We have created the world’s most advanced acoustic-based imaging platform. We are packaging it into multiple new product lines, revolutionizing how our clients quantify and visualize the integrity of their critical assets.




Backed by Koch Industries, one of the world’s largest privately held companies, DarkVision’s team of Mechanical, Skunkworks, Electrical, Software, and Machine Learning Engineers is rapidly expanding to meet the demand for the company’s current and upcoming products.




We allow employees to work on cutting-edge technologies that blend science with real-world applications. We invite you to join our team for the exciting journey ahead as we become the global leader in industrial imaging.




At Koch, employees are empowered to do what they do best to make life better. Learn how our business philosophy helps employees unleash their potential while creating value for themselves and the company.




Additionally, everyone has individual work and personal needs. We seek to enable the best work environment that helps you and the business work together to produce superior results.




How To Apply

If you have the above qualifications, we would like to hear from you. We thank all applicants in advance, but please be advised that only those selected for an interview will be contacted.




We are an equal opportunity employer. If you require accommodation or assistance at any time during the application or selection processes, please submit a request by following the directions located in the FAQ section at the bottom of the kochcareers.com webpage.




Successful candidates will be required to complete a criminal background check.

Title: Data Solutions Engineer
Description:
Establish the single source of truth for customer data. Then use it to get every customer to value, fast.

On-site | Vancouver Office – 675 W Hastings St. 

 

The Problem We're Solving

EviSmart™ has grown fast — data now lives in more places than it used to: the backend that runs the business, the CRM where sales and customer success work, and the data every lab brings with them when they join the platform. Reporting takes more cross-checking than it should, and the data-mapping step in lab onboarding — simple in concept but exacting in practice. This role exists to close that gap: one person who owns making EviSmart's customer data a single source of truth.

 

Why EviSmart

300 people. Two hubs: Vancouver HQ and Manila operations.
145% year-over-year SaaS growth — the market is responding.
28 countries. One platform. The dental industry's Autopilot.
An in-house AI model research and development team building proprietary intelligence.

 

Why This Role, Right Now 

Sales, Customer Success, and go-to-market teams need to open one system and trust what they see — today they can't. And as the platform scales, onboarding has to become a repeatable machine instead of a per-customer rescue effort. These aren't future problems; they're live ones. The first months of this role are deliberately concrete: specific systems, specific deliverables, measured outcomes. But the mandate behind them is bigger — every system the platform adds and every AI capability the company builds will sit on the customer data foundation this person establishes. 

 

What You'll Own

Own — Reconciliation of customer data across systems: pull a clean customer list from the backend into the CRM — no duplicates, no ghost accounts — audit what's already in HubSpot (call logs, deal history, contacts), and make the call on what stays, what gets cleaned, and what gets automated.

Build — A live two-way integration between HubSpot and the backend: data flows automatically, actions trigger from HubSpot, logic stays in the backend.

Establish — One trusted place to generate sales pipeline, retention rate, customer health, and all other sales, customer success, and go-to-market reporting.

Run — Customer onboarding data-mapping sessions directly with labs.

Deliver — A written brief for engineering: where labs hit friction during mapping, what's causing it, and what to fix so labs can complete it independently.

Coordinate — With Customer Success on onboarding sessions and with our contracted HubSpot partner on integration.

Grow — Into the data foundation itself. As the early goals land, the scope expands toward owning and scaling customer onboarding as a repeatable machine — and toward the broader work of making EviSmart's data trustworthy end to end, across every system it touches.

 

What You'll Get

A foundation-level seat: the data layer you build is what sales reporting, customer success, and the platform's AI and analytics ambitions will run on.

Direct customer contact from week one — labs across 28 countries, real workflows, immediate feedback on whether your work holds up.

Concrete goals with real gates: this role is defined by deliverables and measurable outcomes, not vague mandates.
A role built to grow — the scope expands as the foundation you build proves out.
Competitive compensation with salary range disclosed at offer.

 

How We Work

We ship before we're 100% certain. We write things down because we have two offices and memory is lossy. We debate loudly and move without resentment. We treat the customer's real problem as more important than an elegant internal process. If you've spent time waiting for permission to try something obvious — you'll notice the difference here immediately.

 

The Question You're Probably Asking 

"'Is this a CRM admin job?' No. The CRM is where the data problem surfaces first, so it's the first proving ground — but the work is data engineering end to end: cleansing, integration, sync logic, reporting architecture, and reconciling what the backend, the CRM, and the customer's own data each believe is true."

— EviSmart Talent Team

 

What We Need

Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Computer Science, Data Science, Economics, or a related field.
4–5 years of professional experience in data analysis, data engineering, or solutions/implementation engineering.
Advanced SQL skills (joins, CTEs, window functions, subqueries).
Proficiency in Python for data analysis and workflow automation.
Experience with ETL/ELT pipelines and workflow automation.
Hands-on CRM data experience — auditing, cleansing, deduplication, and data migration. HubSpot strongly preferred.
Systems integration experience — building or maintaining two-way integrations between platforms (APIs, middleware, sync logic).
Familiarity with Git/GitHub for version control and collaboration.
Comfortable running customer-facing working sessions and explaining data configuration to non-technical users.
Able to translate customer friction into clear, actionable briefs for engineering.

Title: Data Scientist, ADE Analytics
Description:
Description

The Alexa Daily Essentials team delivers experiences critical to how customers interact with Alexa as part of daily life. Alexa users engage with our products across experiences connected to Timers, Alarms, Calendars, Food, and News. Our experiences include critical time saving techniques, ad-supported news audio and video, and in-depth kitchen guidance aimed at serving the needs of the family from sunset to sundown.

As a Data Scientist on our team, you'll work with complex data, develop statistical methodologies, and provide critical product insights that shape how we build and optimize our solutions. You will work closely with your Analytics and Applied Science teammates. You will build frameworks and mechanisms to scale data solutions across our organization. If you are passionate about redefining how AI can improves everyone's daily life, we’d love to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities

Key job responsibilities

Problem-Solving


Analyze complex data to identify patterns, inform product decisions, and understand root causes of anomalies.
Develop analysis and modeling approaches to drive product and engineering actions to identify patterns, insights, and understand root causes of anomalies. Your solutions directly improve the customer experience.
Independently work with product partners to identify problems and opportunities. Apply a range of data science techniques and tools to solve these problems. Use data driven insights to inform product development. Work with cross-disciplinary teams to mechanize your solution into scalable and automated frameworks.


Data Infrastructure


Build data pipelines, and identify novel data sources to leverage in analytical work - both from within Alexa and from cross Amazon
Acquire data by building the necessary SQL / ETL queries


Communication


Excel at communicating complex ideas to technical and non-technical audiences.
Build relationships with stakeholders and counterparts. Work with stakeholders to translate causal insights into actionable recommendations
Force multiply the work of the team with data visualizations, presentations, and/or dashboards to drive awareness and adoption of data assets and product insights
Collaborate with cross-functional teams. Mentor teammates to foster a culture of continuous learning and development


Basic Qualifications


2+ years of data scientist experience
2+ years of data querying languages (e.g. SQL), scripting languages (e.g. Python) or statistical/mathematical software (e.g. R, SAS, Matlab, etc.) experience
2+ years of machine learning/statistical modeling data analysis tools and techniques, and parameters that affect their performance experience
Master's degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM), or experience working in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM)


Preferred Qualifications


Knowledge of machine learning concepts and their application to reasoning and problem-solving
Experience in Python, Perl, or another scripting language
Experience in a ML or data scientist role with a large technology company
Experience working on multi-team, cross-disciplinary projects
Experience applying quantitative analysis to solve business problems and making data-driven business decisions
Experience effectively communicating complex concepts through written and verbal communication

Title: Business Analyst
Description:
Who We Are

Emterra Group is a dynamic, growth-oriented, and safety-focused group of companies. Our organization have been deemed to be an “essential service” by providing collection and processing for recycling, organics, and waste that keep our communities clean and safe. With customer service and safety as our focus, we are looking for an energetic and driven employee to support our growing company and play a crucial role in waste diversion and the circular economy. Emterra is proud to be recognized as one of Canada’s Greenest Employers, a certified diverse supplier of the Canadian Aboriginal and Minority Supplier Council (CAMSC) and the Canadian Women Business Enterprise National Council (WBE).

Job Summary

We’re seeking an innovative Business Analyst with experience in AI solutions and advanced reporting to help transform our waste management operations. In this role, you’ll lead initiatives to deliver actionable insights through Power BI dashboards, develop and optimize AI chatbot solutions for internal and customer interactions, and identify broader AI automation opportunities across our services. Your work will be central to building a smarter, more efficient, and sustainable waste management system through data-driven decision-making and intelligent automation.

Position Description


Design, develop, and maintain interactive Power BI dashboards that deliver clear operational, sustainability, and business performance insights
Gather business requirements and translate them into effective data models, DAX calculations, and visual reports
Analyze collection, routing, recycling, and disposal data to identify inefficiencies and recommend improvements
Lead the development and implementation of AI-powered chatbots to improve customer service, reduce call volumes, and streamline internal workflows
Collaborate with operations, engineering, and IT teams to scope AI and automation use cases (e.g., smart routing optimization, load forecasting, customer self-service)
Support the evaluation and integration of AI/ML models for predictive analytics, including reducing equipment downtime and improving sustainability KPIs
Communicate complex technical findings in clear, business-friendly language to executives and cross-functional teams
Stay current on emerging AI, chatbot, and data visualization technologies to inform our digital strategy
We ask that all applicants use the link below to complete an assessment to advance to the next steps of the interview process: https://emterra.quickbase.com/db/bsp27zsfw


Skills & Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in business, Data Science, Information Systems, Environmental Science, or a related field
Minimum 1 year of experience as a Business Analyst, with significant exposure to data visualization and AI projects
Familiarity with chatbot development platforms (e.g., Microsoft Power Automate, Dialog flow, Azure Bot Service) and basic prompt engineering
Proficiency in SQL for data extraction and manipulation
Proficiency in Python for data analysis, automation scripting, or AI/ML model integration
Strong communication skills with a demonstrated ability to align technical solutions with business needs
Act as a liaison between the Western Operations teams and the National IT Team to facilitate communication and project coordination.
Communicate and disseminate relevant information, updates, and project developments to internal teams.
Support stakeholder engagement activities, including information gathering, requirements collection, and business needs analysis.


Nice to Have:


Experience in logistics, supply chain, or environmental services
Knowledge of sustainability metrics and ESG reporting frameworks
Experience with QuickBase for workflow automation or custom applications
Exposure to geospatial data analysis or IoT-enabled waste management systems

Lead the design, development, and delivery of Power BI and analytics solutions, including new dashboard builds, enhancements, and defect resolution

Experience with modern data platforms such as Databricks, Azure Synapse, or similar lakehouse/warehouse solutions

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
The Company

Cover Genius is a Series E insurtech that protects the global customers of the world’s largest digital companies including Booking Holdings, owner of Priceline, Kayak and Booking.com, Intuit, Uber, Hopper, Ryanair, Turkish Airlines, Descartes ShipRush, Zip and SeatGeek. We’re also available at Amazon, Flipkart, eBay, Wayfair and SE Asia’s largest company, Shopee. Our partners integrate with XCover, our award-winning insurance distribution platform, to embed protection for millions of customers worldwide each year.

Our team and products have been recognized with dozens of awards including by the Financial Times which ranked Cover Genius as the #1 fastest-growing company in APAC in 2020. Our diverse team across 20+ countries and many language groups commit itself to diverse cultural programs, in particular “CG Gives” which makes social entrepreneurs out of us all and funds development initiatives in global communities.

Our People are

Bold, Authentic, Purposeful and Inspired

Our People are not

Perfect, Traditional, Complacent or Cautious

About The Role

We are seeking a highly analytical, adaptable, and impact-driven Senior Data Analyst to join our growing Product Operations team. This pivotal role will embed within our product domains and problem spaces, acting as a critical partner to Product Managers in driving growth and optimizing the end-to-end customer experience.

You will be obsessed with leveraging data to support teams with strategic product decisions, identify growth opportunities, and ensure operational excellence at scale. This role is ideal for someone excited by continuous change, eager to tackle diverse challenges across various product initiatives, and committed to a data-driven culture

Key Responsibilities

What will your day look like?


Empower Product Teams to be Data Driven: As a strategic partner, you will provide cross-product insights and connect the dots across multiple programs. As the "truth seeker," you will objectively analyze data and identify opportunities. You will design, develop, and own insightful dashboards and reports that provide visibility into key product metrics, user engagement patterns, and feature performance. These tools will empower product teams to be data-led and make informed decisions by ensuring Product Managers have accurate information.
Support Data-Driven Decision Making: You will translate ambiguous business questions into well-defined data problems and deliver actionable recommendations through clean, compelling data narratives. You will collaborate closely with Product Managers to understand user needs and ensure that all decisions are informed by robust data and analysis
Drive Product Growth with Actionable Insights: You will perform deep-dive analysis to unpack insights and recommend solutions to top-of-mind problems the business is facing. Your analysis will go beyond simple reporting of "what happened" to provide a clear understanding of "why it happened", supporting product teams in leveraging data for strategic initiatives and decision-making, influencing product strategy and feature prioritization.
Champion Continuous Improvement & Automation: Actively participate in retrospectives and contribute to a culture of learning and iteration, using data to identify areas for process and product improvement. Drive automation and productisation of analytical solutions, transforming client questions into scalable analytical solutions. Proactively identify data quality issues or opportunities for improvement in analytics tooling and reporting.
Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Work closely with diverse teams, including product, marketing, data engineering, and other relevant teams, to align efforts toward growth initiatives and ensure shared understanding of product performance.
Stakeholder Communication: Communicate findings to stakeholders at various levels, adjusting content and complexity to suit the audience, and translating complex analyses into clear, actionable takeaways tailored for both technical and non-technical audiences.
Ensure Accountability: Ensure accountability for analytics quality and successful delivery of key projects with measurable client outcomes. Support quarterly and annual planning efforts with data inputs, forecasting trends, and key performance analytics.


Experience & Skills

What you will bring:


4+ years of experience as a Data Analyst, preferably within a product-led organization or supporting product teams.
Strong SQL proficiency is essential for data extraction, manipulation, and analysis.
Experience with data modeling and transformation tools like dbt (Data Build Tool).
Familiarity with workflow orchestration tools such as Airflow.
Proficiency in building dashboards and reports using business intelligence tools (e.g., Superset) to visualize data and communicate insights effectively.
Demonstrated ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for non-technical stakeholders.
A strong understanding of product metrics, user behavior, and sales funnels.
A proactive and curious mindset, with a relentless focus on identifying opportunities for improvement and driving measurable outcomes.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence decisions through data.
Adaptability and excitement for working in a fast-paced, evolving environment, embracing new challenges across different product areas.
Basic understanding of Python for data analysis and scripting is a plus.


To Help Us Level Up, You Will Have/be


Data-Driven Mindset: Demands data to inform every significant operational decision.
Problem Solver: Approaches challenges with a solution-oriented attitude.
Accountable & Results-Oriented: Takes full ownership of work and focuses on tangible execution and measurable improvements.
Collaborative Communicator: Fosters clear, timely communication and values constructive feedback.
Systems Thinker: Designs processes that are repeatable, documented, and built to scale; avoids one-off solutions.
Adaptable: Thrives in a dynamic and evolving environment.


Why Cover Genius?

Cover Genius not only cares about being the best in our industry, we care about our team. We’re a business that understands life can be fluid and so we flex to ensure we provide the environment to suit that. What does that mean?


Flexible Work Environment - our teams are hybrid. We work from home on Wednesdays and Thursday and attend the office on Monday, Tuesday and Friday with flexibility around start/finish times. We also have the added bonus of a Wellness day a month.
Employee Stock Options - we want our people to share in our success, we reward them with ownership for their contribution in creating a world-class company.
Work with like-minded people who are passionate about both the work we're doing and giving back. Our CG Gives programs enables us to all become philanthropists through our peer recognition and rewards system.
Social Initiatives - pictures speak a thousand words!


Sound interesting? If you think you have the best composition of the above, send us your resume and let's chat!

Cover Genius promotes diversity and inclusivity. We don't tolerate discrimination, demeaning treatment of anyone, or harassment due to race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or any other legally protected status.

By submitting your application, you acknowledge that we may collect, store and process your personal data for recruitment purposes. To ensure a fair evaluation, we may use AI to assist in sorting applications, but all final decisions are made by our hiring team and no candidate dispositions are automated. We will keep your information on file for three years from the date of your application. For detailed information about how we handle your data and our use of AI, please review our full Privacy Policy.

This position has an annual base salary range C$135,000 - C$175,000

Description:
SureWerx is a leading manufacturer of innovative safety, tool and equipment products and solutions. Since 1957, we've been trusted to keep all who use our products safe in even the most challenging environments. Today, our growing family of world-leading brands serves customers and partners across the U.S., Canada and Europe.

At SureWerx, you'll have the opportunity to challenge yourself in a supportive, growth-oriented culture of industry leaders. You’ll help chart our future as we continue to expand into new products, services and markets. And we’ll invest in your career development, enabling you to grow and succeed.

We are seeking a full-time Junior Data Analyst to join our IT team. Reporting to the Director of Data Analytics, the Junior Data Analyst will support SureWerx leaders by translating business requirements into meaningful insights and dashboards using Power BI. This role will work closely with senior analysts and business stakeholders, gaining hands-on experience with operations, data integrations, reporting, and continuous improvement initiatives in a fast-paced environment. The successful candidate will possess strong technical aptitude, analytical thinking skills, and the ability to thrive in a dynamic, growth-oriented setting.

This position is based Vancouver, BC location and follows a hybrid work arrangement, requiring 2 days per week onsite.

Responsibilities


Power BI Development: Assist senior analysts to transform data sets into compelling data visualizations including dashboards, flowcharts, graphs and maps to effectively communicate trends and patterns. Assist senior analysts to define and implement best practices.
Data Gathering and Preparation - Collaborate with all team members to understand data and its meaning for proper analysis. Develop complex data extraction and transformation scripts, including data linkages, to prepare data for analysis. Create, optimize and manage complex SQL queries and views.
Requirements Gathering: Assist in documenting requirements from business stakeholders.
Data & Integration Support - Assist with data cleaning, preparation, validation and data mapping activities. Support data migration, integrations, and reconciliation efforts.
Daily Support: Provide ongoing support for Power BI users by monitoring status on issues, troubleshooting data-related and Power BI report issues, resolving technical issues and identifying opportunities for process improvement.
System Development, Support and Testing: Assist in database design and maintenance. Develop test plans and conduct quality assurance testing prior to release of reports to business stakeholders.Coordinate user acceptance testing (UAT) to ensure the created reports meet business requirements and function correctly. Assist in rollout of AI tools to accelerate reporting and analysis cycle.
Training: Assist with training end-users.
Presentations: Present to business stakeholders on the implemented reports and dashboards.


Qualifications


Proficient in Power BI, SQL, Copilot, MS Fabric, Excel and related technologies
A bachelor's degree ideally in computer science or mathematics, or a related field is typically required
0–2 years of experience in a business systems, application support, or analyst role.
Exposure to ERP systems (e.g., Microsoft Dynamics 365, SAP, Oracle) is an asset.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to work with both technical and non technical stakeholders.
Ability to create and maintain detailed documentation for technical and non-technical audiences
Collaborative and adaptable, able to work effectively within a team and adapt to changing business needs
Strong problem-solving skills, mathematical and analytical skills
Organized, collaborative, and eager to learn in a fast paced environment.

Title: Senior Decision Science Analyst
Description:
Come join Pattison Food Group Ltd., a Jim Pattison business, and Canada’s largest Western-based provider of food and health products.

Pattison Food Group Ltd. is a certified Great Place to Work® and consists of Save-On-Foods and other well-known grocery banners. With nearly 300 retail locations, we proudly employ nearly 30,000 team members.

We have an exciting opportunity for a full-time Senior Decision Science Analyst to join our More Rewards team in Langley, BC.

Reporting to the Senior Manager, Customer Data & Analytics, you will be responsible for leveraging all aspects of data and analytics to drive large-scale projects and continuous experimentation initiatives, guiding decision-making and delivering high-quality insights. In this role, you will support the development and management of customer data and insights using a large and comprehensive dataset to support the More Rewards Loyalty Program, Retail Operations, Marketing and Merchandising.

You will be responsible for:


Collaborating with stakeholders to understand business questions, processes, and KPIs.
Formulating testable hypotheses aligned with business questions and conducting statistical experiments in a live environment.
Writing SQL scripts to automate data pipelines and workflows.
Using Python scripts in a Jupyter Notebook environment for data analysis, data wrangling, statistical testing, and predictive modeling.
Mentoring and cross-training data analysts in experimentation best practices and statistical design.
Developing dashboards and visualizations in Power BI to convey insights and report on KPIs and test results.
Working in cloud-based analytics environments and with big data tools to build analytics workflows on large datasets.
Collaborating with IT and Data Scientists to identify technical and data requirements for deploying analytic solutions tailored to business needs.
Discovering unique and creative insights to identify new opportunities for driving business value.
Becoming an expert in the relevant datasets within your analytics domain.



You have:


A degree in a STEM discipline and at least 5 years of relevant experience in data analytics or data science.
Advanced Python coding skills.
Advanced understanding of SQL.
Experience using experimental design principles, such as A/B and multivariate testing, and working with business stakeholders to formulate testable hypotheses.
Understanding of advanced analytics and data science methods such as anomaly detection, forecasting, and supervised and unsupervised learning.
Experience with visualization and reporting tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
Working knowledge of cloud environments such as Azure, GCP, or AWS.
Experience with big data tools such as Spark and Databricks and other programming languages is an asset.



You are:


A confident communicator, both verbally and in writing, with strong interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate a story with data and insights to non-technical stakeholders.
A problem-solver with strong analytical and critical thinking skills.
Effective in task management and delivering high-quality work.
Capable of multitasking and thriving in a fast-paced environment.
Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and collaboratively.
Able to mentor and guide junior team members, fostering their professional growth and enhancing team performance.



What we offer:

In addition to a highly competitive salary, we offer a great range of benefits, a company pension plan, free parking, on-site gym, exclusive team member offers, and opportunities for development and career progression.

If you’re looking to join a team that puts people first, you’re in the right place. Apply online today!

Compensation Details:

$96,443.00 - $120,554.00

The compensation offered for this position will take into consideration location, education, skills, experience and other factors.

Title: Senior Data Analyst, Risk
Description:
About Binance.US:

Binance.US is a licensed and regulated U.S. cryptocurrency exchange where users can buy, trade, hold, and earn digital assets. Recognized as a top U.S. crypto platform by Forbes (Best Crypto Exchanges of 2026) and Business Insider (Best Crypto Exchanges of 2025), Binance.US leads the industry with its low fees, advanced trading engine, strong security and reliability, and robust compliance framework. Learn more at www.binance.us. All roles supporting Binance.US are employed via BAM Management US Holdings Inc. or BAM Management Canada Holdings Inc.

About This Role:

As a Senior Data Analyst, Risk at Binance.US, you will be the data engine behind how we understand and reduce financial loss. You will own the analysis of payment and chargeback data end to end, digging into what actually drives net loss and turning that into changes that ship.

This is a hands-on, high-impact role. You will break down fraud and loss by driver, investigate emerging trends, design experiments to test risk rule changes, and build the monitoring that keeps the Risk & Compliance team ahead of new threats. You will work closely with Risk, Payments, and Product to make sure your insights become real fixes, not just dashboards.

This role is a strong fit if you think naturally about where loss leaks in and how to stop it, you are comfortable moving fast in a lean environment, and you like owning a problem from raw data all the way to measurable impact.

Core Responsibilities:


Own the analysis of user lifecycle on-platform activities from on-ramp payment (ACH/Card related), trading, to withdrawal end to end: understand what drives anomalies and net loss, surface the levers to mitigate.
Deep-dive into fraud cases and user profiles to quantify exposure, design and backtest strategies/models to manage exposures.
Design and analyze A/B experiments to measure the impact of risk rule and process changes on loss, pass rate, and customer friction.
Good plus on leveraging ML techniques to surface patterns in fraud and loss data that manual analysis would miss
Break down net loss by driver (fraud type, payment method, user segment) and track it as a core monitoring metric
Build and maintain dashboards and monitoring for all essential Risk & Compliance payment metrics, with clear alerting when trends move
Partner closely with Risk, Payments, and Product teams to turn analysis into shipped changes
Run ad-hoc analysis to investigate emerging fraud and loss trends and quantify their impact fast


Preferred Skills/Experience:


4+ years in risk analytics
Strong SQL, plus Python or R for quantitative analysis, statistical modeling.
Hands-on experience with payment / chargeback data (reason codes, net loss attribution, etc)
Solid grasp of A/B testing and experiment design (hypothesis, guardrails, readout)
Strong data visualization and dashboarding skills
Able to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for non-technical stakeholders
Solid statistical foundation
Experience in a high-growth tech environment; fintech or crypto a plus
Ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously while maintaining analytical rigor and execution quality


Salary:

The starting pay range for this role will vary, and is dependent upon many factors, such as transferable skill sets, work experience, business needs, and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change.

At Binance.US, our mission is to create a more inclusive financial system through Web3 technologies. As a U.S. regulated crypto platform, we’re committed to earning trust through compliance and empowering people to do more with their money, bringing financial freedom within reach for all.

Our Benefits:

We believe in supporting our people with flexibility, balance, and opportunities to grow. One of the ways we demonstrate this commitment is through our benefit offerings.


Time & Family: Unlimited PTO (for salaried FTE roles); 12 weeks fully paid Parental Bonding Leave.
Well-Being: Mental wellness benefits; free 1:1 virtual visits with a licensed mental wellness professional; comprehensive competitive health benefits.
Remote-First Culture: Fully remote, cameras-on culture with work-from-home equipment reimbursements available to new hires.

Title: Distribution Operations Analyst I
Description:
Job Description Summary

Put your proactive mindset, data analysis skills, and cross functional communication abilities to work by joining STEMCELL Technologies, Canada’s largest biotech company, as a Distribution Operations Analyst I!

We are looking for a detail-oriented Distribution Operations Analyst I, who can think critically about operational processes and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, data accuracy, and overall business performance. In this role, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams to analyze operational data, support inventory and quality management activities, resolve system issues, and drive process improvements. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to key operational initiatives, influence business decisions through data-driven insights, and play an integral role in supporting organizational success.

Job Description

Duties and Responsibilities


Prepare, analyze, and present key operational metrics and performance reports to monitor departmental performance, identify trends, and drive continuous improvement initiatives
Execute inventory transactions, maintain critical operational records, and independently troubleshoot complex SAP issues, error queues, and workflow bottlenecks to ensure uninterrupted operations
Develop and execute User Acceptance Testing (UAT) scripts, document outcomes, and support process optimization projects to enhance system functionality and operational efficiency
Lead inventory discrepancy investigations and manage quality non-conformance records, conducting root cause analysis and implementing corrective actions to ensure compliance and timely resolution
Perform master data maintenance and collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure data accuracy, support operational plans, and drive process improvements across the organization


Knowledge And Qualifications


Bachelor's degree with 2-5 years of relevant experience
Experience with SAP and ACE Systems is considered an asset
Strong knowledge of inventory management processes, system transactions and master data
Proven ability to extract, analyze, and synthesize operational data into meaningful reports, performance metrics, and actionable business insights
Demonstrated analytical, problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience supporting process improvements, system enhancements, and UAT activities


#United

STEMCELL Technologies is a privately owned, Vancouver-based biotechnology company that helps power leading-edge life science research around the world. Driven by our love of science and passion for quality, we are a company of Scientists Helping Scientists—standing by our customers to provide the outstanding products, technical support, and training they need to advance their research. Scientists performing stem cell, immunology, cancer, regenerative medicine, and cellular therapy research are among those who rely on our cell culture media, cell separation products, instruments, accessory products, and services. Through our many regional offices, as well as our distribution centers in Vancouver, Seattle, Grenoble, and Singapore, we deliver our innovative, specialized products to more than 100 countries. With over 1,800 employees globally, most with scientific or engineering degrees, STEMCELL is proud to be the largest biotechnology employer in Canada.

Title: Senior Data Analyst, Compliance
Description:
Job Description:

At Remitly, we believe everyone deserves the freedom to access, move, and manage their money wherever life takes them. Since 2011, we've tirelessly delivered on our promise to customers sending money globally, providing secure, simple, and reliable ways to manage their money, ensuring true peace of mind. Whether it's supporting loved ones back home, growing a business across continents, or pursuing new opportunities abroad, we're not just here to move money— we're here to move our global customers forward.

We're looking for builders, reimaginers, and global thinkers who want to work at the intersection of technology, trust, and transformation. If that's you and you're ready to do the most meaningful work of your career—we invite you to join over 2,800 passionate Remitlians worldwide who are united by our vision to transform lives with trusted financial services that transcend borders.

About The Role

The Sr. Data Analyst, Compliance, is a high-performing individual contributor within the broader analytics team. You will be responsible for bridging the gap between compliance business and technology by translating requirements into well-defined and concrete data products. You will own the "Requirement-to-Reporting" lifecycle, ensuring business requirements are robust and detailed and data engineers build the right foundations, balancing data governance with business flexibility, and delivering the final data products with reliability, predictability, and accuracy.

The Lifecycle You Will Own:


Discovery: Understanding the "Why" behind the business request.
Mapping: Identifying the "Where" (data sources) and the "Gaps."
Specs: Writing the "How" for the Data Engineers.
Validation: Testing the "Truth" of the data through UAT.
Delivery: Visualizing the "So What" for stakeholders.


Key Responsibilities


Strategic Translation: Partner with compliance leaders and stakeholders to understand objectives and translate them into Remitly business language and further translate them into detailed functional/technical specifications.
Metric Definition: Lead the definition of North Star metrics and KPIs, ensuring alignment across different departments to prevent "data silos" or conflicting definitions.
Documentation: Own the creation of source-to-target mappings, logic flowcharts, and business requirement documents (BRDs).
Data Scouting: Identify internal and external data sources required to fulfill business needs; perform exploratory data analysis to highlight data gaps or quality issues.
Engineering Partnership: Work hand-in-hand with Data Engineers to design scalable data pipelines, providing the necessary business logic and transformation rules.
Validation & UAT: Lead the User Acceptance Testing (UAT) process, rigorously validating transformation logic and data integrity before production deployment.
Solution Architecture: Design and build sophisticated reporting solutions (Tableau, PowerBI, or internal tools) that go beyond simple charts to tell a meaningful business story.
Data Consumption: Ensure data is delivered in a "business-consumable" form, prioritizing UX/UI in dashboards to drive high adoption rates among non-technical users.


Typical Qualifications


Experience: 4-8+ years in a Senior Analyst or Analytics Consultant role, specifically focused on the end-to-end delivery of data products.
Problem Solving: Mastery of First Principles Thinking—the ability to take a vague request like "we need to increase retention" and break it down into a structured data project involving specific schemas, logic, and metrics.
AI Readiness: Proficient in leveraging AI tools for rapid prototyping of SQL logic, automating documentation, and identifying opportunities where machine learning can enhance traditional business reporting.
Communication: Expert-level ability to navigate two worlds. You can discuss JOIN logic and latency with engineers in the morning and LTV or churn-reduction strategies with executives in the afternoon.
Programming: Expert in SQL, Python or R for data exploration, validation and analysis; Working experience with DBT or Git or similar.
BI Tools: Mastery of visualization and report / dashboard building, and performance optimization; demonstrated experience in building with Tableau, Mode, PowerBI (or similar).


Compensation Details. The starting base salary range for this position is typically $120,000 - $150,000 CAD. In Canada, Remitly employees are shareholders in our Company and equity is part of our total compensation plan. Your recruiter can share more information about medical benefits offered, as well as other financial benefits and total compensation components offered with this role.

Our Benefits:


Flexible paid time off
Health, dental, and vision + 401k plan with company matching
Paid parental, medical, military and family care leave
Mental Health & Family Forming Benefits
Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)
Continuing education and travel benefits


Our Connected Work Culture: Driving Innovation, Together

At Remitly, we believe that true innovation sparks when we come together. Our Connected Work Culture fosters dynamic in-person collaboration, where ideas ignite and challenging problems find solutions faster. For corporate team members, we have an in-office expectation of at least 50% of the time monthly, typically achieved by coming in three days a week. This creates a consistent, meaningful overlap that supports team norms and business needs. Managers also have the flexibility to set higher expectations based on their team's specific needs. These intentional in-office moments are vital for deepening relationships, fueling creativity, and ensuring your impact is felt where it matters most.

Remitly is an E-Verify Employer

At Remitly, we are dedicated to ensuring that our workplace offers equal employment opportunities to all employees and candidates, in full compliance with applicable laws and regulations.

Remitly is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Title: Business Insights Analyst, Fulfillment Inventory Management
Description:
Business Insights Analyst, Fulfillment Inventory Management

This is an opportunity to move beyond reporting and become a true business partner - using data to uncover meaningful insights, influence strategic decisions, and shape the future of inventory and fulfillment operations. If you enjoy solving complex business problems, connecting the dots, and telling compelling stories with data, you'll thrive in this role.




This is a 1-year contract.




Who – The Company:

Our client is one of Vancouver’s most sought-after companies to work for, with global operations and an impeccable reputation. Our client is a people-centric organization and known for their collaborative team culture.




What- The Role:

The Fulfillment Inventory Management team plays a critical role in maintaining inventory health, optimizing network capacity, enabling strategic inventory placement across the fulfillment network, and ensuring the timely exit of end-of-life inventory. They partner closely with a broad range of cross-functional teams to deliver on investment commitments while governing the processes that support effective inventory management and end-of-life execution.




They design and evolve core operational processes, lead governance routines, strengthen organizational connectivity, and generate data-driven insights that fuel continuous improvement and risk mitigation. Through consistent and scalable governance frameworks, we drive efficient, standardized inventory practices that improve product availability, maximize DC space utilization, and minimize impacts on DC operations.




This role supports the delivery of analytics, reporting, and business insights that enable decision-making across the fulfillment network.




This role is a blend of technical analytics and business advisory. The analyst will use enterprise data products, Snowflake, Power BI, Excel, and related tools to investigate business questions, identify performance trends, explain what is driving change, and translate findings into clear recommendations for FIM leaders and cross-functional partners.




Success in this role is not measured only by the dashboards or reports delivered. Success is measured by the quality of insights generated, the clarity of the story told through data, and the ability to help the business understand what is happening, why it is happening, and what actions should be considered next.




Lead analysis that supports inventory, fulfillment, capacity, and network optimization decisions.
Partner with business leaders to solve complex problems and translate questions into actionable insights.
Identify trends, risks, opportunities, and root causes impacting fulfillment and inventory performance.
Develop and maintain dashboards, reporting solutions, and KPI frameworks that support business decision-making.
Present insights and recommendations to leaders and cross-functional stakeholders in a clear and impactful way.
Lead complex investigations and quantify business impacts, trade-offs, and opportunities.
Drive improvements to reporting, data quality, processes, and analytical tools.
Partner with technology and data teams to improve data products, reporting capabilities, and business visibility.
Establish and maintain KPI definitions, reporting standards, and analytical best practices.
Support strategic initiatives through forecasting, scenario modeling, and business case development.
Mentor analysts and share best practices across analytics, reporting, and storytelling.
Act as a trusted advisor by using data to influence decisions and drive business outcomes.




Who- the Candidate:

Bachelor's degree in Business, Analytics, Supply Chain, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or a related field.




5+ years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, supply chain, inventory management, fulfillment operations, or a related field.




Advanced SQL skills and experience working with Snowflake or similar cloud-based data platforms.

Strong experience developing dashboards, reporting solutions, and KPI frameworks using Power BI or similar tools.




Proven ability to independently lead complex analytical initiatives and influence business decisions.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and storytelling skills, with the ability to present insights to senior leaders.




Experience working cross-functionally to define metrics, improve processes, and drive business outcomes.




Experience with Python, forecasting, advanced analytics, or data product ownership is an asset.

Competitive hourly wage in the range of $56-$64/hr + 4% vacation pay, if incorporated, please discuss with Swim

Vancouver, hybrid working conditions, 4 days onsite with some flexibility depending on individual’s circumstances.

Title: Supply Chain Business Analyst
Description:
Discover TRIUMF, Canada's particle accelerator centre. We are a publicly funded, not-for-profit research lab that is a hub for discovery and innovation.

Our mission is to serve as Canada’s particle accelerator centre. We advance isotope science and technology, both fundamental and applied. We collaborate across communities and disciplines, from nuclear and particle physics to the life and material sciences. We discover and innovate, inspire and educate, creating knowledge and opportunity for all.

TRIUMF's diverse community of nearly 600 multidisciplinary researchers, engineers, technicians, tradespeople, staff, and students create a unique incubator for Canadian excellence, as well as a portal to premier global collaborations. Fueling innovation and improving lives, we are committed to accelerating discovery and shaping a better world.

Basic Function

We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Supply Chain Business Analyst to support the continuous improvement of TRIUMF's supply chain operations. This role is responsible for analyzing complex operational and financial data, identifying trends, inefficiencies, and risks, and developing actionable recommendations that improve performance across procurement, logistics, inventory management, and sustainability initiatives.

Working closely with Supply Chain, Finance, and Information Systems & Technology (IS&T) teams, the incumbent will drive data-informed decision-making, optimize business processes, enhance system capabilities, and support strategic initiatives that improve operational efficiency, compliance, and service delivery.

Responsibilities

Supply Chain Analysis & Continuous Improvement


Analyze supply chain operations, including procurement, logistics, inventory management, and supply chain ESG initiatives.
Document current and future-state processes through process mapping, gap analysis, and workflow assessments.
Identify operational bottlenecks, cost drivers, and process inefficiencies; develop data-backed recommendations to improve performance.
Monitor and analyze supplier performance, Source-to-Pay (S2P) and Plan-to-Deliver (P2D) KPIs, processing cycle times, and service-level performance.
Lead and facilitate Supply Chain and Finance business process improvement meetings.


Systems & Technology Optimization


Lead the optimization and continuous enhancement of ERP system: Workday and support the implementation of supply chain systems.
Maintain and enhance business productivity tools such as Power Automate, Power Apps, SharePoint, and related Microsoft Power Platform solutions.
Gather business requirements and translate them into functional and technical specifications for process improvements, automation initiatives, and system enhancements.


Reporting & Business Intelligence


Design, develop, and maintain dashboards, scorecards, reports, and KPIs using Power BI, Excel, Workday reporting tools, and other analytics platforms.
Ensure data integrity, reporting accuracy, and effective visualization of key performance metrics.
Provide analytical insights to support strategic and operational decision-making.


Strategic Support


Conduct market research and competitive analysis on supplier markets, pricing trends, industry benchmarks, and emerging supply chain risks.
Support business case development for process improvements, technology investments, sourcing initiatives, and vendor selection.
Stay current with industry trends, best practices, and emerging technologies to drive innovation and operational excellence.
Participate in cross-functional initiatives that support organizational goals and operational excellence objectives.


Knowledge, Skills & Abilities


Advanced expertise in Workday reporting, dashboard development, analytics, and data management.
Strong experience creating and managing dashboards, scorecards, and KPIs using Power BI, Excel, and other reporting tools.
Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking capabilities.
Excellent business acumen with the ability to connect operational activities to strategic objectives.
Strong verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to present complex information clearly to diverse audiences.
Experience working collaboratively with cross-functional stakeholders in a complex organization.
Project management and change management experience
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, work through ambiguity, and adapt to changing business requirements.
Intellectual curiosity, sound judgment, and a commitment to continuous learning and continuous improvement.
Self-motivated, proactive, and results-oriented, with a strong focus on delivering business value and operational excellence.
Knowledge of sustainable procurement, ESG reporting, and responsible sourcing practices is an asset.


Minimum Qualifications And Experience


Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Supply Chain Management, Operations Management, Industrial Engineering, Logistics, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
Minimum of five (5) years of progressive experience in supply chain business analysis, reporting, and process improvement.
Direct experience with Workday is required.
Strong understanding of procurement, supply chain, inventory management, and logistics operations.
Demonstrated experience in business process analysis, KPI development, and supply chain reporting.


Preferred Professional Qualifications


Master's degree (e.g., MBA).
Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP).
Project Management Professional (PMP).
Supply chain designations such as CSCP, SCMP, or equivalent professional certifications.


Applicants must be legally able to work in Canada on a permanent basis (Canadian Citizen or Permanent Resident).

At TRIUMF, we value our employees and are committed to providing a competitive total rewards package. As the province’s largest energy provider with more than 100 years of knowledge and experience, we proudly deliver renewable energy, natural gas, electricity and propane to 1.3 million customers.

We're actively seeking new talent to join our mission of delivering a stronger energy future in B.C. As one of BC's Top Employers with a diverse team of over 2,700 employees, we are committed to a safe and inclusive culture where each of us can connect, belong, and grow. Join us, and together, let's shape a brighter future for B.C.

Position Overview

You’re a sharp analytical thinker with a knack for leveraging utility planning optimization software tools. Along with your love for quantitative analysis, you’re a numbers guru who excels in forecasting and modelling analyses.

In this role, you will:


Ensure the execution of strategies at the departmental and organizational level, both for analytical and regulatory submissions, that support business priorities.
Strengthen internal modelling expertise and capabilities while strategically guiding and integrating third-party consultant analyses into resource planning activities.
Analyze markets, energy utility planning environment, customer energy use, and provide useful qualitative and comparative insights.
Support workshops between our Gas and Electric utility resource planning analyses and reporting activities.
Collaborate with internal and external cross-functional experts to use energy demand and other business data to support recommendations on planning and project strategies.


What it takes:


A degree in economics, computer science, finance, business administration, or a related resource development field.
A minimum of four years of related analytical experience.
A demonstrated ability to learn coding languages such as R, Python, or other.
Prior experience with optimization models, production cost analytics, and macroeconomic modeling through software such as Plexos, Aurora, Navius, or other energy modelling tools is an asset.
Strong attention to detail and organization skills to conduct accurate analyses and forecasts.
Excellent interpersonal and time management skills to develop and deliver presentations with succinct recommendations and supported strategic arguments.


In this role, you will have the option to participate in a flexible work program, enabling you to work from an approved flex location in British Columbia up to 85 days a year (equivalent to approximately two days a week), subject to business or operational needs.

Title: Client Reporting Analyst
Description:
Are you interested in joining one of Canada’s top performing asset managers?  Connor, Clark & Lunn Financial Group (“CC&LFG”) is looking for a Client Reporting Analyst for an existing vacancy in our Institutional Client Reporting team. You will join our dedicated Client Reporting team to provide reporting operations expertise to CC&LFG’s institutional investment affiliates and interact with all levels of the organization, including daily contact with our affiliates’ Client Relationship Managers. If you have a focus for producing high quality work, are an expert multi-tasker, have a knack for using new technology and work well under pressure, this role could be a great fit for you. The Client Reporting Team places a high value on our team spirit and creating a culture where each of us has an opportunity to succeed. We are a solution-oriented and collaborative team, seeking like-minded individuals who thrive in a challenging and dynamic environment. Our offices currently operate on a hybrid model with a combination of in-office and remote working days throughout the week.

What You Will Do


Setup and maintenance of client accounts and client data
Ensure that a multitude of reports are accurately set up, maintained, produced and distributed
Communicate with various Client Relationship Managers and other key personnel across CC&L to support and trouble shoot the entire reporting production process; liaise with the internal development team and Information Systems support team to provide fixes and solutions
Building and maintaining report layouts using a mix of in-house tools and leading third party technology to ensure highly effective reporting operations
Work closely with the team’s dedicated development team members on using a third party IDE to enhance and develop report layouts and assign logical rules to support the automated report production as well as, translating business logic to source code written in a proprietary language
Analyze, maintain and improve the reporting process to maximize efficiency and minimize risk
Investigate and advise on best reporting practice


What You Bring


You have an interest in learning new technologies; developing and implementing new business processes. \
You have a positive attitude and collaborative spirit. Current and former colleagues would say that you’re an easy person to work with a one-team mindset
You are able to manage competing tasks and can successfully navigate working with multiple lines of business to implement a large number of reports.
Demonstrated ability to evaluate business problems and effectively apply solutions with subject matter expertise.
You have a proven ability to communicate well with internal stakeholders. You are clear on what you need and you clarify what others need; you manage expectations and are professional and positive all at the same time.
Advanced working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Word and PowerPoint (e.g. ability to use and understand formulas, charting tools, styles etc.). Knowledge of Simcorp’s Coric Client Communication solution is an asset.
You have an undergraduate degree coupled with 2-3 years in a related role or similar transferrable experience.


The salary range for this position is $60,000 - $80,000.  The salary range provided reflects the base salary range for this position as required by legislation.  In addition, there is an annual performance bonus which contributes to the total compensation of this position. Further questions may be directed to the HR team during the interview process.

For a closer look at how you can build your career with us, we invite you to explore cclgroup.com. 

CC&L Financial Group is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation or expression, disability, or age. 

Your application will be reviewed by a member of the hiring team - AI is not used in the screening, assessment or selection of applications at this time.

Title: Decision Scientist
Description:
Description & Requirements

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

Decision Scientist

Workplace Type: Hybrid (Austin, TX or Vancouver, BC)

Reporting to: Director, Decision and Data Science

Office of the CXO

The Office of the CXO drives effectiveness across the EA Experiences organization with a focus on excellence in business operations, comprehensive fan intelligence, plus internal technology and business solutions. We are horizontal connectors empowering teams across the Experiences organization with the strategic prioritization, investments, resources, data, insights, and technology required to accelerate business outcomes.

Your Impact

You will transform complex data into actionable insights that improve fan experiences and support business decisions. Working with large-scale gaming and customer datasets, you'll partner with teams across EA to solve business challenges using statistical analysis, experimentation, and machine learning.

Responsibilities


Analyze structured and unstructured datasets to identify trends and business insights.
Build, validate, and improve predictive and prescriptive models using Python or R.
Design and evaluate experiments to measure product and business outcomes.
Develop dashboards and visualizations that communicate analytical findings.
Partner with cross-functional teams to translate business questions into analytical solutions.
Present recommendations through clear visualizations and business-focused storytelling.
Apply responsible AI practices, including model validation, fairness, and bias monitoring.


Required Qualifications


Master's degree in Statistics, Operations Research, Data Science, or a related field; equivalent experience considered.
Experience using Python or R for statistical analysis and modeling.
Experience with SQL and relational databases.
Experience using visualization tools such as Tableau, Streamlit, or RShiny.
Experience applying statistical methods to business problems.


Core Skills And Experience


2+ years applying statistical modeling in a business environment.
Experience preparing, analyzing, and interpreting large datasets.
Knowledge of experimentation and causal inference methods.
Experience communicating analytical findings through dashboards and presentations.
Familiarity with Git and cloud-based analytical environments.


Pay Transparency - North America

Compensation And Benefits

The ranges listed below are what EA in good faith expects to pay applicants for this role in these locations at the time of this posting. If you reside in a different location, a recruiter will advise on the applicable range and benefits. Pay offered will be determined based on a number of relevant business and candidate factors (e.g. education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, or business needs).

PAY RANGES


British Columbia (depending on location e.g. Vancouver vs. Victoria) *$104,500 - $142,800 CAD


Pay is just one part of the overall compensation at EA.

For Canada, we offer a package of benefits including vacation (3 weeks per year to start), 10 days per year of sick time, paid top-up to EI/QPIP benefits up to 100% of base salary when you welcome a new child (12 weeks for maternity, and 4 weeks for parental/adoption leave), extended health/dental/vision coverage, life insurance, disability insurance, retirement plan to regular full-time employees. Certain roles may also be eligible for bonus and other incentive programs.

About Electronic Arts

We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.

We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. We nurture environments where our teams can always bring their best to what they do.

Electronic Arts is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will also consider employment qualified applicants with criminal records in accordance with applicable law. EA also makes workplace accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities as required by applicable law.
